papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.abstract: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.title_cn: 捉迷藏：隐藏概念以寻找黑盒模型的解释
papers.abs_cn: 解释机器学习模型的预测是一个核心挑战，尤其是对于黑盒视觉模型。基于概念的归因方法使用人类可理解的概念来解释模型。现有的基于概念的方法只能解释分类和回归模型。它们需要访问模型权重或大规模概念标注数据集，并且大多数方法无法提供图像级归因。我们提出了捉迷藏（Hide and Seek，HnS），一种新的概念级归因方法，不需要访问模型权重或标注的概念数据集。HnS 可以解释多种视觉模型。给定一个概念和图像集，HnS 使用视觉-语言模型检索与概念对齐的图像，在每个图像中定位该概念，遮蔽定位区域，并通过黑盒模型在原始图像和遮蔽图像之间输出的变化来测量归因。这通过直接测量模型行为并支持局部归因，实现了忠实的归因。我们在 CelebA 和 COCO-Stuff 上验证了 HnS。与现有方法相比，HnS 与真实归因表现出更好的一致性。我们展示了 HnS 在多种任务上的适用性，包括图像描述和卫星图像分割，这些任务中现有概念归因方法无法使用。我们在补充材料中提供了匿名代码。

papers.title: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
papers.abstract: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
papers.title_cn: 神经网络拓扑表达力的构造性边界
papers.abs_cn: 神经网络 Φ 的表达力描述了网络能够表达的函数类。术语“拓扑表达力”指的是一类特别适合理解二分类问题的度量，通常以决策边界 β(Φ^{-1}(0)) 的 Betti 数形式表述。尽管这一度量很流行，但它对于回归以及其他不涉及决策边界的问题并不那么有用。相反，我们提出从神经网络输出 β(Φ(X)) 的 Betti 数角度来研究拓扑表达力。我们正式证明，一个具有架构 (d, sum_{k=1}^{d} β_k(3k+2), sum_{k=1}^{d} β_k(k+1)) 的 ReLU 网络能够表达与具有任意 Betti 数的球面楔和同伦等价的空间。这给出了任意连通（β_0=1）Betti 数序列的上界，但通过构造与 N 个维度为 d_1,...,d_N 的球面的乘积同伦等价的空间，我们对于由 prod_n (1+x^{d_n}) 给出的 Betti 数实现了更好的边界 (sum_{n=1} d_n, 3 sum_{n=1}^N d_n + 2N, sum_{n=1}^N d_n + N)。最后，我们猜想一个更强得多的紧边界，它对于与球面同胚的空间给出架构边界 (d, d+1, d+1)。

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.abstract: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.title_cn: AI 模型可证明地隐藏任意能力
papers.abs_cn: 能力评估旨在在部署前揭示危险的模型行为，但其可靠性取决于一个假设：隐藏的能力可以被诱发出来。我们通过构造后门攻击表明，这一假设在对抗条件下并不成立——这些攻击将加密的神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重中，仅在收到秘密触发器时才解密并执行。利用数字储物柜（digital lockers），这些隐藏电路在密码学假设下可证明地难以被诱发和解释，即使拥有对模型权重的完全访问权限也是如此，从而将先前的工作从隐藏固定字符串扩展到隐藏任意计算。我们在 PyTorch 中实现了概念验证构造，并在一个小型化学反应预测任务（作为 CBRN 相关能力的代理）上，通过微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索和潜在对抗训练来评估诱发效果。我们的结果表明这些方法难以奏效，并结合我们的密码学保证，揭示了基于诱发的能カ审计的局限性。我们发布模型以支持防御措施的改进。

papers.title: KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling
papers.abstract: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. The separation extends to weighted fixed-count targets with bounded weight ratios and quota fractions bounded away from zero and one, without permutation symmetry, and to the full-support Beta$(1,1)$--Bernoulli target, where the sharp expected cost under the output-law criterion is $(e^{-\varepsilon}/2+o(1))\log_2\log_2n$, attained with rare $n$-round runs. Prior work implies the order of the schedule-averaged cost on the balanced target and its $O_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ upper bounds on both extensions.
papers.title_cn: 混合前后的 KL：并行采样中的轮复杂度分离
papers.abs_cn: 并行采样器可以随机选择哪些坐标一起生成。对于目标分布 p 以及每次输出都重新抽取的调度 U 的输出律 q_U，我们比较调度平均散度 E_U D_KL(p||q_U) 与输出律散度 D_KL(p||E_U q_U)，单位为 nat。轮次提交的是在该轮开始时冻结的精确条件边缘分布上的独立抽样，每个输出的调度在采样前从一个有限调度混合中抽取，并且每个已调度的轮次都被计入。对于长度为偶数 n 且恰有 n/2 个 1 的二进制串上的均匀分布，在固定容差 epsilon > 0 下，最小期望轮数在第一个准则下为 Theta_epsilon((log n)^2)，但在第二个准则下为 (e^{-epsilon}+o(1)) log_2 ln n，并且双对数阶可以在每次运行中都以相同轮数达到。对于该目标，计数状态递归给出了在所有因果随机策略下、每个轮数上限处的精确最小输出散度。该分离可扩展到权重比有界且配额比例远离 0 和 1 的加权固定计数目标，无需置换对称性，也可扩展到全支撑 Beta(1,1)--Bernoulli 目标；在后一目标下，输出律准则下的精确期望代价为 (e^{-epsilon}/2+o(1)) log_2 log_2 n，并由罕见的 n 轮运行达到。先前工作蕴含了平衡目标上调度平均代价的阶，以及其在两个扩展上的 O_epsilon((log n)^2) 上界。

papers.title: Goal-Oriented Bundle Management and Flow Control for Deep-Space Communications via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Deep-space communications operate under intermittent connectivity, long propagation delays, and relay storage constraints. In such networks, the Bundle Protocol enables store-carry-forward communication, requiring relay nodes to manage limited storage and scarce contact opportunities. Relay-side scheduling and dropping decisions are inherently goal-oriented: transmission resources should be allocated to bundles most valuable to downstream mission objectives. Conventional schedulers, such as FIFO, do not explicitly optimize task utility and may provide unfair service across heterogeneous planetary sources. This paper presents a closed-loop modeling and learning framework for relay-side bundle and flow management in a contact-driven deep-space network, where lunar and Martian updates are forwarded through a shared-buffer relay to Earth. We quantify destination-side information freshness using excess age $Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+$, where $Δ_i(t)$ denotes the Age of Information of source $i$ and $d_i(t)$ is a source-dependent delay baseline. Based on this metric, we define a goal-oriented loss that supports source-dependent nonlinear penalties, allowing prioritization according to mission relevance. We formulate relay control as a constrained semi-Markov decision process (CSMDP) and solve it using masked Lagrangian Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Feasibility-aware action masking restricts transmissions to bundles that can complete within the remaining contact window. DTNSim simulations indicate improved age-based utility and inter-flow fairness compared with baseline schedulers. The proposed framework jointly optimizes relay-side bundle scheduling, dropping, and flow control under contact-driven dynamics with explicit fairness considerations across heterogeneous sources.
papers.title_cn: 基于强化学习的深空通信面向目标的束管理与流量控制
papers.abs_cn: 深空通信在间歇性连接、长传播时延和中继存储约束下运行。在此类网络中，Bundle Protocol 支持存储-携带-转发通信，要求中继节点管理有限的存储和稀缺的接触机会。中继侧的调度和丢弃决策本质上是面向目标的：传输资源应分配给对下游任务目标最有价值的束。传统调度器（如 FIFO）不显式优化任务效用，并可能对异构行星来源提供不公平的服务。本文提出了一个闭环建模与学习框架，用于接触驱动的深空网络中中继侧的束与流量管理，其中月球和火星更新通过共享缓冲区中继转发至地球。我们使用超额年龄 $Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+$ 量化目的地侧信息新鲜度，其中 $Δ_i(t)$ 表示源 $i$ 的信息年龄，$d_i(t)$ 是依赖于源的延迟基线。基于该指标，我们定义了一个面向目标的损失，支持依赖于源的非线性惩罚，从而允许根据任务相关性进行优先级排序。我们将中继控制建模为约束半马尔可夫决策过程（CSMDP），并使用掩码拉格朗日近端策略优化（PPO）求解。可行性感知的动作掩码将传输限制为可在剩余接触窗口内完成的束。DTNSim 仿真表明，与基线调度器相比，基于年龄的效用和流间公平性均有所改善。所提出的框架在接触驱动动态下联合优化中继侧的束调度、丢弃和流量控制，并显式考虑异构来源之间的公平性。

papers.title: DyssomniaNN: Multi-Scale Spiking Neural Modeling of Human Sleep Disorders and Perceived Restedness
papers.abstract: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. Here, we present DyssomniaNN: a multi-scale biophysical computational framework coupling Borbély's two-process regulation of sleep homeostasis and circadian drive with Saper's hypothalamic reciprocal flip-flop circuit and a recurrent corticothalamic leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network. We formalize five clinical cohorts across an identical 72-hour photoperiod: healthy control, circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder (delayed-phase), chronic insomnia, paradoxical insomnia, and narcolepsy type 1. The synthetic local field potential converges closely with empirical human electroencephalography spectra from the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF database across all canonical frequency bands (spectral mean absolute error of 0.33--0.35). Furthermore, we introduce the Well-Rested Index to quantify restorative efficacy. Simulations reveal that sleep duration fails to predict restorative recovery: paradoxical insomnia achieves normal total sleep time (21.15 h) yet yields low restoration (37.6%) from unsuppressed cortical beta-band intrusion, whereas hypocretin deficiency in narcolepsy produces severe nocturnal fragmentation (781 min of wake after sleep onset) and 35 sleep-onset rapid eye movement periods. DyssomniaNN provides an in silico platform for mechanistic sleep research and virtual neuropharmacology.
papers.title_cn: DyssomniaNN：人类睡眠障碍与感知休息感的多尺度脉冲神经网络建模
papers.abs_cn: 临床睡眠医学反复记录了客观睡眠时长与主观日间功能损害之间的显著分离，其典型例证包括矛盾性失眠中的睡眠状态误知觉以及1型发作性睡病中的边界不稳定性。在此，我们提出DyssomniaNN：一个多尺度生物物理计算框架，将Borbély的睡眠稳态与昼夜节律驱动的双过程调控、Saper的下丘脑交互式flip-flop回路以及一个递归皮质丘脑漏积分-发放脉冲神经网络相耦合。我们在相同的72小时光周期下形式化了五个临床队列：健康对照、昼夜节律睡眠-觉醒障碍（延迟相位型）、慢性失眠、矛盾性失眠和1型发作性睡病。合成的局部场电位在所有典型频带上与PhysioNet Sleep-EDF数据库中的经验人类脑电频谱高度收敛（频谱平均绝对误差为0.33--0.35）。此外，我们引入Well-Rested Index以量化恢复效能。模拟揭示，睡眠时长无法预测恢复性修复：矛盾性失眠达到正常总睡眠时间（21.15 h），但由于未受抑制的皮层beta频段侵入，仅产生较低的恢复度（37.6%）；而发作性睡病中的下丘脑分泌素缺乏则导致严重的夜间碎片化（入睡后觉醒781 min）和35次睡眠始发快速眼动期。DyssomniaNN为机制性睡眠研究和虚拟神经药理学提供了一个in silico平台。

papers.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
papers.abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.
papers.title_cn: 从自然语言设计蛋白质结构
papers.abs_cn: 从头蛋白质设计的一个核心挑战是生成具有所需结构和功能特性的蛋白质。现有设计模型通常需要为每种特性使用专门的输入表示，限制了其支持的设计目标。我们开发了 Prompteina，这是首个支持以自然语言指定的新的、更广泛设计目标的全原子结构生成模型，类似于文本到图像生成。为了训练 Prompteina，我们构建了 Prompteina-Data，这是一个配对文本--蛋白质结构数据集，包含 180 万个结构和超过 5000 万条描述全局及残基特异性结构和功能特性的标题。我们通过文本条件预训练和微调，使残基与其对应文本对齐，从而对预训练结构生成模型 Proteina-Complexa 进行了适配。Prompteina 在 18 项结构特性中的 15 项上优于基线，并生成与其预期功能描述更匹配的蛋白质。在结合体设计中，它在 20 个靶标中的至少 13 个上领先基线，并将界面置信度相比最强基线提高了 14%。通过迭代的计算机反馈，Prompteina 相对于非迭代生成的增益在最难靶标上比次优基线大 57%。最后，我们针对 GM2A 实验验证了 Prompteina 的设计，该靶标尚无报道的从头结合体。我们鉴定出九个结合体，其中最强者的表观 $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ 为 107 nM。这些结果确立了自然语言作为蛋白质结构生成的一种有效且强大的条件接口。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Demand-Private Coded Caching: Exact Characterization for Two Users and Two Files
papers.abstract: We consider the demand-private coded caching problem with heterogeneous file sizes and cache capacities, where each user must recover its requested file without learning any information about the demands of the other users. We first extend the virtual-user reduction technique to accommodate heterogeneous cache sizes, thereby enabling the construction of demand-private coded caching schemes from non-private schemes. Our main contribution is an exact characterization of the memory-rate trade-off for the fundamental setting of two users and two files with arbitrary file sizes and cache capacities. Specifically, we characterize the optimal trade-off through eight linear inequalities and establish achievability by constructing explicit coded caching schemes for the non-trivial corner points, followed by memory sharing. These constructions include novel asymmetric cache placement strategies tailored to heterogeneous file sizes and cache capacities. For the converse, we exploit the distributional equivalences induced by demand privacy to derive information-theoretic lower bounds that explicitly account for the underlying heterogeneity. Our results generalize the exact memory-rate trade-off characterization for the homogeneous demand-private coded caching setting with two users and two files, while quantifying the additional transmission cost imposed by demand privacy compared with the non-private heterogeneous setting.
papers.title_cn: 异构需求隐私编码缓存：两用户两文件的精确刻画
papers.abs_cn: 我们考虑具有异构文件大小和缓存容量的需求隐私编码缓存问题，其中每个用户必须恢复其请求的文件，同时不能获知关于其他用户需求的任何信息。我们首先将虚拟用户归约技术扩展到适应异构缓存容量，从而能够从非隐私方案构造需求隐私编码缓存方案。我们的主要贡献是对两用户两文件这一基本设置（具有任意文件大小和缓存容量）的内存-速率权衡的精确刻画。具体而言，我们通过八个线性不等式刻画最优权衡，并通过对非平凡角点构造显式编码缓存方案再结合内存共享来建立可达性。这些构造包括针对异构文件大小和缓存容量定制的新型非对称缓存放置策略。对于逆定理，我们利用需求隐私所诱导的分布等价性来推导显式考虑底层异构性的信息论下界。我们的结果推广了两用户两文件同构需求隐私编码缓存设置的精确内存-速率权衡刻画，同时量化了与非隐私异构设置相比需求隐私所施加的额外传输开销。

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
papers.title_cn: RSI-Anything：以世界模型解锁递归自我改进
papers.abs_cn: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将交互经验转化为持续改进，但外部反馈代价高昂，且随着策略演化，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。我们提出 RSI-Anything，这是一个基于 JEPA-Anything 构建的领域通用框架，利用预测性世界模型来指导行动和学习数据选择。观测到的反馈驱动策略或工作流改进以及条件世界模型自适应，而组件与兼容性检查则管理更新后的策略-模型对的保留。在多种计算与科学领域中，RSI-Anything 展现出显著收益。在代码修复中，固定编码器时，成功率从静态验证器的 26.3% 提升至通过预测选择的 29.2%，并在世界模型自适应后达到 31.2%，且测试使用量相当。图形用户界面（GUI）评估显示任务完成率更高，同时平均动作数减少 39.4%。在连续五个策略版本中，实验室规划得分从 21.80% 提升一倍以上至 46.01%。在反应优化中，相同 40 次实验预算下，RSI-Anything 达到 96.15% 的平均最佳观测产率，而贝叶斯优化为 82.16%。一个端到端的免疫科学应用进一步将工作流演化与预测建模同治疗假设生成联系起来。这些结果展示了预测性世界模型与保留的系统更新如何在不同环境中实现递归改进。

papers.title: Fundamental Limits of Covert queueing under Busy-Period Observations
papers.abstract: Consider a queueing system operated by Bob, which is intended to serve only jobs generated by a legitimate user, Willie. Willie's jobs arrive according to a Poisson process, and the service times are exponentially distributed. Bob seeks to covertly serve additional jobs arriving according to an independent Poisson process, without Willie detecting their presence. As the legitimate user, Willie is provided with certain statistics of each busy period by Bob. In particular, we consider two statistics: (i) the number of jobs served during each busy period and (ii) the duration of each busy period. We establish that, under either statistic, the maximum expected number of additional jobs that Bob can covertly serve obeys a square-root law. Specifically, over n busy periods, Bob can covertly serve additional jobs in the order of square root of n, whereas any scaling which is above square root of n enables Willie to asymptotically detect the presence of these additional jobs with vanishing error probability. Furthermore, we characterize the scaling constant associated with the square-root law, which we refer to as the covert queueing constant, for each of the two statistics. We compare the scaling constants corresponding to the two statistics and argue that the scaling constant under statistic (i) is no greater than that under statistic (ii).
papers.title_cn: 忙碌期观测下隐蔽排队的根本极限
papers.abs_cn: 考虑一个由 Bob 运营的排队系统，该系统原本只服务于合法用户 Willie 产生的作业。Willie 的作业按照泊松过程到达，服务时间服从指数分布。Bob 试图隐蔽地服务额外到达的、服从独立泊松过程的作业，而不让 Willie 察觉它们的存在。作为合法用户，Willie 从 Bob 那里获得每个忙碌期的某些统计量。特别地，我们考虑两种统计量：(i) 每个忙碌期内服务的作业数，以及 (ii) 每个忙碌期的持续时间。我们证明，在任一统计量下，Bob 能够隐蔽服务的额外作业的最大期望数量都遵循平方根定律。具体而言，在 n 个忙碌期内，Bob 能够隐蔽服务的额外作业数量为 n 的平方根量级，而任何高于 n 的平方根的缩放都会使 Willie 能够以趋于零的错误概率渐近地检测到这些额外作业的存在。此外，我们刻画了与平方根定律相关的缩放常数，我们将其称为隐蔽排队常数，针对这两种统计量分别给出。我们比较了对应于这两种统计量的缩放常数，并论证统计量 (i) 下的缩放常数不大于统计量 (ii) 下的缩放常数。

papers.title: When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.
papers.title_cn: 当 VLM 摧毁它们所知：空间表征跌至词汇先验之下
papers.abs_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地分析和推理图像，但尚不清楚其内部表征是否忠实地编码了此类推理所需的结构化关系。我们引入 EICS（Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability，评估不变概念稳定性），一种用于测试表征在受控的单概念干预下是否一致地编码概念的指标，以及 CASP-VL（Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models，面向视觉语言模型的因果控制空间扰动），一个源自 Visual Genome 场景图的因果控制空间扰动基准。在多种 VLM 架构上，我们发现空间关系的表征忠实度显著低于词汇信息，即使这些模型在组合性基准上的得分远高于随机水平。进一步分析表明，关系在谓词自身的 token 处是可识别的，但当句子被聚合为全局表征时——无论是通过 (EOS) token 还是均值池化——这种关系就丢失了。这些发现揭示了一种基于输出的评估所无法察觉的系统性失败：VLM 在其下游使用的表征中，并未保留其自身输入中存在的关系信息。

papers.title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
papers.abstract: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.
papers.title_cn: 重新审视表格深度回归：目标函数与全局早停的局限
papers.abs_cn: 尽管面向表格数据的深度学习模型近年来受到了大量研究关注，但回归任务中目标函数的选择仍是一个研究不足的自由度。多条研究路线为标准的均方误差（MSE）提供了替代方案，但数据集、骨干网络和评估协议上的差异使得它们的实际收益难以比较。在本工作中，我们通过在大量已确立的表格数据集和多种神经骨干网络上对回归目标函数进行系统性重新评估，来填补这一空白。我们的比较表明，许多被提出的目标函数相对于经过恰当调参的 MSE 基线仅带来有限或不一致的增益，而分位数损失在所测试的骨干网络上相对于 MSE 带来了持续的整体改进。随后，我们识别出一个即使使用这一强大目标函数仍然存在的局限：具有不同目标噪声水平的区域可能在不同训练轮次达到其最佳预测性能。因此，即使目标函数能够表示异方差目标分布，单一的全局早停检查点也会在不同不确定性区域之间强加一种折中。受这一局限的启发，我们引入了一种异方差感知的分位数损失扩展，它使用依赖于输入的标签平滑作为潜在补救手段，并在多个骨干网络上优于分位数损失。总体而言，我们的结果为表格深度学习的回归目标函数提供了一幅现代经验图景，并突出了不同不确定性区域之间最优停止时间的差异如何限制全局早停的有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression 获取。

papers.title: Hitting-Time Bounds for Asynchronous Q-Learning
papers.abstract: We study the last iterate of standard asynchronous Q-learning from a single trajectory of a finite Markov decision process. The trajectory follows a fixed behavior policy whose state--action chain is irreducible and may be periodic. For discount factor $γ$, write $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, and let $μ_{\min}$ be the minimum stationary state--action probability and $\mathfrak h_\star$ the largest expected hitting time of the reverse state--action chain. We prove that zero-initialized Q-learning with a constant step size achieves sup-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ with high probability using $\widetilde{O}(H^4/(μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2)+\mathfrak h_\star)$ transitions, for $0<\varepsilon\le1$. The statistical term retains the quartic effective-horizon dependence of standard Q-learning, while initialization cost is additive in $\mathfrak h_\star$. For aperiodic behavior chains, a comparison with mixing time yields a transient term $\widetilde{O}(t_{\mathrm{mix}}/μ_{\min})$. An empirical state--action count rule selects a constant step size for a subsequent training run and attains the same rate without prior knowledge of model parameters, target accuracy, or confidence level. The output is the last training iterate, with both stages included in the sample count. The proof uses two deterministic Bellman envelopes to separate statistical error from fixed-policy initialization error and adapts reverse-time hitting-cost compensation from TD learning to state--action propagation. An exploration lower bound holds for arbitrary predictable step sizes. Together with the existing statistical lower bound and its extension to pilot-selected constant steps, it yields matching mean-square rates up to logarithmic factors on the stated large-sample parameter classes.
papers.title_cn: 异步 Q 学习的命中时间界
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究标准异步 Q 学习在有限马尔可夫决策过程的单条轨迹上的最后迭代。该轨迹遵循一个固定的行为策略，其状态-动作链不可约且可能周期。对于折扣因子 $γ$，记 $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$，并令 $μ_{\min}$ 为最小平稳状态-动作概率，$\mathfrak h_\star$ 为反向状态-动作链的最大期望命中时间。我们证明，零初始化的 Q 学习采用常数步长时，以高概率达到至多 $\varepsilon$ 的 sup-范数误差，所需转移次数为 $\widetilde{O}(H^4/(μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2)+\mathfrak h_\star)$，其中 $0<\varepsilon\le1$。统计项保留了标准 Q 学习的四次有效时域依赖，而初始化成本以 $\mathfrak h_\star$ 为加性项。对于非周期行为链，与混合时间的比较产生瞬态项 $\widetilde{O}(t_{\mathrm{mix}}/μ_{\min})$。一种经验状态-动作计数规则为后续训练运行选择常数步长，并在无需模型参数、目标精度或置信水平先验知识的情况下达到相同速率。输出是最后训练迭代，两个阶段均计入样本数。证明使用两个确定性贝尔曼包络将统计误差与固定策略初始化误差分离，并将 TD 学习中的反向时间命中成本补偿适配到状态-动作传播。对于任意可预测步长，探索下界成立。结合现有的统计下界及其对试点选择常数步长的扩展，在所述大样本参数类上，它产生了直到对数因子的匹配均方速率。

papers.title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
papers.abstract: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.
papers.title_cn: 面向神经语义解析的结构自动机
papers.abs_cn: 神经语义解析器逐 token 生成意义表示，但其良构性取决于生成过程中展开的引用、作用域和图关系。约束解码可阻止局部无效 token，但不能保证一个有效前缀能在固定输出长度限制内被补全。我们研究了 DRS 解析三个阶段的 结构自动机（解码、事后处理和训练），并额外在 AMR 上评估了解码。对于解码，我们引入接受路径解码（APD），它在剩余长度限制内维护一个经过验证的补全，并在模型偏好的 token 也能被补全时遵循该 token。APD 保证在不撤回 token 的情况下产生被接受的输出。在严格长度限制下，它在 DRS 上将 Smatch++ 相比局部掩码分别提升 5.1 和 2.4 个点，在 AMR 上分别提升 6.4 和 3.2 个点，与相同限制下会撤回 token 的回滚方法相当。对于事后处理，无效输出集中在相同输入上：在训练数据有限时，八个无约束样本对 10.2% 的输入没有产生有效输出，而在完整数据下这一比例为 0.4%，此时过滤与 APD 的 Smatch++ 差距在 0.2 个点以内。对于训练，惩罚被自动机拒绝的 token 可在训练 10% 后将开发集 Smatch++ 提升 3.6-11.0 个点，但随着仅交叉熵在有限数据下于训练前六分之一内将分配给被拒绝 token 的概率从 14% 降至 2% 以下，这一优势会减弱。

papers.title: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.
papers.title_cn: 任务上下文塑造语言模型中的组件角色
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型在不同任务中复用相同的注意力头，但识别这些共享头并不能解释它们在每个任务中做了什么不同的事情。一个自然的灵感来源是共享脑区之间依赖任务的交互，这激发了对语言模型计算的网络视角。在这里，我们使用相同的图事实——即指定哪些有向连接存在的陈述——来比较不同任务中的固定模型组件。我们测量干预如何影响注意力头以及后续层中的激活状态（影响），以及答案（重要性）。任务变化在五个开放权重模型（涵盖四个系列、15亿至140亿参数）中重新分配了影响。在Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B中，激活编辑改变了一个早期内部激活向量，并在书面指令保持不变的情况下切换了模型读取的事实。相同的头随后对不同的图事实做出响应，并以不同方式影响后续组件。对于每个提示，我们构建两个线性响应映射，一个在编辑之前，一个在编辑之后。每个映射根据早期头的测量变化来预测后续头的响应。对于单独的事实干预，与两个映射的平均值相比，对应条件的映射在Gemma中将均方预测误差降低了53.6%，在Qwen中降低了5.0%。这些发现表明，任务上下文既改变了共享组件响应的图事实，也改变了它们的输出如何影响后续计算。网络解释可能有助于解释模型如何使用共享参数执行不同的计算。对任务依赖影响的测量还可以指导旨在改变一种行为同时保留其他行为的干预。

papers.title: Information-Weighted Distributed Kalman Filter for Multi-Target Tracking over Switching Sensor Networks
papers.abstract: Target tracking over wide areas using a network of sensor agents is a challenging problem when agents have limited sensing coverage and communication topologies vary over time. Existing distributed filtering approaches commonly assume that each agent, or at least one of its neighbors, can directly observe the target, and further rely on fixed network topologies, global network parameters, or multiple consensus rounds per time step. These requirements limit their applicability in wide-area network deployments. In this paper, we propose an Information-Weighted Distributed Kalman Filter (IWDKF) that relaxes these assumptions through a weighted-consensus mechanism applicable to arbitrary switching topologies satisfying joint connectivity. The proposed approach requires no prior knowledge of global network properties and limits communication overhead to a single consensus exchange per time step, while enabling information fusion even when some agents lack direct target measurements. The weighted-consensus covariance matrix is shown to remain positive definite, and the resulting consensus update is proven to maintain estimate consistency. It is also established that the proposed weighting strategy preserves the asymptotic agreement property of the underlying consensus protocol under joint connectivity. Numerical simulations of a multi-target tracking scenario involving a network of sensor agents demonstrate the improved estimation accuracy of the proposed IWDKF under both fixed and switching network topologies. The performance of the proposed filter is close to that of the centralized Kalman filter, and is compared with three existing distributed filters.
papers.title_cn: 信息加权分布式卡尔曼滤波器用于切换传感器网络上的多目标跟踪
papers.abs_cn: 当传感器代理的感知覆盖范围有限且通信拓扑随时间变化时，利用传感器代理网络在广域内进行目标跟踪是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有的分布式滤波方法通常假设每个代理，或至少其邻居之一，能够直接观测目标，并且进一步依赖于固定的网络拓扑、全局网络参数或每个时间步的多轮一致性通信。这些要求限制了它们在广域网络部署中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种信息加权分布式卡尔曼滤波器（IWDKF），通过一种适用于满足联合连通性的任意切换拓扑的加权一致性机制来放宽这些假设。所提出的方法不需要关于全局网络特性的先验知识，并将通信开销限制为每个时间步一次一致性交换，同时即使某些代理缺乏直接目标测量也能实现信息融合。加权一致性协方差矩阵被证明保持正定，并且由此产生的一致性更新被证明能够保持估计一致性。同时还证明了所提出的加权策略在联合连通性下保持了底层一致性协议的渐近一致性性质。涉及传感器代理网络的多目标跟踪场景的数值仿真表明，所提出的 IWDKF 在固定和切换网络拓扑下均具有改进的估计精度。所提出滤波器的性能接近集中式卡尔曼滤波器，并与三种现有分布式滤波器进行了比较。

papers.title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
papers.abstract: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.
papers.title_cn: 预测不是充分的内存状态
papers.abs_cn: 一个能重现当前所有预测的内存，可能仍然忘记了如何从下一个观测中学习。我们针对精确累积学习和注意力刻画了这一区别。对于具有无限制实数特征和标签的光滑凸残差损失，固定维度的连续循环状态存在当且仅当损失为多项式。在普通、无权观测下，次数 $D$ 恰好需要 $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ 个坐标；即使在具有一个固定当前预测器的历史中，也恰好有 $r-d$ 个坐标对于延续仍然是必要的。非多项式损失在此类等预测历史上具有无界需求。有界标量逻辑回归示例在固定任意有限导数节之后仍保留这一障碍。对于岭回归，隐藏证据是设计矩阵：精确状态代价为 $dp+d(d+1)/2$，而预测器为 $dp$。在一个良态零预测族上，最优 $B$ 比特压缩的平均单次更新误差为 $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$ 量级，$s_d=d(d+1)/2$，即使使用任意随机编码也是如此。核注意力给出了第二个精确闭包分类。这些结果识别了未来更新所揭示的内容，而不是提出新的回归算法或断言训练模型的增益。

papers.title: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
papers.abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) decoding requires reliable corrections and low latency over long syndrome histories. We extend BP-SF, an oscillation-guided belief-propagation (BP) decoder with independent syndrome-flip trials, by introducing windowed and streaming operations. Our CUDA implementation combines disordered-memory retries, sliding windows, correlation-aware graphs, and layered scheduling. Circuit-level simulations test fixed-basis memory and complete logical Pauli-frame recovery. On the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code at physical error rate p = 0.002, parallel BP-SF reduces 99.9th-percentile call latency by a factor of 13.15 relative to an eight-chain Relay-BP GPU baseline on 100,000 matched samples for which every tested method's initial BP stage fails within 80 iterations. Windowed BP-SF maintains a flat logical error rate and nearly constant per-round compute time through 512 rounds, reaching a 17.1-fold speedup over monolithic decoding. In 512-round full-frame streaming decoding with 2.97-ms syndrome arrivals, layered BP-SF on a transformed joint graph with 20 retries reduces 99.9th-percentile correction-release age from 166.29 to 36.25 ms relative to the joint graph with flooding updates and 100 retries. These results connect parallel BP post-processing to lower decoding costs and earlier correction release in streaming quantum memory.
papers.title_cn: 基于GPU的量子LDPC存储器并行BP解码
papers.abs_cn: 量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）解码需要在长校验子历史下实现可靠纠错与低延迟。我们扩展了BP-SF——一种带有独立校验子翻转尝试的振荡引导置信传播（BP）解码器——通过引入窗口化与流式操作。我们的CUDA实现结合了乱序内存重试、滑动窗口、相关性感知图以及分层调度。电路级仿真测试了固定基存储器与完整逻辑Pauli帧恢复。在[[144,12,12]]双变量自行车码上，物理错误率p = 0.002时，对于100,000个匹配样本（所有被测方法的初始BP阶段均在80次迭代内失败），并行BP-SF相对于八链Relay-BP GPU基线将99.9百分位调用延迟降低了13.15倍。窗口化BP-SF在512轮内保持平坦的逻辑错误率与近乎恒定的每轮计算时间，相较于整体式解码实现了17.1倍加速。在具有2.97毫秒校验子到达的512轮全帧流式解码中，采用20次重试的变换联合图上的分层BP-SF，相对于采用洪泛更新与100次重试的联合图，将99.9百分位校正释放年龄从166.29毫秒降低至36.25毫秒。这些结果将并行BP后处理与流式量子存储器中更低的解码成本和更早的校正释放联系起来。

papers.title: Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking
papers.abstract: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component. With independently sampled function evaluations and Gaussian or spherical probes, PISO attains leading function-evaluation complexities of \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\) under Lipschitz gradients and \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\) under an additional Lipschitz-Hessian assumption. These rates require only one probe direction, two function samples, and one known-component sample per update. The analysis also quantifies how batching trades observations for fewer deployments. Across five settings, PISO variants improve on the tested baselines with comparable oracle access in three, reach a comparable solution faster in bilevel routing, and perform best among methods without response-model derivatives in performative reinforcement learning.
papers.title_cn: 基于零阶残差跟踪的部分信息随机优化
papers.abs_cn: 许多优化问题只能直接获取部分梯度，而剩余部分必须通过函数评估来推断。这种结构出现在表演性预测、表演性强化学习以及下层为黑箱的双层优化中。我们提出了部分信息随机优化（PISO），它将可用的梯度分量与残差的运行估计相结合。通过将每个零阶观测以该估计为中心，PISO 使随机探测引起的方差取决于跟踪误差而非残差的幅度。这产生了一种具有显式收缩机制的随机草图迭代，并为动量提供了有原则的解释。对于光滑非凸目标，我们建立了依赖于残差变化和初始幅度的收敛保证，而不需要对不可用梯度分量的一致界。在独立采样的函数评估以及高斯或球面探测下，PISO 在 Lipschitz 梯度下达到了领先的函数评估复杂度 \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\)，在额外的 Lipschitz-Hessian 假设下达到 \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\)。这些速率每次更新仅需要一个探测方向、两个函数样本和一个已知分量样本。该分析还量化了批处理如何以观测换取更少的部署。在五个设置中，PISO 变体在三个设置中以可比的 oracle 访问改进了所测试的基线，在双层路由中更快地达到可比解，并在表演性强化学习中在没有响应模型导数的方法中表现最佳。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Fully Discrete Conditional Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: We establish finite-sample guarantees for conditional diffusion models learned from data and implemented with finitely many denoising steps. Our approach aligns the score-training objective with the sampling grid, allowing statistical estimation and numerical discretization errors to be analyzed together. Under a smooth conditional density model, we derive high-probability bounds on the generated distribution's error and quantify the required number of score evaluations. For every smoothness index $β>0$, a suitable grid yields averaged conditional Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$ relative to the original target with or without early stopping. Both the full and early-stopped samplers attain average target total-variation (TV) error $\widetilde O_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$. Here $n$ is the sample size, $d_x,d_y$ are the data and conditioning dimensions, and errors are averaged over the conditioning variable. The total-variation bound matches the rate established in existing conditional distribution-estimation theory, up to logarithmic factors.
papers.title_cn: 全离散条件扩散模型的有限样本保证
papers.abs_cn: 我们为从数据中学习并以有限去噪步数实现的条件扩散模型建立了有限样本保证。我们的方法将分数训练目标与采样网格对齐，从而能够同时分析统计估计误差和数值离散化误差。在光滑条件密度模型下，我们推导了生成分布误差的高概率界，并量化了所需的分数评估次数。对于每个光滑性指数 $β>0$，一个合适的网格在有无早停的情况下都能得到相对于原始目标的平均条件 Kullback--Leibler (KL) 散度 $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$。完整采样器和早停采样器都达到平均目标全变差 (TV) 误差 $\widetilde O_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$。这里 $n$ 是样本量，$d_x,d_y$ 是数据和条件维度，误差是在条件变量上取平均的。全变差界与现有条件分布估计理论中建立的速率相匹配，直到对数因子。

papers.title: Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design
papers.abstract: Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.
papers.title_cn: 跨支架和表位的推理时引导用于样本高效的从头纳米抗体设计
papers.abs_cn: 生成式分子设计通常依赖于过度生成和事后过滤。像 Feynman-Kac (FK) 引导这样的推理时引导方法通过将轨迹偏向高奖励候选者来提高效率，但它们在单一固定配置内进行优化。在从头纳米抗体设计中，预先承诺条件选择（如支架身份或目标表位）会造成瓶颈。由于不同条件下的产量各不相同，引导没有前景的设置会浪费计算资源。我们将生成条件选择重新表述为推理时资源分配问题。我们提出了两种动态预算分配器：一种联合全局序列蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 公式，可同时跨配置引导和分配计算资源；以及一种采用批处理逐次消除 (BaSE) 的解耦方法。经验上，这些动态分配器将每个 GPU 小时的可设计候选者产量提高了近 5 倍，同时不牺牲不同治疗靶点和生成配置之间的多样性。

papers.title: A Hardware-Native Trapped-Ion Hybrid Qudit-Oscillator Instruction Set
papers.abstract: Scaling trapped-ion processors by adding ions remains challenging. A complementary route exploits the multilevel internal structure of each ion to increase the computational Hilbert space per ion. We introduce a hardware-native hybrid qudit-oscillator instruction set for a general d-level internal register coupled to bosonic modes and prove that three of its native operation families suffice for universality of one qudit coupled to several modes. Adding an entangling operation between ions extends universality to a connected register of several qudits. The architecture natively supports both phase-space and sideband instruction sets and is implemented in the open-source framework HybridLane. As a representative application, we reproduce the dissipative vibronic dynamics of a three-chromophore complex previously simulated on a hybrid qubit-oscillator superconducting platform. Moving from a one-qubit-per-state register to a single qudit stores the entire electronic manifold in one ion, so every electronic coupling becomes a local intra-ion transition and the lab-frame Hamiltonian compiles directly into the ISA. Under the stated sequential timing model from a 40Ca+ qudit processor, one Trotter step is projected to run about ten times faster on the qudit, with an average RMSE of approximately 1.1 percent against the published reference.
papers.title_cn: 一种硬件原生的囚禁离子混合qudit-振子指令集
papers.abs_cn: 通过增加离子来扩展囚禁离子处理器仍然具有挑战性。一种互补的途径利用每个离子的多能级内部结构来增加每个离子的计算希尔伯特空间。我们为耦合到玻色模式的一般d能级内部寄存器引入了一种硬件原生的混合qudit-振子指令集，并证明了其三个原生操作族足以实现一个qudit耦合到多个模式的通用性。在离子之间添加纠缠操作将通用性扩展到多个qudit的连接寄存器。该架构原生支持相空间和边带指令集，并在开源框架HybridLane中实现。作为一个代表性应用，我们重现了先前在混合qubit-振子超导平台上模拟的三发色团复合物的耗散振动动力学。从每个状态一个qubit的寄存器转向单个qudit，将整个电子流形存储在一个离子中，因此每个电子耦合都成为局部的离子内跃迁，实验室坐标系哈密顿量直接编译到ISA中。在来自40Ca+ qudit处理器的所述顺序时序模型下，一个Trotter步骤预计在qudit上运行速度约快十倍，相对于已发表的参考，平均RMSE约为1.1%。

papers.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.
papers.title_cn: 回归开发状态：当完整沙箱快照帮助编码智能体时
papers.abs_cn: 编码智能体在失败前往往已取得有用进展，但从头重试会丢弃沿途创建的机器状态。这使得失败恢复成为一个有趣的搜索问题：如果中间环境状态保留了有意义的进展，那么从这些状态恢复并分支可能比反复从初始状态重启表现更好。我们在完整的 Daytona 快照上实现了 Go-Explore 风格的搜索，发现更高且更高效的解决率主要取决于仓库之外的进展，例如数据库、服务和其他运行时状态。我们的结果表明，当长时程编码工作跨越多个服务、且其状态无法从单个 diff 重建时，完整快照搜索最为有效。

papers.title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
papers.abstract: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.
papers.title_cn: 大规模人工智能漫画研究：PAGE 框架与三项关于美国漫画和日本漫画的研究
papers.abs_cn: 漫画是二十世纪最重要的视觉记录之一：数十万页的漫画中，大众读者看到了他们的领袖、战争和英雄。这一记录的大部分从未被作为一个整体加以研究；漫画研究通常一次只关注一本书。我们认为，人工智能，包括生成模型，可以改变这一状况，并使漫画媒介本身受益。我们提出 PAGE，一个使人工智能成为漫画研究工具的框架。它将每一份扫描件解析为分格、文本和书目记录；使用遵循书面编码手册的视觉-语言模型为每一页添加注释，就像人类编码员所做的那样；将这些阅读的样本建立在人工标注的基础上；并解释整个档案中的变化，同时对出版商和类型进行控制估计。我们在三项研究中，以 3,929 本美国漫画书（1938--1956）和 87 卷日本漫画展示了该框架，每项研究都依赖于不同的能力。第一项研究将文本搜索与视觉阅读相结合，以还原一种大众媒介如何描绘政治权力。第二项研究测量整个行业中页面的视觉形式，并还原个别艺术家的手法。第三项研究追踪两部漫画传统中谁在说话，并与人工标注进行核对。除研究之外，这些工具还可以使档案按所绘制内容进行搜索，让盲人和低视力读者能够接触漫画，并帮助保存脆弱的收藏、为未署名的艺术家正名。我们勾勒了一项研究议程，其中人工智能将加强该媒介的研究、保存和传播。

papers.title: Specialists Learn Faster: Knowledge Organization in Pre-training Shapes Knowledge Update Efficiency
papers.abstract: An ideal (language) model must continually update its knowledge. Existing work largely focuses on making these updates efficient after training. We investigate how the organization of time-varying knowledge during pre-training shapes the efficiency of subsequent updates. Models trained on chronologically ordered knowledge specialize in the most recently encountered knowledge; we call them specialists. In contrast, models trained on the same knowledge in randomly shuffled order perform well across all represented time periods; we call them generalists. Surprisingly, specialists require far fewer update steps than generalists to acquire new knowledge. To explain this advantage, we derive a law from first principles that relates update cost to the model's optimization dynamics and that closely predicts empirical results. Guided by these findings, we design a strategy for organizing pre-training data that preserves stable historical knowledge while enabling efficient updates to current knowledge. We also show that the benefits of temporal knowledge organization extend to real-world pre-trained models and existing knowledge update tools, and generalize to other knowledge orderings. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/
papers.title_cn: 专家学得更快：预训练中的知识组织塑造知识更新效率
papers.abs_cn: 理想的（语言）模型必须持续更新其知识。现有工作主要关注在训练后使这些更新变得高效。我们研究了预训练期间随时间变化的知识的组织方式如何塑造后续更新的效率。按时间顺序组织的知识训练的模型专精于最近遇到的知识；我们称它们为专家。相比之下，在相同知识上以随机打乱顺序训练的模型在所有表示的时间段上表现良好；我们称它们为通才。令人惊讶的是，专家获取新知识所需的更新步骤远少于通才。为了解释这一优势，我们从第一性原理推导出一条定律，将更新成本与模型的优化动态联系起来，并紧密预测了实证结果。在这些发现的指导下，我们设计了一种组织预训练数据的策略，既能保留稳定的历史知识，又能实现对当前知识的高效更新。我们还表明，时间知识组织的好处可扩展到真实世界的预训练模型和现有的知识更新工具，并可推广到其他知识排序。项目页面：https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/

papers.title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.
papers.title_cn: 论连续扩散语言模型的设计空间
papers.abs_cn: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）有望将连续流建模的优势引入语言领域，包括加速采样和可控生成。该领域发展迅速，CDLMs 的能力已开始与离散扩散相媲美。然而，与图像或视频等连续模态不同，我们对训练 CDLMs 时真正重要的关键因素的理解仍然有限。在本工作中，我们聚焦于其中两个关键因素，即自条件和嵌入几何，并揭示其背后的一些机制，进而提出更廉价且更有效的设计。我们首先表明，自条件通过让模型接触训练中原本罕见的类推理状态，修正了训练/推理不匹配的问题。这些收益可以通过一种两级插值方法在不增加额外前向传播的情况下恢复，我们将其命名为 $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$，它将 TinyGSM 准确率提升了两倍以上。自条件还有助于识别被大范数高斯主导的 token——这一问题被称为 token 可识别性。为直接解决该问题，我们向 $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$ 引入离散揭示机制，得到 $\mathrm{SemiCat}$，其在 TinyGSM 上达到离散扩散级别的性能，在使用标准训练超参数和调优采样器时达到 $49.94\%$。在 $1.7$B 规模下，$\mathrm{SemiCat}$ 在六项基于似然的评估中的四项上优于离散扩散，并在无条件生成上超越 one-hot 流。在嵌入空间上，我们发现交叉熵驱动嵌入趋向一种几何结构，其解码错误率与 one-hot 的错误率密切匹配。我们还简要探索了一系列进一步选项，如混合损坏过程和噪声调度，包括异步调度。我们相信这一探索有助于社区更好地理解和推进 CDLMs 的设计空间。

papers.title: OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment. However, existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines with forced alignment and separate feature extractors, limiting their practicality across response settings. In light of this, we propose OpenPA, a novel APA framework that leverages Whisper's cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment. Through mixed-transcript adaptation and adaptive substitution weighting, OpenPA accommodates heterogeneous transcripts across closed- and open-response settings within a single model. Trained solely on speechocean762, OpenPA achieves the strongest overall performance among evaluated systems under in-domain closed and simulated open-response conditions, while maintaining its performance zero-shot on MultiPA. An additional cross-task evaluation on oral-cancer speech suggests its potential applicability beyond non-native speech.
papers.title_cn: OpenPA：无需强制对齐的混合转写自适应多粒度发音评估
papers.abs_cn: 近年来，自动发音评估（APA）的进展推动了从脚本化评估向自由形式评估的转变。然而，现有方法通常依赖带有强制对齐的多阶段流水线和独立的特征提取器，限制了其在不同应答场景中的实用性。鉴于此，我们提出了 OpenPA，一种新颖的 APA 框架，利用 Whisper 的交叉注意力机制，无需强制对齐即可联合预测词级和话语级发音分数。通过混合转写自适应和自适应替换加权，OpenPA 在单一模型中适应了封闭式和开放式应答场景中的异构转写。仅在 speechocean762 上训练，OpenPA 在域内封闭和模拟开放式应答条件下，在评估系统中取得了最强的整体性能，同时在 MultiPA 上保持了零样本性能。对口腔癌语音的额外跨任务评估表明，其潜在适用性可超越非母语语音。

papers.title: Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection
papers.abstract: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.
papers.title_cn: 语言模型能学会何时弃权吗？策略学习与校准的答案选择
papers.abs_cn: 一个有用的语言模型应当知道何时作答、何时说“我不知道”。我们能否通过训练模型本身，或训练一个单独的组件来检查其答案，从而改进这一决策？我们在 Qwen3-14B 上针对事实性问题研究了这两种方法，使用一个对正确答案给予奖励、对错误答案进行惩罚并允许弃权的评分。在三个训练种子和两个留出置信度阈值下，一个学习得到的答案选择器在阈值平均效用上优于原始模型经校准的置信度过滤器。在 TriviaQA 上，平均覆盖率从 20.2% 提升至 30.9%，而在精确匹配评分下，被评分答案中的合并错误率从 23.0% 降至 14.5%。所测试的强化学习改动未能确立一致的增益。在 NQ-Open 上，选择器在阈值平均效用上优于过滤器，但仍不如始终弃权。一项部分人工复核的审计保持了 TriviaQA 的发现。我们的结果支持在此设定下学习选择答案，同时表明跨数据集的可靠弃权仍未解决。

papers.title: Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views
papers.abstract: In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision. While black-box models trained on raw input can outperform models trained on expert views, it remains unclear what predictive signal the raw model exploits beyond what the expert view captures. We introduce an audit framework to quantify this gap using Shared Canonical Component Removal (SCCR). Unlike standard residualization or concept erasure, SCCR selectively removes only those directions strongly shared between learned raw and expert embeddings. Evaluations on synthetic data, coronary artery disease (CAD) detection, antidepressant treatment dropout prediction, and skin lesion classification using SkinCon annotations show that SCCR identifies the ways in which expert views are insufficient and recovers residual predictive signal while minimizing redundancy with the expert view.
papers.title_cn: 超越专家视角的共享规范成分移除
papers.abs_cn: 在临床实践中，专家通常先将原始输入转换为一组专家特征，然后再做出决策。尽管在原始输入上训练的黑盒模型可能优于在专家视角上训练的模型，但原始模型究竟利用了专家视角所捕捉信息之外的哪些预测信号，仍不清楚。我们引入了一个审计框架，使用共享规范成分移除（SCCR）来量化这一差距。与标准的残差化或概念擦除不同，SCCR 仅选择性地移除学习到的原始嵌入与专家嵌入之间强烈共享的那些方向。在合成数据、冠状动脉疾病（CAD）检测、抗抑郁治疗脱落预测以及使用 SkinCon 标注的皮肤病变分类上的评估表明，SCCR 能够识别专家视角不足的方式，并在最小化与专家视角冗余的同时恢复残余预测信号。

papers.title: TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. Simple frozen TFM readouts yield competitive representations, indicating that predictive pretraining already induces substantial dataset-level structure. The two TabMF encoders obtain the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated learned and classical dataset representations, with particularly strong results in dataset retrieval, compact benchmark construction, and distribution-shift severity assessment.
papers.title_cn: TabMF：使用表格基础模型学习数据集表示
papers.abs_cn: 监督数据集的表示支持数据集检索和分布偏移监控等更高层次的机器学习任务。然而，现有方法通常依赖于手工设计的元特征，或专门为表示学习训练的数据集编码器。我们提出了 TabMF，一个将预训练表格基础模型（TFM）重新用作监督数据集编码器的框架。TabMF 为预测性 TFM 配备了一种架构感知的数据集级读出机制，并通过在合成监督数据集的随机视图上进行对比后训练，对模型进行端到端适配。我们在 TabICLv2 和 TabPFN-2.5 上实例化了 TabMF，并在未见过的真实数据集上跨六项任务评估了所得表示。简单的冻结 TFM 读出即可产生有竞争力的表示，表明预测性预训练已经诱导出了大量数据集级结构。在评估的学习型和经典数据集表示中，两个 TabMF 编码器取得了最强的总体性能，在数据集检索、紧凑基准构建和分布偏移严重程度评估方面表现尤为突出。

papers.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $π_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $π_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.
papers.title_cn: 梦想记忆：用世界模型持续引导通用机器人策略
papers.abs_cn: 通用机器人策略通过模仿学习训练，受限于其演示的质量和覆盖范围。强化学习可以改进和扩展它们，方法可以是微调策略权重，也可以是训练一个小模块来引导冻结生成式策略的输入噪声。当任务按顺序到达时，这两种方法都会遭受灾难性遗忘。在某个任务上微调会降低先前任务的性能，而引导只是将遗忘转移到共享的引导模块上。我们提出 Dream to Remember（D2R），它持续地将冻结的通用策略引导到新任务，同时保留其早期技能。当引导模块学习新任务时，一个冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象 rollout 排练先前任务，将模块锚定在其早期行为上，而无需回放缓冲区或新数据。当世界模型足够忠实时，D2R 完全在想象中学习新任务。否则，它在环境中学习任务，同时仅使用世界模型来排练先前任务。在 CALVIN 上，D2R 完全在想象中依次改进八个任务，将平均成功率从 63.7% 提高到 74.8%，而在同一序列上进行 LoRA 微调则将其降至 11.7%。使用冻结的现成通用策略和世界模型 $π_0$ 和 A2World，D2R 在环境中学习未见过的 LIBERO-90 任务，同时保持 $π_0$ 在其微调过的 LIBERO 套件上的性能，即使世界模型不够准确，无法用于策略优化。最后，在真实的 Franka 机器人上，D2R 完全在想象中依次改进三个任务，同时保留早期的改进。

papers.title: A Miniaturized Wi-Fi HaLow-Based Wireless Imaging Transfer System for Capsule Endoscopy
papers.abstract: Wireless capsule endoscopy is constrained by severe limitations in size, available power, and reliable data transmission through biological tissues. Although recent advances in miniature imaging sensors have improved image quality, the wireless transmission of color images at practical frame rates remains a challenging task under the tight capsule constraints. We present the design and the experimental validation of a miniaturized Wireless Imaging Transfer (WIT) system for capsule endoscopy based on a sub-GHz IEEE 802.11ah (Wi-Fi HaLow) wireless link. In addition, a preliminary in-vivo validation of Wi-Fi HaLow communication is reported, showing that a stable through-body wireless link can be established across biological tissues in a clinically relevant porcine model. These in-vivo results provide direct experimental support for the adoption of sub-GHz Wi-Fi HaLow for capsule endoscopy applications. Experimental results demonstrate stable wireless image transmission at a resolution of 320x320 pixels, with measured end-to-end data rates above 12 Mbps and a transmission energy efficiency of 20.7 nJ/bit. We also report a detailed power consumption analysis, with a breakdown of the contributions from the imaging sensor, illumination, digital processing, and RF transmission. When all active subsystem contributions are considered, including the camera, digital processing, RF transmission, and illumination at 60% LED brightness, the total power consumption is approximately 477 mW, corresponding to a complete-chain energy consumption of approximately 39.6 nJ/bit. Overall, the measured performance confirms that sub-GHz Wi-Fi HaLow provides a promising trade-off among throughput, robustness, and energy efficiency for wireless imaging in capsule endoscopy.
papers.title_cn: 一种用于胶囊内窥镜的基于 Wi-Fi HaLow 的小型化无线图像传输系统
papers.abs_cn: 无线胶囊内窥镜在尺寸、可用功率以及通过生物组织的可靠数据传输方面受到严重限制。尽管近年来微型图像传感器的进展提高了图像质量，但在胶囊的严格约束下，以实用帧率进行彩色图像的无线传输仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们提出了一种基于 sub-GHz IEEE 802.11ah（Wi-Fi HaLow）无线链路的用于胶囊内窥镜的小型化无线图像传输（WIT）系统的设计及实验验证。此外，本文还报告了 Wi-Fi HaLow 通信的初步体内验证，表明在临床相关的猪模型中，可以跨越生物组织建立稳定的穿体无线链路。这些体内结果为采用 sub-GHz Wi-Fi HaLow 用于胶囊内窥镜应用提供了直接的实验支持。实验结果表明，在 320x320 像素分辨率下实现了稳定的无线图像传输，测得的端到端数据速率高于 12 Mbps，传输能量效率为 20.7 nJ/bit。我们还报告了详细的功耗分析，并分解了成像传感器、照明、数字处理和 RF 传输各自的贡献。当考虑所有有源子系统的贡献时，包括相机、数字处理、RF 传输以及 60% LED 亮度的照明，总功耗约为 477 mW，对应完整链路的能耗约为 39.6 nJ/bit。总体而言，测得的性能证实，sub-GHz Wi-Fi HaLow 为胶囊内窥镜中的无线成像在吞吐量、鲁棒性和能量效率之间提供了一种有前景的折中方案。

papers.title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
papers.abstract: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.
papers.title_cn: 通过精确高斯条件化跨越扩散与基于流的后验采样
papers.abs_cn: 流匹配和扩散模型越来越多地被用作线性逆问题的先验，然而大多数方法都是针对某一类轨迹先验专门设计的。即插即用方法已被提出，但这些方法隐式地去相关了引导轨迹，导致先验过于宽泛，在数据稀疏时可能表现不佳。本文提出 $β$-Flow：一种通用的即插即用方法，由相关参数 $β$ 索引，可推广到流、扩散和去相关先验，并由置信参数 $κ$ 控制路径分布的约束强度。每一步仅需对去噪网络进行一次前向评估，随后进行高斯条件化步骤。该步骤是精确的 Kalman 更新，不依赖于网络梯度。我们表明，许多现有的引导采样器可以被解释为本文方法的实例或近似，每个采样器隐式地使用不同的轨迹先验和算子来代替 Kalman 增益。从这一视角出发，我们根据各方法的隐式偏差和假设提供了定性比较。我们在 4 个数据集上的 7 个逆问题中，在 PSNR 和 SSIM 方面展示了一致的最先进水平性能。此外，我们展示了这种先验控制的有效性，表明当观测信息较少时，置信的高相关性（严格先验）效果最佳，而当观测信息较多时，低相关性更受青睐，这反映了贝叶斯推断中先验与似然的互补作用。

papers.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
papers.title_cn: QTestBench：一个评估LLM生成量子代码的测试框架
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在经典代码生成方面已展现出强大能力，并越来越多地被用于编写保障代码的单元测试。它们在量子软件上能否做到同样的事尚不明确，因为量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差，并由领域特定的检查器进行判定，因此一个形式良好的测试仍可能与基准的判定结果不一致。现有的量子基准衡量模型是否产生正确解，但不衡量其测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现。我们提出QTestBench，一个将LLM生成的量子测试套件与独立基准检查器进行对比评估的框架，绝不将测试本身视为真值。对于每个任务，QTestBench提示模型生成语法、语义和行为测试，在运行时注入候选解，并在三个验证队列下将每个测试的判定与检查器的标签进行比较，每个队列回答一个不同的诊断问题。我们在八个PennyLane QHack挑战和十个Qiskit HumanEval任务上对五个LLM进行了基准测试。生成的测试套件几乎总能执行，但区分能力滞后：最佳生成器在QHack上达到0.71的测试质量，在Qiskit HumanEval上为0.34，因此仅可执行性会高估测试质量。当自然错误解稀缺时——如十个Qiskit任务中有三个未产生任何错误解——经oracle验证的合成变异体可稳定缺陷检测估计。QTestBench为LLM生成的量子测试的可信度提供了一个可复现的跨框架基准。

papers.title: Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.
papers.title_cn: 通过子序列关联过滤与广度感知选择追踪和驯服LLM查询扩展中的幻觉词项
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）现已成为查询扩展词项的标准来源，但它们会产生幻觉。它们注入不存在的实体和偏离主题的词项，增加排序噪声，并可能损害强检索器的性能。现有补救措施如语料库接地、相互验证和偏好对齐，将幻觉词项视为无差别的干扰项，通过一致性启发式方法进行过滤，而没有对给定词项为何出现的机制性解释，也没有关于保留多少词项的原则性标准。我们提出子序列关联过滤的广度感知查询扩展（SAFE-QE），这是一种无需训练、与检索器无关的方法，基于幻觉的子序列关联解释。我们通过语料库条件下的跨上下文可复现性对每个候选扩展词项进行评分，那些在随机查询上下文中重新出现但在伪相关集中缺乏支持的词项被标记为主导幻觉关联的产物并被降权。借鉴将语言生成刻画为一致性（无幻觉）与广度（覆盖度）之间权衡的观点，我们将词项选择转化为伪相关集上的约束覆盖最大化问题，保留一个近似广泛但在重采样中保持一致和稳定的集合。我们还引入了幻觉扩展词项率，这是一种查询侧忠实度指标，用于计数没有相关文档支持的注入扩展词项。我们在基准TREC和BEIR集合上评估我们的方法。我们的SAFE-QE在nDCG@10上与生成式和语料库引导的扩展在统计上不可区分，同时注入的不支持词项更少——每查询4.3个，而Query2doc为27.8个，HyDE为57.5个——并且在强学习稀疏检索器上，所有扩展方法均出现性能退化。因此，忠实度可以在排序质量上没有可测量代价的情况下实现。

papers.title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
papers.abstract: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion. We apply Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a model fusion framework that selects and combines multiple scoring systems using rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD), to a pool of 29 architecturally diverse classical models and quantum circuits. Using a diversity-aware model selection method, we identify subsets of maximally diverse models and combine them with both score and rank combination. Experiments on four binary classification benchmarks covering different domains demonstrate that CFA-based hybrid classical-quantum fusion consistently outperform the best individual model on every dataset considered with improvements up to 6.03% in accuracy. When comparing with relevant literatures, the CFA framework further achieves superior performance across all four datasets.
papers.title_cn: 通过组合融合实现多样性感知的量子-经典模型集成
papers.abs_cn: 变分量子电路（VQC）对电路架构高度敏感，然而大多数量子机器学习流程只选择单一最佳设计，并丢弃其余候选方案。本文研究是否可以利用量子电路搜索空间中的结构多样性，通过模型融合产生更强的预测。我们将组合融合分析（CFA）——一种使用排名-得分函数（RSF）和认知多样性（CD）来选择并组合多个评分系统的模型融合框架——应用于一个包含29个架构多样化的经典模型和量子电路的模型池。使用多样性感知的模型选择方法，我们识别出最大多样性模型的子集，并通过得分组合和排名组合将它们结合起来。在覆盖不同领域的四个二分类基准上的实验表明，基于CFA的经典-量子混合融合在所考虑的每个数据集上都始终优于最佳单个模型，准确率提升最高达6.03%。与相关文献比较时，CFA框架在所有四个数据集上进一步取得了更优的性能。

papers.title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
papers.abstract: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.
papers.title_cn: 错误率还不够：低资源ASR中数据增强的代价
papers.abs_cn: 数据增强是低资源自动语音识别（ASR）的标准做法，但其收益几乎总是以总体错误率来报告，这使得人们不清楚一种方法为何以及在何时有帮助。在四种低资源语言和英语上，跨越五种数据规模，我们将两种修改现有音频的增强方法（速度扰动和SpecAugment）与两种修改文本转录并据此合成音频的方法进行交叉组合。我们在音素层面分析错误，发现它们有帮助的原因互为补充。SpecAugment具有最可靠的总体改进，但会增加声调和腭化错误，而基于文本的方法会引入辅音插入；两者结合时，各自都能减少对方引入的错误。这种互补性是可预测的。声调和腭化各自仅由单一声学属性标示，并且在训练中出现频率最低（训练暴露最少），而基于文本的方法压平词频分布后，将其频率提高了37--38%，从而逆转了这些错误，同时进一步改善了总体错误率。组合方法带来的改进超过各自单独改进之和；这种超加性在100小时后消失，将互补性限制在低资源场景中。在特定错误类型重要的场合，我们建议根据训练暴露和声学属性来选择增强方法，这两者都可以在任何训练之前测量。

papers.title: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.
papers.title_cn: FORTE：工业推荐系统中特征评估与废弃的生产框架
papers.abs_cn: 生产推荐系统存在特征生命周期的不对称性：添加新特征必须在某个指标上产生增益，而移除特征则不得使任何指标回退。在实践中，特征废弃难以优先处理，因为如果一个特征与其他特征存在交互、其重要性每日变化、在生产模型变化或数据漂移发生之前无法评估、与其他上线项目争夺 A/B 测试空间、在线 A/B 测试中导致回退，或者被多个需要协调其废弃的模型所消费，那么该特征可能无法被移除。我们提出 FORTE，一个模型无关的生产框架，用于发现、验证和移除特征。其高效的扰动实现允许每日特征评估。为了考虑交互作用，它通过分组消融评估由所有低秩特征构建的候选特征集，其离线结果对在线 A/B 测试具有足够的预测能力，从而可以放心地将废弃推进到在线测试。血缘追踪识别所有下游消费模型，以实现从训练集中移除特征的完整节省。我们在 2 个大规模推荐系统上验证了 FORTE，发现它能识别出不会导致在线回退的可废弃特征集，而对效率的影响取决于模型特性。在一个搜索相关性模型上，FORTE 产生了 3 个嵌套候选集，分别包含 32、48 和 59 个特征。在线护栏拒绝了最大的处理组。48 特征集被选中进行废弃，移除了模型 43.3% 的特征。在一个大型排序模型上，FORTE 识别出 8 个可移除候选。重新训练和 A/B 测试确认没有回退。其上线使可训练参数减少了 29.9%，服务吞吐量提高了 19.8-25.5%，并将年度训练成本降低了数十万美元。

papers.title: Constrained Probabilistic Numerics: Gaussian Process Solvers for Linear PDEs under Linear Inequality Constraints
papers.abstract: Gaussian process solvers for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) return posteriors rather than point estimates, but they condition only on equality information: the PDE residual, boundary data, and measurements. Many solutions of interest also obey inequality constraints, including nonnegativity, monotonicity, and absence of arbitrage, which equality conditioning cannot enforce.
