We prove that conditioning a Gaussian process prior jointly on linear equality observations and a finite-dimensional inequality event is equivalent to conditioning sequentially in terms of Borel measures on the solution space. The physics-informed posterior is therefore a valid prior for the inequality update at virtual points. The combined law is non-Gaussian yet computable through truncated-Gaussian moments, and neither the PDE conditioning nor the inequality update requires modification. We evaluated the construction on a Poisson benchmark, option-price surfaces, and air-quality fields. Under incomplete boundary data, a monotonicity constraint lowered the error of a two-dimensional Poisson reconstruction by $63\%$. On a real S&P 500 option chain thinned to $20$ retained quotes, no-arbitrage constraints reduced held-out extrapolation error by $22\%$ and cut the calendar-arbitrage rate from $10\%$ to $1\%$. On four real air-quality snapshots, nonnegativity reduced a Gaussian moment-based sub-zero-tail proxy by $74\%$ at the sparsest monitor count. Changes in mean accuracy and constraint diagnostics differed across data regimes. The probability of the noisy virtual constraint event under the equality posterior measures agreement with the specified bounds before the update. The construction turns admissibility from a post-processing step into conditioning information for probabilistic PDE solvers.
papers.title_cn: 约束概率数值方法：线性不等式约束下线性偏微分方程的高斯过程求解器
papers.abs_cn: 用于线性偏微分方程（PDE）的高斯过程求解器返回的是后验分布而非点估计，但它们仅以等式信息为条件：PDE 残差、边界数据和观测值。许多有意义的解还服从不等式约束，包括非负性、单调性和无套利条件，而这些是等式条件化无法施加的。我们证明，将高斯过程先验同时以线性等式观测和有限维不等式事件为条件，等价于在解空间上按 Borel 测度顺序条件化。因此，物理信息后验是在虚拟点处进行不等式更新的有效先验。组合后的分布是非高斯的，但可通过截断高斯矩进行计算，且 PDE 条件化和不等式更新均无需修改。我们在 Poisson 基准问题、期权价格曲面和空气质量场上评估了该构造。在边界数据不完整的情况下，单调性约束将二维 Poisson 重建的误差降低了 $63\%$。在精简至 $20$ 个保留报价的真实 S&P 500 期权链上，无套利约束将留出外推误差降低了 $22\%$，并将日历套利率从 $10\%$ 降至 $1\%$。在四个真实空气质量快照上，非负性在最稀疏监测点数量下将基于高斯矩的负尾代理指标降低了 $74\%$。平均精度和约束诊断的变化在不同数据情形下有所不同。等式后验下含噪虚拟约束事件的概率度量了更新前与指定边界的吻合程度。该构造将可容许性从后处理步骤转变为概率 PDE 求解器的条件化信息。

papers.title: Adaptive Variance Reduction without Knowing Oracle Smoothness
papers.abstract: Variance reduction improves the convergence rate of stochastic non-convex optimization under the average smoothness condition. Existing adaptive variance reduction methods are especially designed for average smoothness and do not adapt to standard smoothness. In this paper, we study how one algorithm can adapt to these two settings and the noiseless setting without knowing the smoothness constants or the variance bound. Given the gradient budget $T$, we develop a two-phase method. The first phase compares two independent gradients and switches to normalized momentum when their difference exceeds a threshold. This phase provides both a candidate with standard smooth and noiseless guarantees and also ensures a bounded expected function gap for the second variance reduction phase. The resulting rates are $O(T^{-1/3})$ under average smoothness, $O(T^{-1/4})$ under standard smoothness, and $O(T^{-1/2})$ without noise. When $T$ is unknown, we propose a method with two paths that attain the corresponding rates with logarithmic factors in the stochastic settings. Here, we use a variance reduction path to deal with average smoothness and employ the AdaGrad-Norm for standard smoothness and noiseless setting. Neither method restarts from the initial point or requires a growing number of oracle calls in each round.
papers.title_cn: 在未知Oracle光滑性的情况下的自适应方差缩减
papers.abs_cn: 方差缩减在平均光滑性条件下提高了随机非凸优化的收敛速度。现有的自适应方差缩减方法专门针对平均光滑性设计，无法适应标准光滑性。本文研究一种算法如何在不知道光滑性常数或方差界的情况下，同时适应这两种设定以及无噪声设定。给定梯度预算 $T$，我们提出一种两阶段方法。第一阶段比较两个独立梯度，当它们的差超过阈值时切换到归一化动量。该阶段既提供了一个具有标准光滑和无噪声保证的候选解，也确保了第二阶段方差缩减的有界期望函数间隙。所得收敛速率在平均光滑性下为 $O(T^{-1/3})$，在标准光滑性下为 $O(T^{-1/4})$，在无噪声情况下为 $O(T^{-1/2})$。当 $T$ 未知时，我们提出一种具有两条路径的方法，在随机设定下以对数因子达到相应速率。其中，我们使用一条方差缩减路径来处理平均光滑性，并对标准光滑性和无噪声设定采用 AdaGrad-Norm。这两种方法都不从初始点重新开始，也不要求每轮Oracle调用次数递增。

papers.title: REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality
papers.abstract: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.
papers.title_cn: REFLECT：角色感知的 sentiment、emotion、礼貌与正式度检测
papers.abs_cn: 在对话中检测交际意义，不仅需要对词汇内容建模，还需要对 sentiment、emotion、礼貌与正式度（SEPF）得以表达的参与者角色结构进行建模。现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，却将语义角色留作隐式信息。我们引入一种角色感知的 transformer 架构，将四个 SEPF 维度映射到有理论基础的 Semantic Role Labeling（SRL）配置，并将这些配置直接纳入 transformer 的自注意力机制。角色感知注意力对非方向性的内部状态（sentiment 和 emotion）建模，而方向性角色感知注意力则为外部线索（礼貌和正式度）捕捉发起者到接受者的关系。由此得到的角色感知表示通过一个学习门控与上下文嵌入融合，该门控自适应地加权每个输入对角色信息的贡献，而不是将语义角色作为辅助特征向量附加。在四个基准数据集上，该框架在 emotion、礼貌和正式度方面相较强 BERT 基线取得了统计上可靠的提升，且提升集中在理论预测的情形，如低频、复杂 emotion 和高度礼貌表达；sentiment 的改进边际且不显著，表明 sentiment 更多通过词汇选择而非参与者角色结构传达。在真实世界数据上的额外评估表明，该框架同时提升了预测性能和模型可追溯性。这些结果表明，对 transformer 自注意力进行有语言学依据的修改，能够改进交际意义的检测，从基准数据集泛化到真实世界心理健康数据，并产生可追溯、以角色为依据的解释，从而将价值从预测性能扩展到可解释性。

papers.title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
papers.abstract: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.
papers.title_cn: 不仅仅是评估：语言模型中话语助词敏感性的案例研究
papers.abs_cn: 话语助词通过反映会话语境和对话者态度来微妙地塑造话语流，通常不影响真值条件意义。它们也常常是多功能的，具有与其他助词部分重叠的不同含义；例如，英语中"just"和"only"的排他性用法（"John only/just drinks water"）。尽管这些词在自然语言中频繁出现，但由于其效果的微妙性，它们在很大程度上未被研究。我们使用行为分析和机制分析来研究LLM在自然对话中对"just"和"only"的敏感性。首先，我们发现LLM和人类同样偏好这些助词在语境中的出现，并且两者对"just"比"only"更敏感。其次，当从有和没有这些助词的LLM中采样时，我们发现LLM一致地将其生成的文本评为在其源语境下更可能，展示了它们的助词敏感性。在两个实验中，指令微调都增加了敏感性。最后，我们定位了LLM中对助词敏感的单位，发现"just"和"only"之间的重叠是不对称的："only"单位选择性地迁移到排他性"just"，而所有"just"单位无论含义如何都同样好地迁移到"only"，表明LLM词汇层面的助词表征部分按含义组织。我们在https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation发布了我们的代码、含义标注的对话刺激和人类偏好标注。

papers.title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
papers.abstract: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.
papers.title_cn: OccludeBench：VLM 能否找到缺失之物？
papers.abs_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在推理图像中缺失内容方面的能力如何？我们通过 OccludeBench 研究这一问题，这是一个人工精心构建的基准，用于从残留的视觉证据中恢复被完全遮挡的物体。OccludeBench 区分直接情形与推理情形：前者中隐藏物体必须依据特定物理线索（如阴影或反射）来恢复，后者中则可由更广泛的场景上下文推断。在五个 VLM 上，直接情形的准确率平均为 42.7%，而推理情形为 62.7%，呈现出 20.0 个百分点的差距。人类在直接图像和推理图像上的准确率分别为 63.4% 和 68.5%，更高且无显著差距。为定位这一失败，我们引入 OccludeTrace，一个四阶段诊断方法，用于分离视觉推理过程在何处出现断裂。瓶颈出现在模型必须从完整图像中的投影恢复相关物体时：它们在失败样例中仅有 50% 成功，而在正确回答的样例中成功率为 91%。扩展推理、工具使用和少样本提示带来的提升并不一致，也无法可靠地消除这一差距。相比之下，一种先修复再对照的干预方法，即提示模型首先生成一个候选隐藏物体，然后依据可见物理线索评估该假设，对于两个具备图像生成能力的模型，将差距缩小到统计上不显著的程度。总之，我们的结果建立了一个可处理、受控的诊断方法，用于分离 VLM 如何推理图像中缺失的视觉内容。

papers.title: Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors
papers.abstract: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. An online diagonal predictor admits a regret-to-convergence guarantee. At approximately equal oracle cost, querying a quarter of the corrections lowers the final training loss by $18$ to $43\%$ on MNIST1D and raises the test accuracy of Hessian-vector transport on CIFAR-10 by $1.5$ points.
papers.title_cn: 随机动量传输与廉价预测器
papers.abs_cn: STORM 和二阶动量等动量方法通过向动量添加传输校正来跟踪梯度，代价是每次迭代需要额外一次 oracle 调用。我们引入随机动量传输，以概率 $q$ 评估校正，否则使用廉价预测，并通过重要性加权保持条件均值，同时将预测损失的 $(q^{-1}-1)$ 倍加入方差。在传输偏差、二阶矩和残差控制假设下，线性最小化 oracle（LMO）更新，包括归一化、符号和精确谱（Muon）方向，在单梯度初始化下对每个固定的 $q>0$ 保持 $O(T^{-1/3})$ 的平稳性界。对于未归一化的 STORM，当且仅当梯度差噪声模超过光滑常数时，某个 $q<1$ 会降低我们充分梯度预算的首项系数，降幅至多约 $10\%$。在线对角预测器具有遗憾到收敛的保证。在近似相等的 oracle 成本下，查询四分之一的校正使 MNIST1D 上的最终训练损失降低 $18$ 到 $43\%$，并使 CIFAR-10 上 Hessian 向量传输的测试准确率提高 $1.5$ 个百分点。

papers.title: Optimal Algorithms for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Constraints
papers.abstract: We present new algorithms for stochastic optimization problems in which the objective is neither smooth nor convex, subject to a convex constraint set. Our algorithms return a $(δ,\varepsilon)$-Goldstein stationary point, as recently defined for constrained problems by Liu et al. (2024), with improved complexities, and are the first to achieve optimal convergence rates for this task in several settings. In particular, we design projection-based and projection-free algorithms that achieve a $\widetilde O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using stochastic gradients, which we show to be optimal, and a $\widetilde O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using zeroth-order queries, which is also optimal in its dependence on the dimension $d$ and improves over prior work. Notably, our lower bound is given in terms of the Frank-Wolfe gap and holds even for smooth problems, which is of independent interest. These results show that in nonconvex stochastic optimization, the convergence rate is degraded neither by the presence of constraints nor by nonsmoothness. Our analysis is based on a reduction to online linear optimization, extending a related technique from unconstrained optimization.
papers.title_cn: 带约束的非光滑非凸随机优化的最优算法
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了用于随机优化问题的新算法，其中目标函数既非光滑也非凸，且受凸约束集约束。我们的算法返回一个 $(δ,\varepsilon)$-Goldstein 稳定点（由 Liu et al. (2024) 最近为约束问题定义），具有改进的复杂度，并且是首个在多种设定下为该任务达到最优收敛速率的算法。特别地，我们设计了基于投影和无投影的算法，使用随机梯度达到 $\widetilde O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的速率，我们证明该速率是最优的；以及使用零阶查询达到 $\widetilde O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的速率，该速率在维度 $d$ 的依赖上也是最优的，并改进了先前的工作。值得注意的是，我们的下界以 Frank-Wolfe gap 给出，即使对于光滑问题也成立，这具有独立的研究价值。这些结果表明，在非凸随机优化中，收敛速率既不会因约束的存在而退化，也不会因非光滑性而退化。我们的分析基于归约到在线线性优化，扩展了无约束优化中的相关技术。

papers.title: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
papers.abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.
papers.title_cn: 你的离散图扩散模型正在秘密记忆
papers.abs_cn: 离散图扩散模型（GDM）通过在马可夫噪声模型下向节点和边独立添加噪声来破坏图结构。在无节点特征的无条件设置中，在单个图上训练得到的等变去噪器能够生成新图，且边重叠率和 WL 核相似度等样本级指标未发现记忆的证据。在本工作中，我们挑战这一观点，并首次表明图扩散模型确实表现出记忆现象。通过分析在两个块随机块模型（SBM）上训练的 GDM 的反向扩散轨迹，我们发现存在强烈的训练数据偏差：与留出的测试图相比，模型几乎完美地恢复了被破坏的训练图。我们将其称为条件记忆，因为它仅在反向轨迹以被破坏的训练图为条件时显现，而在推理过程中并不明显。它与不断扩大的泛化差距同时出现，即训练损失改善的同时留出图上的损失却在恶化，且无法通过早停来缓解。记忆的出现总是先于生成图中社区结构的出现，因此此前每一个检查点都会生成无结构的图。在我们测试的所有节点规模下，这一行为都成立。

papers.title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
papers.abstract: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.
papers.title_cn: UkrMeme：乌克兰模因中的多模态可解释说服检测
papers.abs_cn: 模因在现代在线交流中扮演着核心角色，尤其是在政治冲突语境中，视觉和文本线索相结合以传达说服性信息。我们使用视觉语言模型（VLM）研究乌克兰模因中的说服技巧检测。我们引入了 UkrMeme，这是一个包含 200 个自然产生的乌克兰战时模因的数据集，并标注了说服技巧；同时引入了 PTM-UA，这是 Propaganda 950 基准子集的乌克兰语翻译版本，在翻译模因文本的同时保留了原始视觉内容。我们在零样本提示设置下，使用分层 F1 指标评估 VLM 在图像、文本和多模态输入上的表现。最后，我们比较了逐层相关性传播（LRP）和模型生成的 token 归因，并分析了每种解释方法所强调的证据语义类别。

papers.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
papers.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
papers.title_cn: ReplaySSM：缓存 SSM 输入，而非状态
papers.abs_cn: 状态空间模型（SSM）维护固定大小的循环状态，但在每个解码步骤读写该状态会成为混合模型的瓶颈。这种即时状态管理导致大量状态 I/O 且算术强度低，使投机解码无法廉价回滚，并将状态量化误差引入后续循环更新。我们提出 ReplaySSM，它展开循环，将状态表示为检查点和近期 SSM 输入的缓冲区。这将输出计算与检查点更新分离。通过定期更新检查点，ReplaySSM 在大多数步骤上避免了状态写入，并将主要的状态内存流量大致减半。保留近期输入还使投机回滚成为缓冲区指针操作，并支持仅输出验证而无需物化中间状态。同样的分离允许低精度检查点在大多数步骤上服务于输出计算，而高精度检查点服务于循环更新，因此低精度副本中的舍入误差永远不会进入后续更新。我们在 vLLM 中为 Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet 实现了 ReplaySSM。在服务批量大小为 256 时，它在四个混合模型上比调优后的 vLLM 基线加速标准解码 $1.20$--$1.47\times$，并在两个 120B 级模型上提供约 $1.8\times$ 于 vLLM 投机解码的吞吐量。与共享低精度检查点相比，分离状态精度还降低了输出 KL 散度和下游精度损失。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Multi-Objective Optimization: Norm-Constrained Oracles with Entropic Weight Updates
papers.abstract: Multiple-gradient descent is typically formulated in Euclidean geometry, whereas matrix-aware optimizers use directions induced by other norms. We analyze a single-loop multi-objective method combining a norm-constrained linear minimization oracle with entropic updates of task weights. For any finite-dimensional norm pair, we establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ ergodic stationarity rate in the deterministic setting, deriving the required trajectory gradient bound from smoothness and lower-boundedness in the unregularized case. With stochastic gradients and a bounded-gradient assumption, one persistent blended-gradient momentum buffer yields an $O(T^{-1/4})$ rate whose leading term has no explicit dependence on the number of tasks. We also establish static regret for the inner weighting objective on arbitrary bounded gradient sequences and, with entropy regularization and a weight floor, iteration-wise inner-gap control after burn-in while retaining ergodic stationarity, conditional on a trajectory gradient bound. The optimal blended gradient can be nonunique in spectral and sign geometries, motivating a selection-independent inner gap. Our analysis extends the spectral construction studied by concurrent MOON to general norms. Experiments compare the method with existing multi-task optimizers and examine its oracle, weighting, and momentum choices.
papers.title_cn: 几何感知的多目标优化：范数约束的预言机与熵权更新
papers.abs_cn: 多梯度下降通常是在欧几里得几何中表述的，而矩阵感知优化器则使用由其他范数诱导的方向。我们分析了一种单循环多目标方法，该方法将范数约束的线性最小化预言机与任务权重的熵更新相结合。对于任意有限维范数对，我们在确定性设定下建立了 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的遍历平稳性速率，并在无正则化情形下从光滑性和下界性推导出所需的轨迹梯度界。在随机梯度和有界梯度假设下，一个持续混合梯度动量缓冲区可产生 $O(T^{-1/4})$ 的速率，其主导项不显式依赖于任务数量。我们还针对任意有界梯度序列建立了内层加权目标的静态遗憾，并且在熵正则化和权重下限的条件下，在预热后实现了逐迭代的内层间隙控制，同时保持遍历平稳性，这以轨迹梯度界为条件。最优混合梯度在谱几何和符号几何中可能不唯一，这促使我们采用与选择无关的内层间隙。我们的分析将并发 MOON 所研究的谱构造推广到一般范数。实验将该方法与现有多任务优化器进行比较，并考察其预言机、加权和动量选择。

papers.title: From Pixels to Privacy-Sensitive Features: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Reconstruction Bounds
papers.abstract: What can an adversary recover from a model trained with DP-SGD? Its $(\varepsilon,δ)$ guarantee does not answer this question directly. We derive a distortion bound that can be computed before training and applies even to an adversary who observes the parameter trajectory during training, knows every other training record and the population distribution from which the training records are drawn. The analyst may choose the representation in which error is measured, allowing the bound to target the aspects of reconstruction that are privacy-sensitive in a given application. Our information-theoretic framework separates two contributions: the information about a record revealed by training, measured through conditional mutual information, and the uncertainty already present in the data distribution, measured through source entropy. Rate-distortion theory combines them into a lower bound on the expected error of every reconstruction attack. For DP-SGD, the leakage bound depends only on the sampling rates and noise multipliers, while the source entropy is lower-bounded from a sample with finite-sample confidence. An orthogonal block construction keeps the resulting bound informative for high-dimensional images. We instantiate the framework in pixel space and in LPIPS feature space, obtaining, to our knowledge, the first lower bound on reconstruction distortion measured directly by LPIPS. On a range of image datasets the bounds establish non-trivial unavoidable expected reconstruction error within heuristically recommended privacy-budget ranges and beyond. Experiments compare the bounds with strong reconstruction attacks and identify the principal sources of the remaining slack.
papers.title_cn: 从像素到隐私敏感特征：一个用于重建界限的信息论框架
papers.abs_cn: 对手能从使用 DP-SGD 训练的模型中恢复出什么？其 (epsilon, delta) 保证并不能直接回答这个问题。我们推导出一个可在训练前计算的失真界限，该界限甚至适用于这样的对手：他观察训练过程中的参数轨迹，知道所有其他训练记录以及训练记录所来自的总体分布。分析者可以选择测量误差的表示，从而使该界限针对特定应用中隐私敏感的重建方面。我们的信息论框架分离出两种贡献：训练所揭示的关于某条记录的信息，通过条件互信息度量；以及数据分布中已经存在的不确定性，通过源熵度量。率失真理论将二者结合为对每一种重建攻击的期望误差的下界。对于 DP-SGD，泄漏界限仅取决于采样率和噪声乘数，而源熵则从样本中以有限样本置信度给出下界。一种正交块构造使所得界限在高维图像上仍具有信息量。我们在像素空间和 LPIPS 特征空间中实例化该框架，据我们所知，得到了第一个直接由 LPIPS 测量的重建失真下界。在一系列图像数据集上，这些界限在启发式推荐的隐私预算范围内及之外，确立了非平凡且不可避免的期望重建误差。实验将这些界限与强重建攻击进行比较，并识别出剩余松弛的主要来源。

papers.title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
papers.abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.
papers.title_cn: DualQuant：面向LLM的双尺度免校准权重与激活量化
papers.abs_cn: 在原生支持4-bit的加速器上进行低比特推理，需要对权重和激活都进行量化，才能充分实现这些格式带来的吞吐量收益。虽然训练后权重量化已被广泛研究，但激活量化仍然困难得多，通常需要校准数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了DUALQUANT，一个双尺度、免校准的训练后量化框架，它直接最小化权重重建均方误差（MSE），并作为直接副产物，在激活量化之前产生逐通道的激活重缩放。我们的关键观察是，通过最小化权重重建误差得到的缩放因子能够提供有效的激活重缩放，从而无需校准数据即可实现有竞争力的激活量化。我们将DUALQUANT形式化为一个不可微的权重重建问题，并开发了一种基于变量分裂和块坐标下降的高效求解器，其中每个子问题都有闭式更新。DUALQUANT提供了一种统一算法，支持广泛的格式，包括完整的MX系列和NVFP4。据我们所知，DUALQUANT是首个正式支持MX和NV块格式的双尺度方法。在WikiText-2、C4和零样本下游任务上评估的Llama和Qwen模型中，DUALQUANT在大多数模型和格式上达到或超过了基于校准的SmoothQuant的准确率，并显著优于免校准基线，在MX和NV块格式上提升尤为明显。我们在RTX 4090上通过Llama-3.1-8B的真实打包W4A4推理路径验证了这些收益。所得实现与伪量化的准确率非常接近，同时相比BF16可实现最高2.61倍的内存减少和最高2.46倍的吞吐量加速。

papers.title: Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment
papers.abstract: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only features on BRIGHT. Shuffling image pairs within the same disaster and damage class causes modest losses. Motivated by these findings, we test whether feature transformations learned only from training disasters improve generalization to unseen disasters. These transformations improve performance, with supervised contrastive learning performing best on xView2 and PCA on BRIGHT. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation on unseen domains for assessing model robustness and show that simple feature-level transformations can improve generalization. Code and experiments can be found at https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning.
papers.title_cn: 地理空间基础模型嵌入在跨灾害损害评估中的捷径学习
papers.abs_cn: 地理空间基础模型可以支持灾害损害评估，但在熟悉灾害上的高准确率可能掩盖了捷径学习：即预测来自事件或场景特征，而非可迁移到新灾害的证据。我们研究了 TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA 和 DINOv3 在 multi-disaster 数据集 xView2 和 BRIGHT 上的嵌入。留出整个灾害而非随机划分图像块，使 xView2 上的平均平衡准确率从 0.807 降至 0.638，BRIGHT 上从 0.818 降至 0.568。四组测试考察了支持预测的信息：事件与采集上下文、灾前/灾后图像输入、建筑数量和正确的图像配对。灾前图像仍具有预测性，仅给定标注建筑数量的分类器达到 0.629 和 0.653 的平衡准确率。在 xView2 上，结合灾前/灾后特征平均表现最佳，但在 BRIGHT 上并未优于仅使用灾前特征。在同一灾害和损害类别内打乱图像配对会造成适度损失。受这些发现启发，我们测试了仅从训练灾害中学习到的特征变换是否能提升对未见灾害的泛化能力。这些变换提升了性能，其中监督对比学习在 xView2 上表现最佳，PCA 在 BRIGHT 上表现最佳。我们的结果凸显了在未见域上评估对于衡量模型鲁棒性的重要性，并表明简单的特征级变换可以提升泛化能力。代码和实验见 https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning。

papers.title: When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors
papers.abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.
papers.title_cn: 当边独立性失效时：具有潜在社交性先验的联合图扩散
papers.abs_cn: 离散图扩散模型通过独立边更新与马尔可夫噪声模型来破坏图结构。结合输出分布的可交换性要求，终端先验必然是 Erdős--Rényi (E-R) 随机图。这对无节点特征的无条件图生成具有根本性影响：在大图极限下，任何应用于 E-R 图的 GNN 去噪器近似输出 E-R 图，使得有效去噪变得困难。实践中，生成的图无法恢复有意义的节点异质性和高阶结构。先前模型引入专门的节点特征来补偿，将此视为表达力问题，而先验的作用则未被审视。我们转而通过引入潜在社交性先验 (LSP) 和联合扩散过程来解决根本原因，该过程使潜在节点社交性变量与图结构共同演化，在保持可交换性的同时消除边独立性。与现有潜在图扩散方法不同，社交性机制不需要复杂的编码器：其唯一作用是引导边更新并在整个轨迹中保持节点异质性。我们在多个图生成数据集上验证了我们的方法，并表明所提出的框架比无节点特征的基线方法更准确地捕捉图分布。

papers.title: How Well Do Prior-Data Fitted Networks Amortize Bayesian Inference?
papers.abstract: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) of a synthetic prior, yet results about the approximation quality are surprisingly thin. Taking an empirical risk minimization perspective, we decompose the deployment error of PFNs into prior, context, and amortization error, and measure the latter against a reference PPD under a realistic prior. Results show that PFNs generally recover the targeted PPD very well. Nevertheless, we find that parts of the residual amortization error persist, especially in \textit{rare} settings under the prior pretraining distribution, even when scaling the model size, which manifests in disagreement between independently pretrained PFNs and leaves uncertainty about the predictor at inference time. As a remedy, we study multiple types of Bayesian model averages and find that these can consistently reduce this uncertainty and improve predictions up to full-size TabICLv2 models.
papers.title_cn: 先验数据拟合网络对贝叶斯推断的摊销效果如何？
papers.abs_cn: 先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）被训练用于近似合成先验的贝叶斯后验预测分布（PPD），然而关于其近似质量的结果却出奇地少。从经验风险最小化的视角出发，我们将 PFNs 的部署误差分解为先验误差、上下文误差和摊销误差，并在一个现实的先验下针对参考 PPD 测量摊销误差。结果表明，PFNs 总体上能够很好地恢复目标 PPD。尽管如此，我们发现部分残差摊销误差仍然存在，尤其是在先验预训练分布下的稀有设置中，即使扩大模型规模也是如此，这表现为独立预训练的 PFNs 之间的不一致，并在推理时对预测器留下不确定性。作为补救措施，我们研究了多种类型的贝叶斯模型平均，并发现这些方法能够持续减少这种不确定性，并将预测性能提升至完整规模的 TabICLv2 模型。

papers.title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.abstract: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.
papers.title_cn: 面向LLM智能体训练的匹配上下文组策略优化
papers.abs_cn: 训练长时程语言模型智能体需要从稀疏的终端反馈中为中间决策分配信用。在有限的一组同级 rollout 中，有用的动作比较取决于其上下文、两种备选方案的证据，以及该证据如何进入学习。我们提出匹配上下文组策略优化（MCGPO），一种从已收集轨迹中构建加权动作偏好的方法。MCGPO 使用动作前状态摘要和观察到的评分标准进展来定义比较上下文，并由任务规则进行标注。双动作支持在有序的精确匹配和粗粒度匹配规则之间进行选择。固定折叠将候选决策与用于定向其偏好的终端结果分开，而依赖于支持的证据权重在共享的 GraphGPO 任务学习之外，对辅助成对目标进行缩放。MCGPO 重用 rollout 数据和每个响应的原始历史，保持无评论家训练。在六个环境-骨干设置（每个设置三个训练种子）中，MCGPO 相比匹配的 GraphGPO 提高了平均成功率：在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 7B 时提高了 0.47-1.46 个百分点；在 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 8B 时分别提高了 3.96 和 5.16 个百分点。ALFWorld 的增益建立在基线成功率超过 92% 的基础上，此时剩余提升空间有限。在四个 Qwen2.5 设置中，有三个设置的集成成功率得到改善。三种子因子控制支持相反折叠证据和证据加权；联合状态-评分标准匹配在所有四个表示控制设置中均达到最高平均值。

papers.title: Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds
papers.abstract: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.
papers.title_cn: 使用小型数学世界研究任务多样性的影响
papers.abs_cn: 模加法等基础数学任务一直是揭示神经网络行为某些方面的宝贵工具，这些方面在嘈杂、不可验证、大规模的真实世界环境中难以观察。这些研究通常聚焦于单一任务。然而，现代语言模型尽管以预测下一个 token 为目标进行训练，却会接触到大量任务。在这项工作中，我们引入了两个数学任务生态系统：IntWorld 和 PermWorld，它们分别由整数和排列上不同但相关的任务构建而成。两者都旨在模拟一个连贯的数学“世界”中的任务多样性，其中任务彼此不同但又相互关联。由于数据集是程序化生成的，我们可以精确地改变任务数量，从而开始厘清任务多样性在训练中的作用与其他因素的区别。在描述这些数据集之后，我们提供了从这些数据集中获得的一些初步结果，这些结果支持了增加任务多样性会提升模型内部表示丰富程度的观点。

papers.title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
papers.abstract: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emph{critique-conditioned self-distillation}: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as ``Wait'', ``But'', and ``Actually''. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.
papers.title_cn: 只会打分的特权教师无法搜索：面向推理的批评条件化在策略自蒸馏
papers.abs_cn: 在策略自蒸馏有望用密集的词元级信用取代可验证奖励强化学习稀疏的结果信号：一个以参考解答为条件的教师对学生自身的 rollout 打分，由此产生的分布偏移被蒸馏回策略中。我们研究这种打分信号是否真的包含纠正性信用。利用学生 rollout 中的黄金错误片段，我们检验自蒸馏目标所消耗的两种信号——全分布 KL 和词元对数比——是否具备两个性质：它们是否能定位错误，以及它们是否将概率推离学生的错误词元。它们既不具备这两个性质，也无法可靠地区分同一问题内正确与错误的 rollout。我们认为这种失败是结构性的：在推理轨迹中定位错误本身就是一个搜索问题，而打分教师从未被明确要求执行该搜索。同一个模型，在拥有相同特权信息的情况下，若被允许生成批评，则能显著更好地定位错误。这构成了\emph{批评条件化自蒸馏}的动机：首先生成对当前 rollout 的批评，然后让打分教师以该批评为条件。由此得到的信号能够定位错误，在错误片段内具有纠正性，并将概率推向启动回溯的词元，如“Wait”、“But”和“Actually”。我们进一步表明，批评在测试时和冷启动 GRPO 中都有用：在测试时，将批评放入上下文后继续一个错误的 rollout，可以解决模型通过采样无法解决的数学问题；在冷启动 GRPO 中，它为那些仅靠可验证奖励无法提供任何优势信号的提示提供了优势信号。

papers.title: SmolWAM: A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.
papers.title_cn: SmolWAM：面向边缘设备机器人操作的潜在世界-动作模型
papers.abs_cn: 世界-动作模型（WAM）在预测机器人动作的同时预测这些动作将产生的观测。然而，最强的模型依赖视频扩散 transformer，其计算成本对于资源受限的边缘设备而言过于高昂。我们提出 SmolWAM，一种潜在 WAM，它从 20 亿参数的 Cosmos Policy 派生而来：保留其预训练主干并重建其推理接口——单帧视觉潜在表示、保留主干注意力汇的缓存文本特征、28 个 transformer 块中的 12 个，以及 1,008 个 token，并在单步 rectified-flow 中从中读出动作和未来视觉潜在表示。SmolWAM 仅用 3.6 GPU 小时训练，在 400 个 LIBERO 回合中成功率达到 95.5%，每 16 动作块耗时 57 ms、2.3 TFLOP，GPU 内存占用 2.4 GiB，比其教师模型快 11 倍，FLOPs 少 18.5 倍，内存少 3.2 倍，且其世界头仍能预测场景运动。

papers.title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.
papers.title_cn: SafeDiSTL：分解联合约束以实现安全多智能体强化学习
papers.abs_cn: 协作多智能体任务通常对共享目标或集体安全施加约束。团队级别的违反代价函数可以衡量该约束结果，但无法区分哪些智能体的动作对该违反影响最大。我们提出 SafeDiSTL，一种约束多智能体强化学习框架，即使面对联合约束测量也能进行信用分配。我们使用信号时序逻辑（STL）鲁棒性，通过运行最大代价增量来衡量回合级别的违反程度。平滑的全回合鲁棒性和可微动力学提供了动作敏感度，从而在同一决策时刻将每个代价增量分配给各智能体。这些敏感度在加权各智能体对每个代价增量的份额时考虑了延迟效应。我们在协作负载运输、连通导航和网络化交通控制任务中研究了该框架。与约束基线相比，SafeDiSTL 在运输任务中实现了 1.6-5.1 倍的安全成功率，将导航安全成功率提升了 11.1%，并在交通任务中提供了 50-68% 的更高吞吐量。结果表明，所学策略在处理共享约束方面有显著改进，同时保持了无约束策略的性能。

papers.title: Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers
papers.abstract: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.
papers.title_cn: Orthros：面向高效Transformer的相位感知异构注意力
papers.abs_cn: 线性注意力和滑动窗口注意力等高效注意力机制旨在将Transformer的计算复杂度从二次降低到线性。然而，其上下文召回能力的退化往往需要交错使用全注意力层，使得长上下文处理中的二次瓶颈仍未得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Orthros注意力，它将效率范式从结构性分配转变为相位感知解耦。作为一个统一模块，它在序列处理的不同阶段动态切换其计算模式，从而实现线性复杂度的预填充和全注意力解码。我们的设计使Orthros注意力在以重预填充和轻解码为特征的常见长上下文场景中，相比原始Transformer具有更低的渐近复杂度。除了理论公式和复杂度分析外，大量实证评估在多个维度上展示了Orthros的优越性。首先，我们验证了其基础语言建模能力，展示了在不同模型规模上的可扩展性以及在全面架构比较中的强大竞争力。其次，Orthros通过数据高效的Transformer到Orthros转换展现出卓越的转换可行性，其性能甚至超越了原始Transformer。最后，Orthros实现了相比Transformer的21.9倍预填充加速，并带来端到端推理收益，同时保持了长上下文能力，近乎完美的128K needle-in-a-haystack结果以及在真实世界上下文召回任务上Transformer级别的性能均证明了这一点。总体而言，这些在高性能、灵活性和效率方面的优势使Orthros成为在工业应用中接替Transformer的有前景的候选方案。

papers.title: SeoulMMOD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Origin-Destination Flow Benchmark
papers.abstract: Origin-destination (OD) flow forecasting supports urban mobility decisions by predicting the volume and patterns of human movement across a city. Most existing public OD benchmarks provide only a partial view of citywide mobility, covering a single transport service or at most two modes. With partial mode coverage, observed demand changes are difficult to separate into shifts across transport modes and changes in total travel. We introduce SeoulMMOD, a large-scale public benchmark for citywide multimodal mobility in Seoul. SeoulMMOD provides three years of hourly OD flows estimating total mobility for 6 urban travel modes across 25 districts and 426 sub-districts, together with travel-time, travel-distance, calendar, rainfall, and point-of-interest (POI) signals. Using SeoulMMOD, we benchmark 14 forecasting baselines under a common protocol and analyse the effects of spatial scaling, joint versus mode-separate training, and cross-year generalization. Results show that several spatio-temporal models that work at district level do not scale to sub-district OD forecasting, and that naive joint multi-mode training does not consistently improve accuracy. Together, the dataset and benchmark establish a reproducible testbed for multi-mode, multi-year OD forecasting at the city scale.
papers.title_cn: SeoulMMOD：一个大规模多模态起讫点流量基准
papers.abs_cn: 起讫点（OD）流量预测通过预测城市中人类移动的流量和模式，为城市交通决策提供支持。大多数现有的公开OD基准仅提供城市范围内移动性的部分视图，覆盖单一交通服务或至多两种模式。由于模式覆盖不完整，观测到的需求变化难以被分解为交通模式间的转移与总出行量的变化。我们提出了SeoulMMOD，一个面向首尔全市多模态移动性的大规模公开基准。SeoulMMOD提供了三年的逐小时OD流量，估计了25个区、426个街道中6种城市出行模式的总移动性，并附有旅行时间、旅行距离、日历、降雨和兴趣点（POI）信号。利用SeoulMMOD，我们在统一协议下对14个预测基线进行了基准测试，并分析了空间尺度缩放、联合训练与分模式训练对比以及跨年泛化的影响。结果表明，若干在区级有效的时空模型无法扩展到街道级OD预测，且朴素的联合多模式训练并不能持续提升准确率。该数据集与基准共同为城市尺度下的多模式、多年份OD预测建立了一个可复现的测试平台。

papers.title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. CFGNP uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to exploit the dual-graph structure by restricting cross-world message passing to corresponding factual--counterfactual variables. Across synthetic and image-based benchmarks, CFGNP achieves stronger predictive performance than existing approaches, including on the German Loan benchmark, where it reduces MSE from $4.51 \times 10^{-2}$ to $0.19 \times 10^{-2}$. Furthermore, on synthetic causal graphs, a model trained only on 10-node graphs maintains strong predictive performance on graphs with up to 30 nodes, without retraining.
papers.title_cn: 基于图神经网络的摊销反事实预测
papers.abs_cn: 反事实推断探讨的是在另一种情形下已观测结果可能如何不同，例如患者若接受不同治疗是否会康复。只要决策依赖于未观测到的备选方案的结果，这类问题就会出现。回答反事实查询通常需要了解潜在的因果结构，而这在实践中往往无法获得。因此，一种常见方法是先从观测数据中估计因果图，再进行反事实推断。然而，估计出的因果图中的误差会传播到下游的反事实预测中。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了反事实图神经过程（CFGNP），这是一种端到端方法，可直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，而无需先估计因果图。CFGNP 利用图神经网络（GNN）来挖掘双图结构，其方式是将跨世界消息传递限制在相对应的 factual--counterfactual 变量之间。在合成基准和基于图像的基准上，CFGNP 均取得了优于现有方法的预测性能，包括在 German Loan 基准上，它将 MSE 从 $4.51 \times 10^{-2}$ 降低到 $0.19 \times 10^{-2}$。此外，在合成因果图上，仅在 10 节点图上训练的模型无需重新训练，即可在多达 30 个节点的图上保持较强的预测性能。

papers.title: Differentiable Partitioning With Dual-Max 3D Wirelength Model and Hybrid Bonding Terminal Awareness for Optimized 3D Placement
papers.abstract: Research on 3D integrated circuits (3D-ICs) physical design has expanded rapidly in recent years, driven by the increasing adoption of hybrid bonding and the demand for higher integration density. Continued scaling of hybrid-bonding pitch supports higher vertical interconnect density and finer-grained circuit partitioning in 3D-ICs. Hybrid bonding-enabled 3D-ICs offer substantial benefits in interconnect scaling and system integration, yet tier assignment remains challenging because it jointly determines 3D wirelength and hybrid bonding terminal (HBT) assignment. This paper presents a differentiable partitioning framework that directly optimizes placement-aware tier assignment for 3D-ICs through gradient-based optimization. Discrete tier assignment is relaxed to continuous probabilities, and a Dual-Max 3D wirelength model is introduced as a placement-aware surrogate for tier-specific half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). In addition, a terminal-aware cutsize penalty gives higher weights to cross-die nets with predicted HBT overlaps, and a local balance penalty discourages regional area overflow on each tier. On ten OpenROAD benchmarks, our method reduces final die-to-die (D2D) HPWL by 8.05% and 14.81% on average relative to hMETIS and TritonPart, respectively. On the seven benchmarks with available CoPlace results, the average HPWL reduction is 10.33%. The source code for the differentiable partitioner and the integrated 3D placement flow is publicly available to support reproducibility.
papers.title_cn: 面向优化3D布局的可微分划分：双最大3D线长模型与混合键合端子感知
papers.abs_cn: 近年来，随着混合键合技术的日益普及以及对更高集成密度的需求，3D集成电路（3D-IC）物理设计研究迅速扩展。混合键合间距的持续缩小支持了3D-IC中更高的垂直互连密度和更细粒度的电路划分。支持混合键合的3D-IC在互连缩放和系统集成方面具有显著优势，然而层分配仍然具有挑战性，因为它同时决定了3D线长和混合键合端子（HBT）分配。本文提出了一种可微分划分框架，通过基于梯度的优化直接优化3D-IC中布局感知的层分配。离散层分配被松弛为连续概率，并引入双最大3D线长模型作为层特定半周长线长（HPWL）的布局感知代理。此外，端子感知切割尺寸惩罚对具有预测HBT重叠的跨芯片网络赋予更高权重，局部平衡惩罚则抑制每个层上的区域面积溢出。在十个OpenROAD基准测试上，与hMETIS和TritonPart相比，我们的方法分别平均降低了最终芯片间（D2D）HPWL的8.05%和14.81%。在七个有可用CoPlace结果的基准测试上，平均HPWL降低为10.33%。可微分划分器及集成3D布局流程的源代码已公开，以支持可复现性。

papers.title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
papers.abstract: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.
papers.title_cn: 通过知识图谱引导的多任务预训练增强预训练语言模型中的法律推理能力
papers.abs_cn: 法律语言理解需要对半结构化的法规文档进行推理，然而标准的预训练目标并未明确针对这种结构化能力。由于当前的法律语言模型仅依赖掩码语言建模，它们将成文法文本视为扁平的词元序列，忽略了底层的层级约束。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种针对德国交通法（StVO）的多任务预训练方法。我们的方法结合了三个互补的目标：下一句预测（NSP）、知识图谱（KG）引导的聚类（CLU）以及知识图谱（KG）感知的段落分类（CLS）。该方法将结构化的法律知识显式地编码到模型权重中。这种编码使得在推理时能够进行零样本法律推理，并消除了对离散图遍历的需求。我们在九个基于 Transformer 的编码器和 324 次实验运行中评估了我们的方法。在合成的 StVO 问答任务上，我们的模型相较于基线展现出持续一致的相对提升，提升幅度在 10.3% 到 155.0% 之间。此外，相对于已有的 LexGLUE 基线（Chalkidis et al., 2022），我们的模型在七个法律基准中的四个上超越了先前的结果。在奥地利驾驶法规上，它还实现了一致的零样本迁移增益，提升幅度在 3.4% 到 15.8% 之间。这些实验结果表明，我们的训练方法成功泛化到了初始训练的法律领域之外。

papers.title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
papers.abstract: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. For two groups, we prove an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling, and we show that same-seed replay reproduces retraining exactly. Reuse pays off most when a whole client withdraws: across three datasets, replay is $35.8\times$ faster than retraining for the initialization-only model and remains $2.4\times$ and $1.7\times$ faster with one and two fair-refinement rounds, which improve worst-group cost. For individual record deletions, gains are modest (about $1.06\times$), and certifying cached assignments can cost more than it saves. These results map where exact unlearning can profitably reuse computation. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc.
papers.title_cn: 联邦社会公平 k-Means 聚类的机器遗忘
papers.abs_cn: 联邦聚类可支持跨医院的患者分层以及跨分布式金融数据集的客户细分等应用。负责任的人工智能要求公平地代表人口群体，并支持数据删除，部分动机源于 GDPR 的被遗忘权等权利。这些目标相互影响：删除记录可能改变群体间的平衡，并改变剩余人口的聚类结果。我们研究了联邦社会公平 k-means 的精确机器遗忘，其目标是最小化到最近中心的组平均平方距离的最大值。我们的方法为每个组保留独立的局部摘要，因此当全局公平权重变化时，未受影响机构的摘要仍然有效。对于两个组，我们证明了在理想采样下独立于客户端组比例的初始化近似保证，并表明相同种子的重放能够精确复现重新训练。重用在整个客户端退出时收益最大：在三个数据集上，对于仅初始化模型，重放比重新训练快 35.8 倍，在加入一轮和两轮公平细化后仍分别快 2.4 倍和 1.7 倍，这些细化改善了最差组成本。对于单个记录删除，收益有限（约 1.06 倍），并且认证缓存分配的成本可能超过其节省。这些结果描绘了精确遗忘可以在何处有利地重用计算。代码和可复现材料可在 https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc 获取。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Training of GFlowNets: A Theoretical Perspective
papers.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn policies that sample discrete objects in proportion to a positive reward. They are trained by minimizing balance objectives, whose exact satisfaction guarantees correct sampling. However, a comprehensive theory linking nonzero balance loss and approximate stationarity to sampling accuracy, especially under evolving sampling distributions and backward policies, is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we develop a unified theory for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in this regime. We first bound terminal symmetric KL by the square root of the expected balance loss. Then, we show that approximate stationarity controls this distribution error up to a tangent-space residual measuring parameterization incompleteness. Finally, we establish finite-time convergence under fixed or controlled sampling and fixed, balance-trained, or separately updated backward policies. Under standard smoothness assumptions, with fixed or controlled sampling and a fixed or balance-trained backward policy, the expected loss is $O(\barε^2+T^{-1})$ and expected terminal symmetric KL is $O(\barε+T^{-1/2})$ under uniform coverage. For a separately updated backward policy, we characterize the sufficient update decay to approach the residual neighborhood and preserve these rates. These results connect balance objectives to sampling accuracy and clarify how parameterization, coverage, and moving components govern GFlowNet training.
papers.title_cn: 理解 GFlowNets 的训练：一个理论视角
papers.abs_cn: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）学习按照正比于正奖励的方式采样离散对象的策略。它们通过最小化平衡目标来训练，这些目标的精确满足保证了正确的采样。然而，将非零平衡损失和近似平稳性与采样精度联系起来的全面理论仍然缺乏，尤其是在采样分布和后向策略不断演化的情况下。为了弥补这一空白，我们在此情形下为 Flow Matching、Detailed Balance 和 Trajectory Balance 建立了一个统一理论。我们首先用期望平衡损失的平方根来界定终端对称 KL。然后，我们表明近似平稳性控制这种分布误差，直至一个衡量参数化不完整性的切空间残差。最后，我们在固定或受控采样以及固定、平衡训练或单独更新的后向策略下建立了有限时间收敛。在标准光滑性假设下，对于固定或受控采样以及固定或平衡训练的后向策略，期望损失为 $O(\barε^2+T^{-1})$，并且在均匀覆盖下期望终端对称 KL 为 $O(\barε+T^{-1/2})$。对于单独更新的后向策略，我们刻画了足以接近残差邻域并保持这些速率的更新衰减。这些结果将平衡目标与采样精度联系起来，并阐明了参数化、覆盖和动态组件如何支配 GFlowNet 训练。

papers.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
papers.abstract: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.
papers.title_cn: 自适应 DHiSparse：基于负载自适应 KV 层次结构的推测解码
papers.abs_cn: 长上下文服务在硬件达到有效吞吐量之前就会耗尽 KV 内存。HiSparse 将历史存储在主机内存中，仅获取被选中的条目，但它在所有负载下都使用单一的缓存预算，并且不处理 DSpark 和 DFlash2 等草稿模型推测解码。我们提出 Adaptive DHiSparse，它支持在分层稀疏 KV 上进行推测解码，并根据负载自适应调整驻留。它保护所需的工作集，在 GPU 内存空闲时保留额外历史，并通过精确融合检索恢复其余部分。DSpark 和 DFlash2 保持其提议和接受规则：查询共享缺失行检索，草稿 KV 使用窗口受限的环形结构，验证暂存跨层组复用。在 100K 上下文和并发 128 下，使用 DFlash2 的 GLM-5.3 每解码 GPU 提供 793 输出 tokens/s，是 HiSparse 的 1.45 倍，是非推测自适应服务的 1.27 倍。在与 HiSparse 相同的延迟界限下，它可维持高达 4 倍的并发和 2.3 至 3.7 倍的输出，具体取决于每 token 界限。在 500K 上下文和并发 512 下的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上，使用 DSpark 的 Adaptive DHiSparse 提供使用 DSpark 的常驻服务输出的 1.85 倍。在负载阶跃中，可选驻留将主机获取从低负载下选中行的 14.2% 降低到 1.4%，并在压力下释放内存。

papers.title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
papers.abstract: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.
papers.title_cn: 智能体网络技术栈的基线评估
papers.abs_cn: 针对基于LLM的智能体，协议、框架和技术的快速提出使得任何想要创建最先进AI解决方案的人都面临复杂的局面。如果没有对不同协议、框架和库如何协同构成智能体网络解决方案的评估，开发者和组织甚至在成为智能体网络生态系统的一部分之前就面临各种挑战（例如，技能、治理、基础设施）。在此背景下，我们提出了一个用于执行智能体网络评估的系统，称为MASTIF（多智能体系统测试框架），并针对300个Mind2Web基准任务，对智能体网络技术进行了基线评估，包括3个LLM、3种协议和4个智能体实现框架。结果表明，选择特定任务的技术栈可能会带来任务完成率、效率得分和社会价值稳定性得分的提升，并减少冗长度和完成任务的时间。通过所呈现的结果，我们期望为那些旨在设计、评估和开发多智能体系统的人，在这个复杂且快速演变的场景中提供一个指标和结果方面的基线。

papers.title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.
papers.title_cn: 通过结构驱动知识图谱实现法律推理的可验证检索
papers.abs_cn: 在医学或法律等可靠性至关重要的领域中，任何自动化都必须具备透明性和可验证性。尽管当前基于LLM的系统具有优势，但由于其固有的黑箱特性，它们并不满足这些要求。检索增强生成（RAG）试图将生成过程建立在相关的可解释文档之上，从而降低AI“幻觉”的风险，并有可能实现对初始生成上下文的验证。然而，随着潜在来源数量和规模的增加，朴素的检索方法往往表现更差，忽略了关键的上下文元素。在本文中，我们旨在德国法律法典的背景下解决这一问题。利用结构驱动的解析来创建用于源文档导航和检索的知识图谱（KG），我们比较了几种基于KG的分块和检索策略，并评估了它们对检索引用准确性的影响。

papers.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.
papers.title_cn: 一次完成校准：联合学习准确且校准良好的神经网络
papers.abs_cn: 神经网络（NNs）虽然高度灵活且用途广泛，但往往校准不佳。事后校准方法使用单独的校准数据集和额外的校准参数来调整已训练模型的输出。这一过程增加了开销，需要单独优化校准器并进行后续的模型选择。在本文中，我们表明，标准（事后）校准器可以通过双层 Stackelberg 公式与骨干网络进行端到端训练。该公式通过使用交叉熵联合优化准确性和校准，消除了对单独校准集或专用校准损失的需求，仅引入一个额外的超参数：校准器学习率。尽管我们的框架支持从温度缩放和矩阵缩放到 NN 层的各种校准器，但我们的结果表明，使用最终分类层本身作为校准器可以产生准确且校准良好的模型，且无需额外参数。我们的方法以最小的额外复杂度超越了 SOTA 校准器，同时在多任务学习等设置中避免了单独校准组件的乘法开销。

papers.title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
papers.abstract: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $Ω(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.
papers.title_cn: 方差缩减策略梯度近乎极小极大最优
papers.abs_cn: 标准策略梯度（PG）算法由于依赖蒙特卡洛更新而面临高估计方差。虽然离策略方差缩减缓解了这一问题，但建立最优样本复杂度目前需要要么限制性假设（如一致有界重要性权重），要么不切实际的二阶操作。在本工作中，我们引入了无循环方差缩减PG（LVR-PG），这是一个统一的理论框架，抽象了一类将递归更新与防御性重要性采样相结合的一阶估计器，包括已知的估计器如PAGE-PG和STORM-PG。我们证明了该算法类在一般参数化策略下，在弱梯度支配条件下实现了$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$的最后迭代全局收敛。我们使用纯一阶更新、最小假设且无需梯度预条件子来建立这一保证。通过将最先进的下界扩展到连续参数化策略，我们建立了$Ω(ε^{-2})$的样本复杂度极限，确认我们的框架在对数因子和视界项范围内是极小极大最优的。

papers.title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a model in our constructed transformer class, providing a principled foundation for the proposed query-dependent attention architecture. The operator is trained through amortized denoising score matching across task distributions. We establish generalization-error bounds that quantify the effects of the context size, the numbers of training tasks and within-task samples, model complexity, and intrinsic and ambient dimensions. Numerically, we evaluate the method on a range of scientific and visual datasets, including Navier-Stokes, ERA5 climate data, QuickDraw sketches, and Food-101. The results show that the proposed method performs well on relatively simple task families, while its performance degrades as task complexity increases, thereby illustrating both the promise and the limitations of in-context learning for diffusion models.
papers.title_cn: 基于Transformer的扩散模型上下文评分算子学习
papers.abs_cn: 扩散模型通常学习单一目标分布或由训练期间固定的条件变量索引的一族分布的生成动力学。这限制了它们仅从少量示例适应先前未见分布的能力。我们引入了一种用于扩散模型的上下文解算子学习框架，其中每个目标分布被视为从元分布中抽取的任务，并在推理时由经验上下文集指定。我们的方法学习一个上下文评分算子，将上下文样本、噪声查询点和扩散时间映射到任务相关的评分，从而能够在未见任务上进行反向扩散采样，而无需重新训练或参数更新。一个关键观察是，任务相关的评分允许高斯核条件均值表示。其经验Nadaraya--Watson近似可以由我们构造的Transformer类中的模型精确表示，为所提出的查询依赖注意力架构提供了有原则的基础。该算子通过跨任务分布的摊销去噪评分匹配进行训练。我们建立了泛化误差界，量化了上下文大小、训练任务数和任务内样本数、模型复杂度以及内在和环境维度的影响。在数值上，我们在一系列科学和视觉数据集上评估了该方法，包括Navier-Stokes、ERA5气候数据、QuickDraw草图和Food-101。结果表明，所提出的方法在相对简单的任务族上表现良好，而其性能随着任务复杂度的增加而下降，从而说明了扩散模型上下文学习的潜力和局限性。

papers.title: VQIL: Visible Quantum Interference Learning for Perturbation Response Ranking on Graphs
papers.abstract: Learning how local perturbations affect a network is important for identifying which components drive or absorb a system's response. We formulate this as seed-conditioned response ranking: given a perturbation at one seed node, ranking all other nodes by response strength. This is challenging when the model is given only the interaction topology, while the mechanism governing how perturbations propagate must be learned from data. We present VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning), a trainable Szegedy quantum walk for seed-conditioned ranking. Edge weights, link phases, and per-node phase rotations are optimized end-to-end by backpropagation while the walk operator remains unitary throughout training. Node scores are obtained from a geometrically discounted coherent sum of quantum-walk amplitudes, enabling quantum interference before the final squared-norm readout. Because each learned parameter is attached to a named edge or node, the trained model provides directly inspectable hypotheses about the roles of individual graph components in the propagation mechanism. On AC power-flow perturbations over six transmission grids, with electrical parameters withheld from the model, VQIL improves Spearman rank correlation from 0.147 for the untrained walk to 0.831 and outperforms an identically trained random-walk model. On gene perturbation over five protein-protein interaction networks with Perturb-seq supervision, VQIL improves rank correlation from 0.171 to 0.620, outperforming the strongest learned classical and neural baselines. These results show that trainable quantum-walk interference provides a scalable and interpretable inductive bias for learning seed-conditioned response rankings on graphs.
papers.title_cn: VQIL：用于图上扰动响应排序的可见量子干涉学习
papers.abs_cn: 学习局部扰动如何影响网络对于识别哪些组件驱动或吸收系统响应至关重要。我们将其形式化为种子条件响应排序：给定一个种子节点上的扰动，按响应强度对所有其他节点进行排序。当模型仅给定交互拓扑，而支配扰动传播的机制必须从数据中学习时，这一任务具有挑战性。我们提出 VQIL（Visible Quantum Interference Learning），一种用于种子条件排序的可训练 Szegedy 量子行走。边权重、连边相位和逐节点相位旋转通过反向传播进行端到端优化，同时行走算子在训练全程保持酉性。节点分数由量子行走振幅的几何折扣相干和获得，从而在最终的平方范数读出之前实现量子干涉。由于每个学习到的参数都附着在具名边或节点上，训练后的模型提供了关于传播机制中各个图组件作用的可直接检验的假设。在六个输电网上的交流潮流扰动任务中，在模型不获得电气参数的情况下，VQIL 将 Spearman 秩相关从无训练行走的 0.147 提升至 0.831，并优于以相同方式训练的随机行走模型。在五个蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络上、以 Perturb-seq 作为监督的基因扰动任务中，VQIL 将秩相关从 0.171 提升至 0.620，优于最强的可学习经典基线和神经基线。这些结果表明，可训练的量子行走干涉为学习图上种子条件响应排序提供了一种可扩展且可解释的归纳偏置。

papers.title: X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks. Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. Empirically, X-AVDD significantly outperforms other audio-visual distillation methods. On VGGSound, an audio-visual dataset of short YouTube clips, X-AVDD improves top-1 test accuracy from $8.2\%\rightarrow24.0\%$ at SPC=$10$ and $9.8\%\rightarrow26.5\%$ at SPC=$20$. Furthermore, X-AVDD improves cross-architecture generalization (e.g., $25.5\%\rightarrow35.3\%$ for a ViT target on AVE dataset at SPC $=50$) and successfully scales to complex architectures such as AudioCLIP, achieving $62.3\%$ accuracy using only $5.65\%$ of the full dataset, against the full dataset accuracy of $72.4\%$ while completing in $9\times$ lower training time compared to the full dataset.
papers.title_cn: X-AVDD：交叉注意力音视频数据集蒸馏
papers.abs_cn: 音视频数据集蒸馏旨在从大规模配对音视频数据集中合成一个小型数据集，同时几乎保持神经网络的训练效用。现有的 DM 和 AVDD 等方法面临两个关键局限：1）内存占用大，难以扩展到复杂架构和更高的每类样本数（SPC）设置；2）往往无法保持强跨模态语义对应关系。为解决这些问题，我们提出 X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的蒸馏方法，在合成过程中显式捕获模态间关系。通过将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，X-AVDD 在内存效率上大幅提升，将端到端合成成本降低约 8 倍 GPU 小时，同时生成高度对齐的合成数据。实验表明，X-AVDD 显著优于其他音视频蒸馏方法。在 VGGSound（一个由短 YouTube 片段组成的音视频数据集）上，X-AVDD 在 SPC=10 时将 top-1 测试准确率从 8.2% 提升至 24.0%，在 SPC=20 时从 9.8% 提升至 26.5%。此外，X-AVDD 改善了跨架构泛化能力（例如，在 AVE 数据集上 SPC=50 时，ViT 目标模型从 25.5% 提升至 35.3%），并成功扩展到 AudioCLIP 等复杂架构，仅使用完整数据集的 5.65% 即达到 62.3% 的准确率，而完整数据集的准确率为 72.4%，同时训练时间相比完整数据集缩短 9 倍。

papers.title: On Privacy Mechanism Design Under a Bounded $α$-Lift Leakage Constraint with $χ^2$-Utility
papers.abstract: We study the design of a statistical privacy mechanism under a bounded $α$-lift leakage constraint. An agent observes useful data $Y$, which is arbitrarily correlated with private data $X$, and releases $U$. The goal is to maximize Pearson $χ^2$-information $χ^2(Y;U)$ while satisfying the point-wise privacy constraint. This utility is an $f$-information that is nonnegative, obeys data processing, and measures the aggregate normalized change from the prior $P_Y$ to the posteriors $P_{Y|U=u}$. The main benefit of this choice is that $χ^2(Y;U)$ is exactly quadratic in the posterior perturbations; hence, no local approximation of the utility is required. For the nonlinear $α$-lift constraint, we derive a uniform Taylor-remainder bound that remains valid for the optimizing, $ε$-dependent perturbation. When $P_{X|Y}$ is invertible, this yields a closed-form quadratic surrogate, an explicitly scaled binary mechanism that satisfies the original $α$-lift constraint, a computable sufficient range for $ε$, and an $O(ε^{3/2})$ bound on the utility gap. For $α=2$, the solution is exact over an explicit range. We transfer these results to point-wise Rényi-divergence privacy, including an exact-feasible mechanism, an explicit privacy-budget range, and matching gap bounds. We also give an exact formulation for arbitrary leakage matrices and evaluate exact-feasible mechanisms numerically.
papers.title_cn: 在有界 $α$-Lift 泄漏约束与 $χ^2$-效用下的隐私机制设计
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究在有界 $α$-lift 泄漏约束下的统计隐私机制设计。一个代理观察到有用数据 $Y$，它与私有数据 $X$ 任意相关，并发布 $U$。目标是在满足逐点隐私约束的同时最大化 Pearson $χ^2$-信息 $χ^2(Y;U)$。该效用是一种 $f$-信息，非负、满足数据处理不等式，并度量从先验 $P_Y$ 到后验 $P_{Y|U=u}$ 的聚合归一化变化。这一选择的主要好处是 $χ^2(Y;U)$ 关于后验扰动恰好是二次的；因此不需要对效用进行局部近似。对于非线性的 $α$-lift 约束，我们推导出一个一致 Taylor 余项界，该界对优化中的、依赖于 $ε$ 的扰动仍然有效。当 $P_{X|Y}$ 可逆时，这给出一个闭式二次替代、一个满足原始 $α$-lift 约束的显式缩放二元机制、一个可计算的 $ε$ 充分范围，以及效用差距的 $O(ε^{3/2})$ 界。对于 $α=2$，解在一个显式范围内是精确的。我们将这些结果推广到逐点 Rényi 散度隐私，包括一个精确可行机制、一个显式隐私预算范围以及匹配的差距界。我们还给出了任意泄漏矩阵的精确表述，并对精确可行机制进行了数值评估。

papers.title: Learning-Based Power Flow Estimation with Sparse PMU Deployment in Power Systems
papers.abstract: Accurate monitoring of power flow is fundamental to the secure and reliable operation of modern power systems. Existing data-driven power flow estimation methods typically assume that synchronized measurements are available at every bus, requiring extensive deployment of phasor measurement units (PMUs). Such dense sensing infrastructures substantially increase installation, communication, and maintenance costs. This paper proposes a learning-based framework that minimizes the number of installed PMUs while maintaining high-accuracy systemwide power flow estimation. Instead of relying on measurements from all buses, the proposed method identifies an informative subset of buses whose synchronized measurements are sufficient to accurately reconstruct branch power flow across the network. To this end, a neural network is developed to learn the nonlinear relationship between PMU measurements and system-wide power flows, and multiple PMU deployment scenarios are evaluated to quantify the trade-off between measurement availability and estimation accuracy. The results enable utilities to identify cost-effective PMU placement strategies that balance deployment cost and prediction performance. Case studies on the IEEE 30-bus test system demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly reduces the number of required PMUs while maintaining accurate power flow estimation.
papers.title_cn: 电力系统中基于稀疏PMU部署的基于学习的潮流估计
papers.abs_cn: 准确的潮流监测是现代电力系统安全可靠运行的基础。现有的数据驱动潮流估计方法通常假设每个母线都可获得同步测量，需要大量部署相量测量单元（PMU）。这种密集的传感基础设施大幅增加了安装、通信和维护成本。本文提出了一种基于学习的框架，在保持高精度全网潮流估计的同时最小化已安装PMU的数量。所提方法不依赖所有母线的测量，而是识别出一个信息量丰富的母线子集，其同步测量足以准确重建网络中的支路潮流。为此，开发了一个神经网络来学习PMU测量与全网潮流之间的非线性关系，并评估了多种PMU部署场景，以量化测量可用性与估计精度之间的权衡。结果使电力公司能够识别出兼顾部署成本与预测性能的经济高效的PMU配置策略。在IEEE 30母线测试系统上的案例研究表明，所提框架在保持准确潮流估计的同时显著减少了所需PMU的数量。

papers.title: Retractions Revisited: A Replication, Extension, and Mechanistic Evaluation of Linguistic Obfuscation Effects in Fraudulent Science
papers.abstract: Prior work suggests fraudulent scientists write their articles with higher rates of linguistic obfuscation than genuine scientists, with a possible mechanism suggesting obfuscation makes research more costly for a reader to analyze. This result has not undergone additional empirical scrutiny in the open science era, nor have other psychological mechanisms been evaluated. The current replication and extension addressed this opportunity by comparing 800 fraudulent and 800 genuine control papers (2013-2025). The results supported the linguistic obfuscation hypothesis, suggesting fraudulent papers were more obfuscated than genuine ones. A parallel mediation model evaluated three competing mechanisms, finding that reality monitoring, as measured through decreased rates of adjectives, best explained the link between fraudulent science and linguistic obfuscation. Cross-validated detection accuracy using obfuscation features (60.7%) and an elastic net of over 100 language dimensions (71.6%) were significantly greater than chance. Implications for scientific fraud and psychology of language research are discussed.
papers.title_cn: 撤稿再探：欺诈科学中语言模糊效应的重复、扩展与机制评估
papers.abs_cn: 先前的研究表明，欺诈科学家在撰写文章时，语言模糊程度高于真正的科学家，可能的机制是模糊化使读者分析研究的成本更高。这一结果在开放科学时代尚未经过进一步实证检验，其他心理机制也未被评估。当前的重复与扩展研究通过比较800篇欺诈论文和800篇真实对照论文（2013-2025年）来填补这一空白。结果支持语言模糊假说，表明欺诈论文比真实论文更加模糊。一个平行中介模型评估了三种竞争机制，发现通过形容词使用率降低来衡量的现实监控，最能解释欺诈科学与语言模糊之间的联系。使用模糊特征（60.7%）和包含100多个语言维度的弹性网络（71.6%）进行的交叉验证检测准确率均显著高于随机水平。本文讨论了这些发现对科学欺诈和语言心理学研究的意义。

papers.title: On the Encoding of Calendar Features in Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) increasingly offer covariate support, with calendar information being the most common type of categorical covariate in practice, as it is available for every point in time.
