However, how these features are encoded is largely treated as an implementation detail rather than as an object of study, despite encoding being one of the few design choices left for pretrained models at inference time. With the present study, we demonstrate that the way information is propagated into the model substantially affects forecast accuracy of TSFMs. Therefore, we systematically compare seven calendar encodings, including three conventional target-agnostic representations (ordinal, one-hot, and cyclic) and four target encodings, across four state-of-the-art TSFMs on nine datasets from multiple domains in a zero-shot rolling evaluation. The nine datasets are influenced by social activities, such as weekends and holidays, making calendar information particularly relevant for forecasting. We find that encoding choice affects forecast accuracy across all models, with MASE differences of up to 9.9 % on non-holidays and 83 % on holidays within a single model. Effectiveness and utilization vary substantially across models. Improvements are concentrated around holidays, where calendar information provides signals unavailable from target history, while some model encoding combinations also improve non-holiday forecasts. A SHAP-based attribution analysis locates the contribution of the covariates relative to the autoregressive component and explains why some model-encoding combinations degrade performance. Our findings suggest that current benchmarks for covariate-informed TSFMs can distort model comparisons by imposing fixed encoding strategies.
papers.title_cn: 论协变量感知时间序列基础模型中日历特征的编码
papers.abs_cn: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）越来越多地提供协变量支持，其中日历信息是实践中最常见的类别型协变量，因为它对每个时间点都可用。然而，这些特征如何编码在很大程度上被视为实现细节而非研究对象，尽管编码是预训练模型在推理时仅剩的少数设计选择之一。在本研究中，我们证明信息传播到模型中的方式会显著影响 TSFMs 的预测精度。因此，我们在零样本滚动评估中，系统地比较了七种日历编码，包括三种传统的目标无关表示（序数、独热和循环）以及四种目标编码，在来自多个领域的九个数据集上，跨四个最先进的 TSFMs 进行评估。这九个数据集受社交活动（如周末和节假日）影响，使得日历信息对预测尤为重要。我们发现编码选择影响所有模型的预测精度，在单个模型内，非节假日的 MASE 差异高达 9.9%，节假日高达 83%。有效性和利用率在不同模型间差异显著。改进集中在节假日附近，此时日历信息提供了目标历史无法提供的信号，而某些模型编码组合也改善了非节假日预测。基于 SHAP 的归因分析定位了协变量相对于自回归分量的贡献，并解释了为什么某些模型-编码组合会降低性能。我们的发现表明，当前协变量感知 TSFMs 的基准测试通过强加固定编码策略，可能会扭曲模型比较。

papers.title: Can Multimodal Decision Models Classify Breast Ultrasound Images? Benchmarking CLEF and CLEF-Flash Across Prompts and Datasets
papers.abstract: Multimodal decision models return probabilities over predefined alternatives, offering a structured interface for image classification. This study benchmarks inference with CLEF and CLEF-Flash on 2818 breast ultrasound images from Dataset B, BUSI, and BUS-BRA. Dataset B and BUS-BRA use binary benign-malignant classification, whereas BUSI includes normal, benign, and malignant categories. Model parameters remain unchanged, and original images are submitted without user-defined preprocessing. Three prompts provide minimal labels, an explicit classification task, or sonographic criteria. We report accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, macro precision, throughput, and latency. CLEF-Flash with the clinical prompt achieves the highest accuracy on all three datasets: 74.85% on Dataset B, 66.28% on BUSI, and 51.63% on BUS-BRA. On BUSI, however, CLEF with the task-guided prompt achieves the highest macro F1 (64.51%) and balanced accuracy (68.72%). CLEF-Flash has lower latency in every matched comparison. Clinical instructions improve CLEF-Flash accuracy relative to the minimal prompt but reduce CLEF accuracy on all datasets. Confusion matrices reveal frequent benign-to-malignant errors, particularly on BUS-BRA, where all configurations fall below the 67.63% accuracy of a majority-class predictor. These findings demonstrate dataset-and prompt-dependent performance and motivate class-specific evaluation before applying multimodal decision models to breast ultrasound analysis.
papers.title_cn: 多模态决策模型能否对乳腺超声图像进行分类？跨提示词与数据集的 CLEF 和 CLEF-Flash 基准测试
papers.abs_cn: 多模态决策模型返回预定义选项上的概率，为图像分类提供了结构化接口。本研究在来自 Dataset B、BUSI 和 BUS-BRA 的 2818 张乳腺超声图像上，对 CLEF 和 CLEF-Flash 的推理进行了基准测试。Dataset B 和 BUS-BRA 采用良性-恶性二分类，而 BUSI 包含正常、良性和恶性三类。模型参数保持不变，原始图像未经用户自定义预处理直接提交。三种提示词分别提供最小标签、明确的分类任务或超声标准。我们报告准确率、宏 F1、平衡准确率、宏精确率、吞吐量和延迟。使用临床提示词的 CLEF-Flash 在三个数据集上均取得最高准确率：Dataset B 上为 74.85%，BUSI 上为 66.28%，BUS-BRA 上为 51.63%。然而在 BUSI 上，使用任务引导提示词的 CLEF 取得了最高的宏 F1（64.51%）和平衡准确率（68.72%）。在每一组匹配比较中，CLEF-Flash 的延迟都更低。相对于最小提示词，临床指令提高了 CLEF-Flash 的准确率，但降低了 CLEF 在所有数据集上的准确率。混淆矩阵显示良性到恶性的错误频繁发生，尤其是在 BUS-BRA 上，所有配置的准确率都低于多数类预测器的 67.63%。这些发现表明性能依赖于数据集和提示词，并说明在将多模态决策模型应用于乳腺超声分析之前，有必要进行类别特异性评估。

papers.title: Not All Dimensions Are Equal: Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization with Grouped Quadratic Kernels
papers.abstract: Linearizing softmax attention offers a route to efficient Transformer inference, but preserving pretrained attention remains challenging. We identify an important source of approximation error overlooked by standard linearization methods: a small number of outlier dimensions contribute disproportionately to query-key dot products and account for a large fraction of the approximation error. Motivated by this heterogeneity, we propose Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization (OAL), a dimension-aware method for constructing quadratic attention approximations. Starting from a second-order Taylor approximation, we introduce a Hadamard-product formulation that makes individual query-key contributions explicit. This formulation relaxes globally shared coefficients to support dimension-specific linear terms and cross-dimensional quadratic interactions while preserving separable evaluation. To retain this flexibility with fewer parameters, OAL groups dimensions with similar contribution scales to share coefficients, while allowing distinct treatment of the few outliers. The resulting positive quadratic kernel is calibrated against pretrained attention outputs and admits linear-time evaluation with respect to sequence length for fixed head dimensions. On Qwen2.5-0.5B, OAL reduces frozen-attention output relative MSE by approximately 8.9% compared with DiJiang. Replacing middle-layer attention modules and jointly fine-tuning the kernel coefficients with LoRA further lowers WikiText-103 perplexity from 31.71 to 27.50 compared with a learned global quadratic, while improving accuracy on PIQA, HellaSwag, and ARC-E. These results demonstrate the value of outlier-aware dimension grouping for both attention approximation and pretrained-model conversion. The code is available at https://github.com/wuqianyue09/OAL
papers.title_cn: 并非所有维度都平等：基于分组二次核的离群值感知注意力线性化
papers.abs_cn: 线性化 softmax 注意力为高效 Transformer 推理提供了一条路径，但保持预训练注意力的性能仍然具有挑战性。我们发现了标准线性化方法所忽略的一个重要近似误差来源：少数离群维度对 query-key 点积的贡献不成比例，并占据了近似误差的很大一部分。受这种异质性的启发，我们提出了离群值感知注意力线性化（OAL），一种用于构建二次注意力近似的维度感知方法。从二阶 Taylor 近似出发，我们引入了一种 Hadamard 积形式，使各个 query-key 贡献显式化。该形式将全局共享系数放宽，以支持维度特定的线性项和跨维度二次交互，同时保持可分离计算。为了以更少参数保持这种灵活性，OAL 将贡献尺度相似的维度分组以共享系数，同时允许对少数离群值进行单独处理。所得的半正定二次核针对预训练注意力输出进行校准，并且在固定头维度下允许关于序列长度的线性时间计算。在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上，与 DiJiang 相比，OAL 将冻结注意力输出的相对 MSE 降低了约 8.9%。替换中间层注意力模块，并使用 LoRA 联合微调核系数，与学习到的全局二次核相比，进一步将 WikiText-103 困惑度从 31.71 降至 27.50，同时提高了 PIQA、HellaSwag 和 ARC-E 上的准确率。这些结果证明了离群值感知维度分组在注意力近似和预训练模型转换中的价值。代码可在 https://github.com/wuqianyue09/OAL 获取。

papers.title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
papers.abstract: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complements GRPO and self-correction methods.
papers.title_cn: 注入一个轮次，而非一个词元：学习在何处重定向LLM推理以实现自我纠错
papers.abs_cn: 大型语言模型难以可靠地识别和纠正自身推理中的错误。与先前基于训练的方法（微调LLM以生成修订或反馈）不同，我们学习在失败的推理轨迹中于何处进行干预，并确定如何重定向它们。为了选择干预位置，我们在冻结编码器上训练了一个13万参数的MLP头，仅使用最终答案正确性作为信号。对于重定向，我们发现在校正预算固定的情况下，所测试的行内注入无法可靠地重定向推理，而以新的用户轮次呈现相同指令则能改变模型的推理方向。由此得到的纠错框架UPTURN（User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position，即在学习到的位置进行用户提示轮次注入）无需对LLM进行微调：它保留选定的前缀，以新的用户轮次注入指令，并重新生成后缀。在四个推理模型和六个数学基准上，UPTURN在每种设置下均优于32次采样基线，提升了平均准确率。在匹配的纠错预算下，它优于自我纠错和反思词元注入基线，无需重新训练即可跨推理模型迁移并泛化到GPQA-Diamond，且能与GRPO和自我纠错方法互补。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
papers.abstract: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.
papers.title_cn: 一种用于专用神经网络模型自动调优的多智能体LLM系统
papers.abs_cn: 许多机器学习方法采用两层结构：由专家选择一类方法，而在该类方法内部，关键组件的选择至关重要且通常依赖人工。本文针对这些组件的自动调优问题展开研究，并提出一个可跨不同性质模型迁移的框架。该多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架包含三种角色——分析师、编码者和记录者——并配备实验日志和沙箱化执行环境。与优化整个ML脚本或在离散空间中搜索架构的系统不同，该框架在一个开放但语义狭窄的空间中运行：智能体仅为指定组件生成代码，保持整体网络结构不变。该方法在两个方向上得到验证：调优具有相关性学习的分类脉冲神经网络，以及使用物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解高阶微分方程。在五个任务中——MNIST和Digits上的脉冲分类，以及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和Kuramoto--Sivashinsky（KS）方程的边值问题——该智能体均优于基线：分类准确率分别高出13个百分点（MNIST）和6个百分点（Digits）；与解析单孤子解的误差降低约2491倍；在选定的带高斯扰动的GNLSE运行中，不变量保持误差下降约325倍，在重复初始化下平均下降超过100倍；对于带高斯扰动的KS问题，质量漂移下降14倍。因此，该框架能够在不改变其内部结构的情况下，对不同性质任务中的关键组件进行调优。

papers.title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
papers.abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increasing the TTT task-variant count consistently helps only TRM, whereas VARC often performs better with fewer variants. VARC also remains competitive without pretraining, while TRM benefits much more from it. These results show that pretraining and TTT budgets affect ARC evaluation and motivate reporting at comparable budgets.
papers.title_cn: 预训练与测试时训练预算对 ARC 至关重要：VARC 与 TRM 的受控研究
papers.abs_cn: 抽象与推理语料库（ARC）越来越多地被用于评估神经网络能否从少量示例中推断出任务特定的变换。近期的 ARC 模型在架构上存在差异，但在更广泛的训练与评估协议上也各不相同，包括预训练数据、数据增强、测试时设置和优化预算，这使得关于架构优势的结论存在争议。在本工作中，我们在 ARC-AGI-1 上采用统一的归纳协议，研究受视觉启发的 VARC 和基于递归的 TRM 模型的性能如何受到预训练和测试时训练（TTT）预算的影响。对于每个测试任务，我们将五种预训练预算与四种 TTT 预算进行交叉组合。每种预算指定了任务变体数量和总样本呈现次数，从而定义了受控的训练预算。我们观察到，增加 TTT 样本呈现次数在所有设置下都能提升两个模型的标准 ARC pass@2 指标。增加 TTT 任务变体数量仅对 TRM 持续有帮助，而 VARC 通常在变体较少时表现更好。VARC 在没有预训练的情况下也保持竞争力，而 TRM 则从预训练中获益更多。这些结果表明，预训练和 TTT 预算会影响 ARC 评估，并促使人们在可比的预算下进行报告。

papers.title: Scalable Sparse Autoregressive Variational Inference for Non-Gaussian Spatial Fields
papers.abstract: Latent field models are essential for spatial statistics, but the posterior distribution of the latent field, even with a Gaussian process (GP) prior, is analytically intractable whenever the likelihood is non-Gaussian. Existing approximations are either too slow or too restrictive for large non-Gaussian datasets. We present a scalable variational inference framework that mirrors the sparse nearest-neighbor autoregressive structure of the prior in the variational family, uses normalizing-flow conditionals for expressiveness, and amortizes all variational parameters via a single shared neural conditioner. Doubly stochastic optimization with reduced ancestor sets achieves polylogarithmic complexity per iteration.
papers.title_cn: 面向非高斯空间场的可扩展稀疏自回归变分推断
papers.abs_cn: 潜场模型对空间统计至关重要，但只要似然是非高斯的，即使先验为高斯过程（GP），潜场的后验分布也无法解析求解。现有近似方法要么太慢，要么对大规模非高斯数据集限制过强。我们提出一个可扩展的变分推断框架，它在变分族中镜像先验的稀疏最近邻自回归结构，使用归一化流条件分布以增强表达能力，并通过单个共享神经调节器摊销所有变分参数。采用缩减祖先集的双随机优化使每次迭代达到多对数复杂度。

papers.title: TabReliBench: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models Beyond Predictive Accuracy
papers.abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular for their strong predictive performance. Many also provide posterior predictive distributions (PPDs), whose reliability remains less studied. We assess reliability through point prediction, distributional quality, marginal and subgroup calibration, and interval efficiency. We then introduce TabReliBench, a large classification and regression benchmark for these comparisons and dataset-level analyses. We find that TFMs' rankings change between TabArena and our benchmark and across reliability metrics. Regression TFMs usually achieve near-nominal marginal coverage and retain narrow intervals, but this favorable marginal behavior does not imply valid conditional coverage. Dataset-level analyses show that classification difficulty often accompanies poor calibration, whereas regression predictive performance is not a reliable indicator of calibration. Ensembling improves predictive performance but does not consistently improve calibration of PPDs; TFMs also benefit little from conformal post-processing, which does not reliably resolve subgroup gaps. Reliable TFM selection therefore requires multidimensional evaluation beyond aggregate rankings. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/TabReliBench.
papers.title_cn: TabReliBench：超越预测准确性评估表格基础模型
papers.abs_cn: 表格基础模型（TFMs）因其强大的预测性能而日益流行。许多模型还提供后验预测分布（PPDs），但其可靠性研究仍较少。我们通过点预测、分布质量、边际与子组校准以及区间效率来评估可靠性。随后，我们引入 TabReliBench，一个用于这些比较和数据集级分析的大型分类与回归基准。我们发现，TFMs 在 TabArena 与我们的基准之间的排名会发生变化，且在不同可靠性指标之间也有所不同。回归 TFMs 通常能达到接近名义的边际覆盖率并保持较窄的区间，但这种有利的边际表现并不意味着有效的条件覆盖率。数据集级分析表明，分类难度往往伴随较差的校准，而回归预测性能并不是校准的可靠指标。集成方法能提升预测性能，但并不能一致地改善 PPDs 的校准；TFMs 从保形后处理中获益也很少，且该方法无法可靠地解决子组差距。因此，可靠的 TFM 选择需要超越聚合排名的多维评估。代码见 https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/TabReliBench。

papers.title: A Critical Look at Power Sampling when Test Time Sharpening LLMs
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved LLM reasoning, yet growing evidence suggests it mainly performs distribution sharpening: concentrating probability mass on reasoning paths the base model already produces. Recent work therefore seeks RLVR's gains without needing reward signals, by sampling from the power distribution $π_α\propto π_{\text{base}}^α$ via Markov chain Monte Carlo or sequential Monte Carlo. We show that these samplers fail to converge to $π_α$ under realistic compute budgets, and that their gains are largely recreated via simple Best-of-$N$ with appropriate grading . This suggests they succeed by selecting high-probability sequences, not by approximating $π_α$, raising a natural question: is the power distribution itself a worthwhile target? We test this hypothesis directly by fine-tuning the base model to match $π_α$, sidestepping sampler convergence issues entirely. Despite approximating the target far more faithfully than existing samplers, this strategy yields gains that are noisy and specific to certain models and sampling tasks. Together, our results suggest that the value of power sampling lies not in faithfully targeting $π_α$, but in the simpler goal of extracting sequences the base model already deems likely.
papers.title_cn: 对测试时锐化大语言模型时幂采样的批判性审视
papers.abs_cn: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已大幅提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但越来越多的证据表明，它主要执行的是分布锐化：将概率质量集中到基础模型已经能够生成的推理路径上。因此，近期工作试图通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛或序贯蒙特卡洛从幂分布 $π_α∝π_{base}^α$ 中采样，从而无需奖励信号即可获得 RLVR 的收益。我们表明，这些采样器在现实计算预算下无法收敛到 $π_α$，并且它们的收益在很大程度上可以通过带有适当评分的简单 Best-of-N 重新实现。这表明它们成功的原因在于选择了高概率序列，而非逼近 $π_α$，从而引出一个自然的问题：幂分布本身是否是一个值得追求的目标？我们通过微调基础模型以匹配 $π_α$ 来直接检验这一假设，从而完全绕开采样器收敛问题。尽管该策略比现有采样器更忠实地逼近目标分布，其收益却是嘈杂的，并且特定于某些模型和采样任务。综合来看，我们的结果表明，幂采样的价值不在于忠实地瞄准 $π_α$，而在于一个更简单的目标：提取基础模型已经认为可能的序列。

papers.title: Electron-Density-Informed Molecular Property Prediction Using Surrogate Functionals
papers.abstract: Machine learning methods are increasingly used to predict chemical properties directly from the molecular structure to bypass the often prohibitive cost of quantum mechanical calculations. Recent work has shown that including the ground-state electron density as input to the machine learning model can improve accuracy in this setting. This work employs the recent surrogate functional framework originally developed for orbital-free density functional theory and extends it to predicting molecular properties. We show that passing the ground-state density as input to the model, while simultaneously enforcing it to be the minimum of the surrogate functional, surpasses state-of-the-art performance for six out of seven extensive properties of the QM9 dataset. Additionally, the approach shows improved generalization to larger molecules taken from the QM40 dataset. On all extensive properties of both datasets, our approach outperforms models that are informed by the ground-state density but do not enforce the surrogate functional constraints.
papers.title_cn: 基于代理泛函的电子密度信息分子性质预测
papers.abs_cn: 机器学习方法越来越多地被用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算往往高昂的成本。近期研究表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高此类任务的精度。本工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的代理泛函框架，并将其扩展至分子性质预测。我们表明，将基态密度作为模型输入，同时约束其为代理泛函的最小值，在 QM9 数据集的七个广延性质中有六个超越了当前最优性能。此外，该方法在来自 QM40 数据集的更大分子上展现出更好的泛化能力。在两个数据集的所有广延性质上，我们的方法均优于那些以基态密度为输入但未施加代理泛函约束的模型。

papers.title: SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data
papers.abstract: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection. We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models. Our results reveal clear trade-offs across predictive performance, runtime, stability, and validity. Tree-based methods, CART and RFImportance, along with F-Test are Pareto-optimal when taking into account predictive performance and runtime. F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics. Search-based methods are slow, unstable and achieve low performance. SelectArena turns these findings into practical guidance and, as an extensible platform, supports future feature selection research.
papers.title_cn: SelectArena：面向真实世界表格数据的现代特征选择基准
papers.abs_cn: 从表格数据集中选择特征（列）的子集是现实应用中普遍存在的挑战。行业专家希望最小化模型训练成本，气候科学家需要可解释的因素子集来理解极端天气事件，临床医生则因财务和时间限制需要在诊断测试中做出选择。在查阅科学文献以确定使用哪种特征选择方法时，各领域的从业者面临着缺乏代表性的基准测试格局。尽管已有大量研究，现有的特征选择基准提供的指导有限，因为它们依赖于过时的模型、临时的评估协议或无法反映现实问题的人工生成数据。为弥合科学基准测试与现实应用之间的差距，我们推出了 SelectArena，一个面向特征选择的现代基准。我们在 71 个手动整理的真实世界表格数据集上，使用标准化评估协议和最先进的表格（基础）模型，比较了 15 种广泛使用的特征选择方法，涵盖分类和回归问题。我们的结果揭示了在预测性能、运行时间、稳定性和有效性之间明确的权衡。综合考虑预测性能和运行时间时，基于树的方法 CART 和 RFImportance 以及 F-Test 处于 Pareto 最优。F-Test、基于信息论和基于距离的方法在稳定性和有效性方面领先，其中 F-Test 在我们的各项指标中成为均衡的选择。基于搜索的方法速度慢、不稳定且性能较低。SelectArena 将这些发现转化为实用指导，并作为一个可扩展平台支持未来的特征选择研究。

papers.title: Model-agnostic Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning for Weakly Annotated Bioimaging Data
papers.abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly used for automated feature extraction from weakly annotated bioimaging data, such as microscopy and cytomorphology images. Due to the sole dependency of automated feature extraction, existing methods yield inconsistent classification performance across weakly annotated datasets. Here, we propose a model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that enables ML models to exploit domain knowledge beyond what automated feature extraction can capture. The proposed approach improves classification performance across seven ML architectures. When integrated with masked autoencoder-based self-supervised learning, our method achieves the strongest overall performance, improving precision by 2.9% over the next-best method on three in-house microscopy datasets and by an average of 6.8% across three public cytomorphology benchmarks. We perform nucleus-level classification based on mislocalization of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, a phenotype linked to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), using three independent microscopy datasets of motor neurons derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells. Accurate quantification of this phenotype at scale remains challenging and may contribute to inconsistencies across studies. Application of the best-performing model to these microscopy datasets reveals biological interpretations related to ALS, including dose-dependent effects of the proteasomal stressor, MG132, and the oxidative stressor, sodium arsenite (SA), on TDP-43 mislocalization, variable pathology in motor neurons from sporadic and familial ALS donors, and a lack of protection of the pharmacological compounds, edaravone and niclosamide, against SA-induced TDP-43 mislocalization. Together, our pipeline enables in-vitro cellular image analysis to advance understanding of ALS-associated pathology and potential treatments.
papers.title_cn: 模型无关的知识增强机器学习用于弱标注生物成像数据
papers.abs_cn: 机器学习模型越来越多地用于从弱标注生物成像数据（如显微镜和细胞形态学图像）中自动提取特征。由于仅依赖自动特征提取，现有方法在弱标注数据集上的分类性能不一致。在此，我们提出了一种模型无关的知识增强方法，使机器学习模型能够利用自动特征提取无法捕获的领域知识。所提出的方法在七种机器学习架构上提升了分类性能。当与基于掩码自编码器的自监督学习集成时，我们的方法实现了最强的整体性能，在三个内部显微镜数据集上比次优方法提高了 2.9% 的精确度，在三个公开细胞形态学基准上平均提高了 6.8%。我们基于 TAR DNA 结合蛋白 43（TDP-43）从细胞核到细胞质的错误定位，对细胞核水平进行分类，该表型与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）相关，使用了三个独立的来自人诱导多能干细胞来源运动神经元的显微镜数据集。大规模准确量化该表型仍然具有挑战性，并可能导致研究之间的不一致。将表现最佳的模型应用于这些显微镜数据集，揭示了与 ALS 相关的生物学解释，包括蛋白酶体应激剂 MG132 和氧化应激剂亚砷酸钠（SA）对 TDP-43 错误定位的剂量依赖性效应、散发性和家族性 ALS 供体运动神经元中的可变病理，以及药理化合物依达拉奉和氯硝柳胺对 SA 诱导的 TDP-43 错误定位缺乏保护作用。总之，我们的流程使得体外细胞图像分析能够推进对 ALS 相关病理和潜在治疗方法的理解。

papers.title: PANDA: Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture
papers.abstract: Hypergraph Neural Networks (HNNs), designed to model higher-order relations beyond pairwise interactions, typically rely either on fixed structural weights or on normalised attention. Fixed weights can propagate misleading information in heterophilic settings, while normalisation makes attention coefficients competitive, in the sense that, in a message-passing framework, increasing the weight of one sender must reduce the weight of others in the same aggregation set. Our main contribution is the introduction of PANDA (Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture), a plug-in for two-stage message passing HNNs applicable to both undirected and directed settings. The main path interpolates between learned receiver-normalised attention and structural incidence priors, while a non-competitive (not normalised) auxiliary path lets each sender contribute its own transformed information. We also show that, with fixed structural coefficients, PANDA recovers a certain complex-valued convolution operator adopted in previous works. Across four HNNs spanning spatial and spectral methods in both directed and undirected settings, plugging PANDA in yields an average improvement of 5.18 percentage points across eight real-world benchmark datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/jainris/panda.
papers.title_cn: PANDA：先验引导的注意力双路径架构
papers.abs_cn: 超图神经网络（HNNs）旨在建模超越成对交互的高阶关系，通常依赖于固定的结构权重或归一化注意力。固定权重在同配性较差的设置中可能传播误导性信息，而归一化使注意力系数具有竞争性，即在消息传递框架中，增加一个发送者的权重必然减少同一聚合集合中其他发送者的权重。我们的主要贡献是引入 PANDA（先验引导的注意力双路径架构），这是一种适用于两阶段消息传递 HNNs 的插件，适用于无向和有向设置。主路径在学习到的接收者归一化注意力与结构关联先验之间进行插值，而非竞争性（未归一化）的辅助路径允许每个发送者贡献其自身变换后的信息。我们还表明，在固定结构系数下，PANDA 恢复了先前工作中采用的某种复值卷积算子。在涵盖有向和无向设置下空间与谱方法的四个 HNNs 中，插入 PANDA 在八个真实世界基准数据集上平均提升了 5.18 个百分点。代码可在 https://github.com/jainris/panda 获取。

papers.title: Private and Distributionally Robust Federated Multiclass Classification
papers.abstract: Fault diagnosis in asset-intensive industries requires multiclass models trained on noisy, sensitive data collected across geographically distributed client sites. Federated learning enables collaborative training without centralizing data, but most approaches do not provide formal privacy guarantees for individual records stored at client sites and can degrade under label noise. To address these limitations, we develop a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification that provides sample-level privacy for records stored at each client. We build on a federated Wasserstein distributionally robust multiclass objective with the Crammer-Singer loss, solved using an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. To protect the released client updates, our method injects calibrated Gaussian noise into the proximal linearized client updates of both the local model and the local distributionally robust variable before aggregation at the central server, and we quantify the cumulative privacy loss using the moments accountant. We provide per-round sample-level $(ε,δ)$-differential privacy guarantees and an overall composed privacy guarantee across all training rounds, together with convergence results and an explicit privacy-utility tradeoff. Experiments on simulated industrial fault data and UCI benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms differentially private federated empirical risk minimization and stochastic gradient descent baselines in most tested settings, with the largest gains under strong privacy-induced noise.
papers.title_cn: 私有且分布鲁棒的联邦多类分类
papers.abs_cn: 资产密集型行业中的故障诊断需要多类模型，这些模型在跨地理分布式客户端站点收集的噪声、敏感数据上进行训练。联邦学习能够在不集中数据的情况下进行协作训练，但大多数方法无法为存储在客户端站点上的个体记录提供形式化隐私保证，并且在标签噪声下性能可能下降。为解决这些局限，我们开发了一个差分私有、分布鲁棒的联邦多类分类框架，为每个客户端存储的记录提供样本级隐私。我们基于采用 Crammer-Singer 损失的联邦 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒多类目标，并使用基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的算法求解。为保护发布的客户端更新，我们的方法在中央服务器聚合之前，将校准的高斯噪声注入到本地模型和本地分布鲁棒变量的近端线性化客户端更新中，并使用矩会计量化累积隐私损失。我们提供每轮样本级 $(ε,δ)$-差分隐私保证以及跨所有训练轮次的总体组合隐私保证，并给出收敛结果和显式的隐私-效用权衡。在模拟工业故障数据和 UCI 基准数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在大多数测试设置中优于差分私有联邦经验风险最小化和随机梯度下降基线，在强隐私诱导噪声下增益最大。

papers.title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.
papers.title_cn: 多流注意力残差
papers.abs_cn: 注意力残差（AttnRes）能够在网络深度方向上进行依赖内容的检索，可视为沿深度轴的单流 softmax 注意力。受序列轴上多头注意力成功的启发，我们提出了多流注意力残差（MSAR），这是 AttnRes 的扩展，将该机制推广到多头深度注意力，以极小的额外开销带来显著的性能提升。MSAR 通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文中获取流多样性，使不同的头能够通过不同的上下文视角检索历史表示，同时保持隐藏表示的完整性。检索到的流通过轻量级自适应混合进行组合，以生成单流层输入。通过保留单流源并按需扩展，MSAR 支持多流计算，而无需持久的多流存储或通信。在 18B 和 28B MoE 规模的全部 12 个下游基准上，MSAR 始终优于先前的残差变体，包括标准残差连接、流形约束超连接（mHC）和 AttnRes。缩放律实验相对于标准残差基线实现了 1.58 倍的等损失计算加速，而 AttnRes 为 1.35 倍，mHC 为 1.30 倍。这些结果使 MSAR 成为大规模预训练中一个有前景的残差架构。

papers.title: JitterVLA: A Replay Benchmark for Motion Quality in VLA-Driven Human-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller's effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.
papers.title_cn: JitterVLA：VLA驱动的人-机器人操作中运动质量的回放基准
papers.abs_cn: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略发出稀疏目标，这些目标到达机器人控制器时存在延迟且不规则，因此即使预测动作合理，在人员附近仍可能产生突变运动。现有补救措施在不同数据流、延迟和指标上进行评估。JitterVLA通过替代控制器回放相同的命令和到达轨迹，从而隔离控制器的影响。我们将其应用于合成到达任务、20人的手部轨迹、三个开源VLA流水线（838个回合）以及一台物理UR3。插值降低了所有来源的建模p99 jerk，在200 ms延迟下对人体运动降低了83%（从615降至106 m/s^3），跟踪代价为2.0 cm，且该效果在598个新回合上得到复现；jerk受限生成以更大代价进一步降低了jerk。熵-不连续性关联在两个流水线中具有相反且可复现的符号，熵门控在一个流水线中有帮助，但在另一个中没有。在UR3上，插值在所有六对探索性实验中使加速度计导出的jerk降低了3.0-14.0%，而位置导出的指标未能分辨出该对比。JitterVLA支持在以人为中心的研究之前进行筛选；代码和数据将发布。

papers.title: AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. At the released sizes, F1 RMSE is 0.00-2.58 percentage points versus 4.44-7.41 for uniform sampling with HT weights; conservative intervals remain broad. Under the evaluated graph prompts, seven open-weight LLMs have weighted precision near the predict-all-illicit baseline. In an outcome-stratified audit of 1,000 HI-Small few-shot outputs from one run per model, lexical checks pass for 84.5% of correct and 56.2% of incorrect binary verdicts, so these markers do not establish correctness. We release the evaluation sets, construction code, and audit tools at https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval and https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact.
papers.title_cn: AMLworld-Compact：重要性加权降采样用于低成本LLM评估与错误诊断
papers.abs_cn: 在AMLworld最小的测试集上评估大语言模型（LLM）成本高昂，因为超过一百万个目标中的每一个都需要单独的图提示。采样可以降低这一成本，但小型平衡子集会改变未加权的精确率和F1。我们引入AMLworld-Compact，这是一个评估集，保留所有非法测试交易，并从监督分数分层中采样良性交易。其HT-Coreset协议在HI-Small和LI-Small上将评估目标分别减少271倍和611倍。Horvitz-Thompson权重为固定预测提供无偏的全测试混淆计数估计；召回率是精确的，而精确率和F1是比率估计。在一项使用图特征预处理器（GFP）特征的留出研究中，一个提升树家族定义分层，用于在每种配置超过500次抽取中评估另一个。在发布的规模下，F1的RMSE为0.00-2.58个百分点，而使用HT权重的均匀采样为4.44-7.41；保守区间仍然较宽。在所评估的图提示下，七个开放权重LLM的加权精确率接近全预测为非法的基线。在对每个模型一次运行的1,000个HI-Small少样本输出进行的结果分层审计中，词汇检查在84.5%的正确和56.2%的错误二元判定中通过，因此这些标记不能确立正确性。我们在https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval和https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact发布了评估集、构建代码和审计工具。

papers.title: Kernel-based External Validity of Experimental Studies
papers.abstract: The external validity of a study is the extent to which its findings generalize to unseen experimental conditions, such as datasets. We formalize the results of a study together with its research question, and define external validity as the probability that two independent and same-sized replications of the study produce results whose maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) is below a given tolerance. This approach, centered on the choice of a space of results and of an appropriate reproducing kernel for the MMD, is flexible enough to be deployed on multiple different types of results and research questions. Additionally, we establish an asymptotic power-law relation between the size of a study and the quantiles of the MMD, which we use to estimate the desired size of an externally valid study from a small-scale preliminary study. We deploy our framework to rankings with ties and discuss kernels suited to different research questions. Experiments on existing case studies and on a simulated newly designed study illustrate the applicability of the framework. We release our code as part of the genexpy Python module.
papers.title_cn: 基于核的实验研究外部有效性
papers.abs_cn: 一项研究的外部有效性是指其发现能够推广到未见实验条件（如数据集）的程度。我们将研究结果与其研究问题一起形式化，并将外部有效性定义为：两次独立且规模相同的重复研究产生的结果，其最大均值差异（MMD）低于给定容差的概率。这种方法以结果空间的选择和适用于MMD的合适再生核为中心，足够灵活，可应用于多种不同类型的结果和研究问题。此外，我们建立了研究规模与MMD分位数之间的渐近幂律关系，并利用该关系从小规模初步研究估计具有外部有效性的研究所需规模。我们将该框架应用于带并列的排名，并讨论了适用于不同研究问题的核。在现有案例研究和一项模拟的新设计研究上的实验说明了该框架的适用性。我们将代码作为genexpy Python模块的一部分发布。

papers.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
papers.abstract: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications. These environments create safety risks that are difficult to capture with attacks placed at a single, known read location. We introduce APEX-Harm, a benchmark for evaluating prompt and script injection against long-horizon agents performing finance, consulting, and legal tasks in large workspaces. Each task contains 115 to 328 files, together with email, calendar, chat, document, spreadsheet, PDF, and code-execution tools exposed through MCP servers. The benchmark includes six attack categories covering static and dynamic injections, task-specific script replacement, and attacker-provided generic scripts, and evaluates attack success, exposure, and task performance. We evaluate 12 frontier models on 180 task instances per model. Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 have the lowest overall attack success rates (8% and 20%), while task-specific script replacement and attacker-provided generic script attacks remain substantially more effective, averaging 81-84% and 73% attack success, respectively. Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the highest mean task score (0.877) while still exhibiting a 33% attack success rate. These results show that completing the requested task is not sufficient evidence of safe behavior: an agent can produce a correct deliverable while also performing an unauthorized action in the workspace.
papers.title_cn: APEX-Harm：评估共享专业工作空间中的智能体安全性
papers.abs_cn: 专业智能体越来越多地通过命令行界面和多种工具，在包含文件、消息和业务应用的共享工作空间中工作。这些环境带来的安全风险难以通过放置在单一已知读取位置的攻击来捕捉。我们提出了 APEX-Harm，一个用于评估针对在大型工作空间中执行金融、咨询和法律任务的长时程智能体的提示注入和脚本注入的基准。每个任务包含 115 到 328 个文件，以及通过 MCP 服务器暴露的电子邮件、日历、聊天、文档、电子表格、PDF 和代码执行工具。该基准包含六个攻击类别，涵盖静态和动态注入、任务特定脚本替换以及攻击者提供的通用脚本，并评估攻击成功率、暴露程度和任务性能。我们在每个模型 180 个任务实例上评估了 12 个前沿模型。Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 的总体攻击成功率最低（8% 和 20%），而任务特定脚本替换和攻击者提供的通用脚本攻击仍然显著更有效，平均攻击成功率分别为 81-84% 和 73%。Gemini 3.8 Flash 取得了最高的平均任务得分（0.877），同时仍表现出 33% 的攻击成功率。这些结果表明，完成所请求的任务并不足以证明行为是安全的：智能体可以在产生正确交付物的同时，在工作空间中执行未经授权的操作。

papers.title: Training User Simulators with Latent Intrinsic Feedback
papers.abstract: User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. We train LLM-based simulators using interaction logs between real users and assistants and demonstrate that intrinsic feedback improves simulation realism and critiquing behaviors versus prompted simulator baselines, while also providing turn-level evaluations that existing fine-tuned simulators lack. Further, evaluations generated by our trained simulators correlate better with human judgments than those of prompted simulators of the same size. Lastly, our experiments reveal that simulators with intrinsic feedback provide effective reward signals for multi-turn RL training, matching setups that rely on external judge LLMs for rewards while cutting RL compute by more than half.
papers.title_cn: 训练具有潜在内在反馈的用户模拟器
papers.abs_cn: 用户模拟器作为训练 LLM 助手的环境正受到越来越多的关注，这些助手能够更好地应对与真实用户多轮对话中的细微差别。以往关于用户模拟的工作主要强调生成逼真的用户话语，而对其作为助手回复直接反馈来源的潜力尚未探索。这种评估信号可能不会以语言形式明确传达，而是存在于用户的潜在推理中。在这项工作中，我们引入了具有内在反馈的用户模拟器，即配备潜在评估状态的模型：在每一轮对话中，从第一人称用户视角评估助手的内部想法、反应和标量评分。我们使用真实用户与助手之间的交互日志来训练基于 LLM 的模拟器，并证明与提示式模拟器基线相比，内在反馈提高了模拟的真实性和评判行为，同时还提供了现有微调模拟器所缺乏的轮级评估。此外，我们训练出的模拟器所生成的评估与人类判断的相关性优于同等规模的提示式模拟器。最后，我们的实验表明，具有内在反馈的模拟器为多轮 RL 训练提供了有效的奖励信号，其效果与依赖外部评判 LLM 提供奖励的设置相当，同时将 RL 计算量减少了一半以上。

papers.title: OpenH-RF: A Large-Scale Ultrasound Raw Channel Dataset Initiative
papers.abstract: Medical ultrasound is a widely accessible, real-time imaging modality, yet progress in data-driven ultrasound research is constrained by the scarcity of large, open collections of raw channel data. Existing public datasets are predominantly based on reconstructed images, while the smaller number of open raw channel datasets is generally specialized to individual reconstruction or imaging tasks, limiting the development of general-purpose methods and foundation models that operate directly on ultrasound signals. While interpretive tasks can be performed on reconstructed images, many of the key technical challenges in ultrasound imaging, such as aberration correction and reverberation reduction, require the raw channel data itself. We introduce OpenH-RF, a community-driven open dataset initiative comprising approximately 40 TB of medical ultrasound raw channel data in 19,332 acquisitions, contributed by 38 institutions across academia and industry, spanning in-vivo, phantom, and simulated data. Each dataset is annotated with a number of supported tasks, ranging from generalized reconstruction, speed-of-sound estimation, and aberration correction to blood flow imaging, motion estimation, quantitative ultrasound, and image interpretation. OpenH-RF provides a unified, self-contained data format that captures raw channel data together with the acquisition, probe, metadata, and reconstruction information required for reproducible processing across scanners and acquisition schemes. The corpus is publicly hosted under a permissive CC BY 4.0 license and can be streamed programmatically and selectively at scale. By bringing heterogeneous ultrasound data into a common representation, backed by modern data infrastructure, OpenH-RF lowers the barrier to working with raw channel data and aims to open medical ultrasound research to new communities. See https://open-h.github.io/OpenH-RF.
papers.title_cn: OpenH-RF：大规模超声原始通道数据集倡议
papers.abs_cn: 医学超声是一种广泛可及、实时的成像模态，然而数据驱动的超声研究进展受限于大规模、开放的原始通道数据集的稀缺。现有的公开数据集主要基于重建图像，而数量较少的开放原始通道数据集通常专门针对单个重建或成像任务，限制了直接在超声信号上运行的通用方法和基础模型的发展。虽然解释性任务可以在重建图像上执行，但超声成像中的许多关键技术挑战，如像差校正和混响抑制，需要原始通道数据本身。我们提出 OpenH-RF，一个社区驱动的开放数据集倡议，包含约 40 TB 的医学超声原始通道数据，涵盖 19,332 次采集，由 38 个来自学术界和工业界的机构贡献，涵盖在体、体模和仿真数据。每个数据集都标注了若干支持的任务，从广义重建、声速估计和像差校正到血流成像、运动估计、定量超声和图像解释。OpenH-RF 提供了一种统一、自包含的数据格式，将原始通道数据与采集、探头、元数据和重建信息一起捕获，以实现跨扫描仪和采集方案的可重复处理。该语料库在宽松的 CC BY 4.0 许可下公开托管，并可以大规模地以编程方式选择性流式传输。通过将异构超声数据纳入由现代数据基础设施支持的通用表示，OpenH-RF 降低了使用原始通道数据的门槛，旨在向新社区开放医学超声研究。参见 https://open-h.github.io/OpenH-RF。

papers.title: Some remarks on the connection between generative diffusion and optimal transport
papers.abstract: We discuss three simple connections between generative diffusion and optimal transport. First, the joint law of the data and of their Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noising is, at every time, the solution of an entropic optimal-transport problem, at a temperature set by the noise level. Backward diffusion can consequently be read as an annealing which gradually decreases the entropic regularization. Second, we study the speciation transition--how the modes of the data distribution emerge during generation--and compare how it happens in diffusion and flow matching with respect to optimal transport. Using Gaussian mixtures as high-dimensional example, we show that the dynamical instability through which diffusion and flow matching separate the modes becomes, for optimal transport, an exponentially thin boundary layer at the beginning of generation, which is rounded by entropic regularization. Third, considering a generic forward dynamics with a general confining potential, we show that the backward process driven by the score also satisfies a drift-based variational principle whose minimal cost is the entropy difference between initial and final distributions.
papers.title_cn: 关于生成扩散与最优传输之间联系的若干注记
papers.abs_cn: 我们讨论了生成扩散与最优传输之间的三个简单联系。首先，数据及其 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 加噪的联合分布在任意时刻都是熵正则最优传输问题的解，其温度由噪声水平设定。因此，反向扩散可以被解读为一种逐渐降低熵正则化的退火过程。其次，我们研究了物种形成转变——即数据分布的各模态在生成过程中如何涌现——并比较了扩散和流匹配相对于最优传输中这一过程的发生方式。以高斯混合作为高维例子，我们表明扩散和流匹配借以分离各模态的动态不稳定性，对于最优传输而言，在生成开始时变成了一个指数级薄的边界层，而该边界层被熵正则化所圆滑。第三，考虑具有一般约束势的一般前向动力学，我们表明由 score 驱动的反向过程也满足一个基于漂移的变分原理，其最小代价是初始分布与最终分布之间的熵差。

papers.title: Vocal Intensity Conversion with Continuous SPL Control via Adversarial Training
papers.abstract: Vocal intensity conversion renders a recorded utterance at a different vocal intensity, rather than simply scaling its amplitude, while preserving its content and speaker identity. Existing systems control intensity through a reference utterance or a few discrete categories. Instead, we control the conversion with any target sound pressure level (SPL) on a continuous dB scale. A lightweight converter, trained as a conditional cycle-consistent GAN without parallel data, transforms the features of a frozen speech encoder, from which a pretrained vocoder resynthesizes the speech. We compare three representations, log-mel spectrograms, WavLM, and SpeechTokenizer, and introduce an objective protocol that measures the achieved intensity change against the target one on a calibrated corpus. With WavLM, the converter achieves a measured 83% of the target change in intensity and also shifts the fundamental frequency. A perceptual evaluation confirms that perceived vocal intensity increases with the target level on amplitude-normalized stimuli.
papers.title_cn: 通过对抗训练实现连续SPL控制的嗓音强度转换
papers.abs_cn: 嗓音强度转换是将录制的语音以不同的嗓音强度呈现，而非简单地缩放其振幅，同时保持其内容和说话人身份。现有系统通过参考话语或几个离散类别来控制强度。相反，我们使用连续dB尺度上的任意目标声压级（SPL）来控制转换。一个轻量级转换器被训练为条件循环一致GAN，无需平行数据，转换冻结语音编码器的特征，然后由预训练声码器重新合成语音。我们比较了三种表示：log-mel频谱图、WavLM和SpeechTokenizer，并引入了一个客观协议，在校准语料库上测量实现的强度变化与目标变化之间的差异。使用WavLM时，转换器实现了目标强度变化的83%，并且还改变了基频。感知评估证实，在振幅归一化的刺激上，感知到的嗓音强度随目标水平增加而增加。

papers.title: BLiMPPI: Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Polarity Items
papers.abstract: Negative polarity items (NPIs), such as "anymore" and "ever", are grammatical only in select environments, predominantly in the context of negation. Because their grammaticality depends on both syntax and semantics, they have a rich, multilingual literature in theoretical linguistics, yet work on NPIs in language models is almost entirely confined to English. We introduce BLiMPPI, a multilingual evaluation suite of over 12,000 NPI minimal pairs in 33 languages, built by a pipeline that discovers NPIs in Universal Dependencies (UD) treebanks, labels their licensing environments, and perturbs these into minimal pairs. Evaluating 12 multilingual and 2 monolingual models alongside n-gram baselines, we find that multilingual models struggle most with lower-resource languages and with pairs that are not n-gram solvable. We further examine the effects of NPI typology, language family, licensing variability, and NPI-licenser distance. Data: https://github.com/arzuburcuguven/blimppi-data
papers.title_cn: BLiMPPI：极性项的语言学最小对基准
papers.abs_cn: 否定极性项（NPIs），如“anymore”和“ever”，仅在特定环境中合乎语法，主要是在否定语境中。由于其语法性同时取决于句法和语义，它们在理论语言学中有着丰富的多语言文献，然而语言模型中关于NPI的研究几乎完全局限于英语。我们提出了BLiMPPI，一个涵盖33种语言、超过12,000个NPI最小对的多语言评估套件，其构建流程包括在通用依存（UD）树库中发现NPI、标注其允准环境，并将其扰动为最小对。在评估12个多语言模型和2个单语言模型以及n-gram基线后，我们发现多语言模型在低资源语言以及无法通过n-gram解决的最小对上表现最为困难。我们进一步考察了NPI类型学、语系、允准变异性和NPI-允准词距离的影响。数据：https://github.com/arzuburcuguven/blimppi-data

papers.title: CorrFlow: Exact and Permutation-Equivariant Flow Matching on the Correlation Elliptope
papers.abstract: Correlation matrices combine nonlinear positive-definiteness constraints with a simultaneous row-column permutation symmetry. Their generation therefore involves two distinct problems. First, every output must remain on the correlation elliptope, irrespective of how its variables are ordered. Second, the generator must learn the domain-specific distribution occupied by empirical data inside that valid space. Existing financial image generators mix these problems: they learn ordered matrix entries and repair invalid draws afterward. We introduce CorrFlow, which separates them. A generalized Fisher transform maps full-rank correlation matrices bijectively to unconstrained coordinates, guaranteeing valid outputs without projection. A graph flow-matching network learns the empirical distribution in those coordinates and is permutation equivariant: reordering the variables only reorders the output. We compare a conditional CorrGAN reimplementation, image diffusion, and CorrFlow on $80\times80$ Taiwan equity matrices using five seeds per neural method. CorrFlow produces 100% valid draws without repair and obtains feature sliced-Wasserstein distance $.712\pm.141$, versus $4.339\pm.252$ for CorrGAN and $4.610\pm.191$ for image diffusion after their invalid outputs are projected back to the correlation space. It also improves this distance over historical lookup, while lookup retains higher local coverage. These results support the combined construction under the evaluated training budget; they do not establish superiority over fully tuned image models or isolate the contribution of each component.
papers.title_cn: CorrFlow：在相关椭圆体上精确且置换等变的流匹配
papers.abs_cn: 相关矩阵将非线性正定性约束与同时的行列置换对称性结合在一起。因此，它们的生成涉及两个不同的问题。首先，无论变量如何排序，每个输出都必须保持在相关椭圆体上。其次，生成器必须学习经验数据在该有效空间内所占的特定领域分布。现有的金融图像生成器将这两个问题混在一起：它们学习有序的矩阵条目，并在事后修复无效抽样。我们提出了 CorrFlow，将二者分离。一个广义 Fisher 变换将满秩相关矩阵双射映射到无约束坐标，从而无需投影即可保证输出有效。一个图流匹配网络在这些坐标中学习经验分布，并且是置换等变的：重新排列变量只会重新排列输出。我们在 $80	imes80$ 台湾股票矩阵上比较了条件 CorrGAN 复现、图像扩散和 CorrFlow，每种神经方法使用五个种子。CorrFlow 在无需修复的情况下产生 100% 有效抽样，并获得特征切片-Wasserstein 距离 $.712\pm.141$，而 CorrGAN 为 $4.339\pm.252$，图像扩散在其无效输出被投影回相关空间后为 $4.610\pm.191$。它还在该距离上优于历史查找，而查找保持了更高的局部覆盖。这些结果在评估的训练预算下支持该组合构造；它们并未确立相对于完全调优的图像模型的优越性，也未分离每个组件的贡献。

papers.title: zip2zip++: Towards Inference-Time Token Compression with Minimal Quality Loss
papers.abstract: Dynamic vocabularies built on-the-fly via Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) compression let a language model represent the same text in fewer tokens, but prior work shows that this efficiency comes at a cost to reasoning and perplexity. We show that this quality gap is not a fundamental price of compression but can be substantially closed through targeted improvements to the compression layer and LZW codec, without modifying the underlying pretrained language model. Our analysis reveals four key issues: (1) LZW's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding, a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve; (2) naively applying RoPE to LZW-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens; (3) merging certain tokens (notably digits) disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy; and (4) dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. We address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer, size-aware RoPE positioning, and a modified LZW codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. Across four models, our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy, closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. This represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.
papers.title_cn: zip2zip++：迈向推理时最小质量损失的 token 压缩
papers.abs_cn: 通过 Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) 压缩动态构建的词汇表让语言模型能用更少的 token 表示相同文本，但先前工作表明这种效率以推理能力和困惑度为代价。我们表明这一质量差距并非压缩的根本代价，而是可以通过对压缩层和 LZW 编解码器进行针对性改进来大幅弥合，且无需修改底层预训练语言模型。我们的分析揭示了四个关键问题：(1) LZW 的压缩算法在输入嵌入和输出嵌入之间造成隐式冲突，这是单一共享嵌入无法解决的张力；(2) 将 RoPE 朴素地应用于 LZW 压缩序列忽略了合并后的 token 可能跨越多个 token；(3) 合并某些 token（尤其是数字）会不成比例地损害下游准确率；(4) 动态词汇表引入了固有的分词歧义，干扰了标准评估。我们通过解耦的输入/输出动态嵌入层、尺寸感知的 RoPE 定位，以及支持选择性合并和多视图分词的改进 LZW 编解码器来解决这些问题。在四个模型上，我们的方案在我们评估的每个语料上都改善了困惑度以及数学推理准确率，在通用文本上以相近压缩比弥合了 zip2zip 与未压缩基线之间约一半的质量差距。这代表了朝着语言模型无损自适应词汇压缩迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: A small cognitive core explains human behavior at scale
papers.abstract: Psychology has proposed many principles of cognition. Each, however, was developed in isolation, leaving their combined explanatory power unknown. We assembled a small set of established principles into one model, which we call COntextual Retrieval and Encoding (CORE). CORE consists of a hierarchy of episodic memories into which prediction errors are written and whose encoding, retrieval, and forgetting depend on context. Fitted jointly to 7,036,442 choices from 137 experiments, the model predicts human choices better than black-box models and reproduces 75% of reported behavioral effects when simulated. Moreover, its latent variables show classic signatures of Bayesian learning and event segmentation. Taken together, these findings suggest that a small cognitive core accounts for much of human behavior. They also open a path toward making psychology more than the sum of its parts, by building computational models on the entire experimental record.
papers.title_cn: 一个小型认知核心解释了大规模的人类行为
papers.abs_cn: 心理学提出了许多认知原则。然而，每一条原则都是孤立发展的，其联合解释力尚不明确。我们将一小组已确立的原则整合为一个模型，称之为情境检索与编码（CORE）。CORE 由情节记忆的层级结构组成，预测误差被写入其中，其编码、检索和遗忘依赖于情境。该模型联合拟合了来自 137 个实验的 7,036,442 次选择，在预测人类选择方面优于黑箱模型，并在模拟时再现了 75% 的已报告行为效应。此外，其潜在变量显示出贝叶斯学习和事件分割的经典特征。综上所述，这些发现表明一个小型认知核心解释了人类行为的很大一部分。它们还开辟了一条道路，使心理学不再只是其各部分的总和，而是通过在整个实验记录上构建计算模型来实现。

papers.title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Diagnostic information in multi-view medical imaging studies, like echocardiography, is distributed across views, each capturing different aspects of cardiac structure and function. In clinical practice, these views are first interpreted through quantitative measurements, which then support specific diagnoses. However, existing echo representation learning methods do not explicitly model measurements as an intermediate representation between views and diagnosis. As a result, individual measurements are not explicitly represented in a form that downstream diagnostic tasks can selectively use, hindering accurate diagnosis. Inspired by this hierarchical clinical workflow, we introduce EchoTab, a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that represents multi-view echocardiography studies using measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis. Each measurement token selectively attends to the views relevant to its estimation and is trained through tabular reconstruction to predict the corresponding measurement value. The resulting tokens form a factorized echo representation, which encode clinically meaningful structural and functional properties and can be selectively used for downstream diagnosis. Unlike the commonly used contrastive approaches, EchoTab does not require negative samples or large batch sizes. Experiments on two datasets demonstrate that EchoTab learns effective measurement-grounded representations that improve diagnosis classification in multi-view echocardiography and its learned attention aligns with established measurement-view relationships used by cardiologists. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/michelleespranita/EchoTab.
papers.title_cn: EchoTab：通过表格重建学习基于测量的超声心动图诊断表示
papers.abs_cn: 在多视图医学影像研究（如超声心动图）中，诊断信息分布在各个视图中，每个视图捕捉心脏结构和功能的不同方面。在临床实践中，这些视图首先通过定量测量进行解读，进而支持具体诊断。然而，现有的超声心动图表示学习方法并未明确将测量建模为视图与诊断之间的中间表示。因此，单个测量并未以可供下游诊断任务选择性使用的形式被显式表示，从而阻碍了准确诊断。受这一分层临床工作流程的启发，我们提出了 EchoTab，一种基于测量的表示学习框架，使用测量特定的 token 作为超声视图与诊断之间的中间表示来表示多视图超声心动图研究。每个测量 token 选择性地关注与其估计相关的视图，并通过表格重建进行训练以预测相应的测量值。由此产生的 token 形成了一种因子化的超声表示，编码了具有临床意义的结构和功能属性，并可用于下游诊断的选择性使用。与常用的对比方法不同，EchoTab 不需要负样本或大批量。在两个数据集上的实验表明，EchoTab 学习到了有效的基于测量的表示，改善了多视图超声心动图的诊断分类，并且其学习到的注意力与心脏病专家使用的既定测量-视图关系一致。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/michelleespranita/EchoTab 获取。

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Randomized Linear-Oracle Optimization over Strongly Convex Sets
papers.abstract: Recent results [arXiv:2602.04378, arXiv:2602.22608] have established worst-case objective-error lower bounds of order $1/T^2$ after $T$ linear minimization oracle (LMO) calls, matching the upper bound [arXiv:1406.1305] in its dependence on $T$ and thereby resolving a long-standing open question. Upon close inspection, however, both lower bounds are somewhat brittle. The first [arXiv:2602.04378] applies only to the standard Frank--Wolfe algorithm, and, as we show, its prescribed slow exact-line-search trajectories can amplify sufficiently small initialization errors exponentially, corresponding to roughly one additional bit of initialization accuracy per iteration. The second [arXiv:2602.22608] obtains lower bounds for any deterministic LMO-based first-order method via a resisting oracle that adversarially adapts to the queries of the algorithm. In both cases it is conceivable that randomization may circumvent these lower bounds; in particular, neither establishes a lower bound for unrestricted randomized first-order LMO methods. We close this gap by proving an $Ω(L\operatorname{diam}(S)^2/T^2)$ distributional lower bound for randomized first-order linear minimization oracle methods over strongly convex sets. While our construction reuses the family of [arXiv:2602.22608], our proof characterizes the conditional distribution of the hidden permutation after adaptive queries and bounds the expected decrease of a combinatorial statistic controlling optimizer variance. We further show that the same error threshold holds with probability at least $3/4$ and yields a stopping-time tail bound.
papers.title_cn: 强凸集上随机线性预言优化的下界
papers.abs_cn: 近期结果 [arXiv:2602.04378, arXiv:2602.22608] 建立了在 T 次线性最小化预言机（LMO）调用后阶为 1/T^2 的最坏情况目标误差下界，其在 T 的依赖关系上与上界 [arXiv:1406.1305] 相匹配，从而解决了一个长期悬而未决的问题。然而仔细审视后，这两个下界都略显脆弱。第一个 [arXiv:2602.04378] 仅适用于标准 Frank--Wolfe 算法，并且正如我们所展示的，其规定的缓慢精确线搜索轨迹可以将足够小的初始化误差指数级放大，大致相当于每次迭代需要额外一位初始化精度。第二个 [arXiv:2602.22608] 通过一个对抗性地适应算法查询的抵抗预言机，获得了任何确定性基于 LMO 的一阶方法的下界。在这两种情况下，随机化都有可能绕过这些下界；特别地，二者均未为不受限制的随机一阶 LMO 方法建立下界。我们通过证明强凸集上随机一阶线性最小化预言机方法的 Omega(L diam(S)^2/T^2) 分布下界来填补这一空白。虽然我们的构造复用了 [arXiv:2602.22608] 的族，但我们的证明刻画了自适应查询后隐藏排列的条件分布，并界定了控制优化器方差的组合统计量的期望下降量。我们进一步表明，相同的误差阈值以至少 3/4 的概率成立，并给出一个停时尾界。

papers.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging in a Time-varying Hierarchical Infrastructure
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification for electric vehicle (EV) charging demand is essential to turn the increasing pressure of EV adoption on power systems into a source of flexibility. We study a large-scale dataset of public charging stations in Scotland, where demand exhibits a hierarchical structure, organized across multiple aggregation levels, from individual charging points to regional and national scales. The charging infrastructure is continuously evolving, with new stations deployed and existing ones occasionally removed, which calls for forecasting and uncertainty quantification methods tailored to this evolving structure. To address these challenges, we combine hierarchical forecasting with recent advances in conformal prediction with missing data. The conformal procedures considered produce valid prediction intervals at every node of the hierarchy and the algorithm CP-MNR-Nested successfully accounts for the time-varying hierarchical structure of the data.
papers.title_cn: 时变分层基础设施中电动汽车充电的概率预测
papers.abs_cn: 电动汽车（EV）充电需求的不确定性量化对于将电动汽车普及给电力系统带来的日益增长的压力转化为灵活性来源至关重要。我们研究了苏格兰公共充电站的大规模数据集，其中需求呈现出分层结构，跨越从单个充电点到区域和国家尺度的多个聚合层级。充电基础设施持续演变，新站点不断部署，现有站点偶尔被移除，这要求针对这种演变结构定制预测和不确定性量化方法。为应对这些挑战，我们将分层预测与缺失数据下共形预测的最新进展相结合。所考虑的共形方法在分层结构的每个节点上都能产生有效的预测区间，且 CP-MNR-Nested 算法成功处理了数据的时变分层结构。

papers.title: How far is Kolmogorov-Loveland randomness from Martin-Löf randomness?
papers.abstract: We'll call a map from basic to clopen sets of binary sequences an \textit{encoding} if it preserves uniform Lebesgue measure and the disjointedness relation. For some notion of randomness $R$ we can ask if there is a computable encoding $E$ such that for every non-Martin-Löf-random (non-MLR) sequence $α$, the sequences in $E(α)$ are non-$R$. Thus we can use $E$ and randomness test for $R$ to construct a randomness test for MLR. We show that there is no such $E$ for partial computable randomness (PCR), but there is one for Kolmogorov-Loveland randomness. Indeed, there is a total computable $E$ and a pair of total computable non-monotonic betting strategies such that on every sequence in $E(α)$ at least one of the strategies wins whenever $α$ is non-MLR.
papers.title_cn: Kolmogorov-Loveland 随机性与 Martin-Löf 随机性相距多远？
papers.abs_cn: 我们将从基本开集到二进制序列的开闭集的映射称为一个\textit{编码}，如果它保持均匀 Lebesgue 测度和不相交关系。对于某种随机性概念 $R$，我们可以问是否存在一个可计算编码 $E$，使得对于每个非 Martin-Löf 随机（非 MLR）序列 $α$，$E(α)$ 中的序列都是非 $R$ 的。因此，我们可以利用 $E$ 和针对 $R$ 的随机性检验来构造针对 MLR 的随机性检验。我们证明，对于部分可计算随机性（PCR），不存在这样的 $E$，但对于 Kolmogorov-Loveland 随机性，存在这样的 $E$。事实上，存在一个全可计算 $E$ 和一对全可计算非单调投注策略，使得对于 $E(α)$ 中的每个序列，只要 $α$ 是非 MLR 的，至少有一个策略获胜。

papers.title: Measuring Artifact Reliance in Machine-Generated Text Detectors
papers.abstract: Detectors of machine-generated text score almost perfectly on scientific-literature benchmarks, implying we can reliably distinguish with these detectors human and machine-generated documents. We looked at ten scientific-document subsets from six popular resources, and on several of them that apparent ease is a side effect of how the documents were put together. A logistic regression using 27 superficial features reached 0.833-0.997 macro-F1, and on the three arXiv subsets it outperformed every detector we evaluate with F1-scores 0.951-0.997. The strongest cue to the detector is the PDF extraction artifact: human texts retain their original line breaks, whereas generated texts are extracted as a single block of prose. This cue, together with three other formatting features, tell the classes apart at 0.996 AUC. To distinguish benchmarks that contain such a signal from detectors that rely on one, we introduce format counterfactuals: just re-wrapping a machine-written abstract without changing a single word reverses 20-27% of a public detector's correct decisions. Normalizing formatting before training reduces the generalization gap from 0.32 to 0.22. On format-clean benchmarks, it also raises out-of-domain macro-F1 from 0.33 to 0.65 for detectors trained on artifact-containing subsets.
papers.title_cn: 测量机器生成文本检测器中的伪影依赖
papers.abs_cn: 机器生成文本检测器在科学文献基准上几乎完美得分，这意味着我们可以用这些检测器可靠地区分人类和机器生成的文档。我们考察了来自六个流行资源的十个科学文档子集，在其中几个子集上，这种表面上的轻松是文档组装方式的副作用。一个使用27个表面特征的逻辑回归达到了0.833-0.997的宏F1，在三个arXiv子集上，它以0.951-0.997的F1分数优于我们评估的每一个检测器。检测器最强的线索是PDF提取伪影：人类文本保留其原始换行，而生成文本被提取为单一散文块。这一线索，连同另外三个格式特征，以0.996的AUC将类别区分开来。为了区分包含此类信号的基准与依赖该信号的检测器，我们引入了格式反事实：仅仅重新换行一个机器撰写的摘要而不改变任何一个词，就会逆转公共检测器20-27%的正确决策。在训练前规范化格式将泛化差距从0.32降低到0.22。在格式干净的基准上，对于在包含伪影的子集上训练的检测器，它还将域外宏F1从0.33提高到0.65。

papers.title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pre-trained robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, provide a strong foundation for generalist robotic manipulation, but adapting them to new tasks with only a few demonstrations remains challenging. Directly fine-tuning a pre-trained policy often achieves strong in-distribution performance, yet it can distort the representations learned during pre-training and weaken the model's generalization ability under out-of-distribution shifts. We propose Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment (RARA), a two-stage adaptation method, to address this issue. First, RARA retrieves representation features from pretraining with similar task intent and motion, and aligns the policy's representations of the target demonstrations with the pre-trained representations of the retrieved demonstrations. Second, RARA fine-tunes the policy on the target demonstrations while limiting how much its representations of the retrieved demonstrations change during fine-tuning. By reducing the representation mismatch before action learning and preserving pre-trained knowledge during adaptation, RARA limits unnecessary representation drift during fine-tuning. Experiments with Diffusion Policy and GR00T on 13 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboCasa, and on a real robot show that RARA improves the average success of fine-tuning by 9.5 points in-distribution and 13.6 points out-of-distribution, and outperforms all compared baselines. Project page: https://shua-kang.github.io/RARA_robot/
papers.title_cn: RARA：通过检索锚定表示对齐实现机器人操作的鲁棒策略微调
papers.abs_cn: 预训练的机器人策略（如视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）为通用机器人操作提供了强大的基础，但仅用少量演示将其适应到新任务仍然具有挑战性。直接微调预训练策略通常能获得较强的分布内性能，但可能会扭曲预训练期间学到的表示，并削弱模型在分布外偏移下的泛化能力。我们提出了检索锚定表示对齐（RARA），一种两阶段适应方法，来解决这一问题。首先，RARA 从预训练中检索具有相似任务意图和运动的表示特征，并将策略对目标演示的表示与检索到的演示的预训练表示对齐。其次，RARA 在目标演示上微调策略，同时限制其对这些检索到的演示的表示在微调过程中的变化幅度。通过在动作学习之前减少表示不匹配，并在适应过程中保留预训练知识，RARA 限制了微调期间不必要的表示漂移。在 RoboTwin、RoboCasa 中的 13 个任务以及真实机器人上使用 Diffusion Policy 和 GR00T 进行的实验表明，RARA 将微调的平均成功率在分布内提高了 9.5 个百分点，在分布外提高了 13.6 个百分点，并且优于所有比较基线。项目页面：https://shua-kang.github.io/RARA_robot/

papers.title: Direct Vector Field Guidance for Path Following
papers.abstract: This paper presents a path-following guidance framework for a turn-rate-constrained unmanned aerial vehicle (UAVs). The proposed guidance strategy uses commanded course angle as a tanh-hyperbolic shaping function of the lateral deviation from the desired path. Stability characteristics illustrating asymptotic convergence to the desired path are established using Lyapunov analysis. Analytical expressions for the turn-rate and corresponding maximum turn-rate bound are derived, enabling direct gain selection for a turn-rate-limited vehicle. Numerical simulations are performed for straight-line following scenarios under both ideal and non-ideal initial heading conditions. Furthermore, a comparative study against representative arctan-, arcsine-, and arccos-based vector-field guidance laws is conducted using analytically feasible gains selected from their respective turn-rate bounds. Comparative numerical results demonstrate the proposed formulation achieves reliable boundary convergence while maintaining smooth steering behavior and a compact analytical gain-design framework.
papers.title_cn: 直接矢量场路径跟踪制导
papers.abs_cn: 本文提出了一种面向转弯速率受限的无人机（UAV）的路径跟踪制导框架。所提出的制导策略将指令航向角表示为相对于期望路径横向偏差的 tanh 双曲整形函数。利用 Lyapunov 分析建立了渐近收敛到期望路径的稳定性特性。推导了转弯速率及相应最大转弯速率边界的解析表达式，从而能够为转弯速率受限的飞行器直接选择增益。针对直线跟踪场景，在理想和非理想初始航向条件下进行了数值仿真。此外，使用从各自转弯速率边界中选取的解析可行增益，与具有代表性的基于 arctan、arcsine 和 arccos 的矢量场制导律进行了对比研究。对比数值结果表明，所提出的公式在保持平滑转向行为和紧凑解析增益设计框架的同时，实现了可靠的边界收敛。

papers.title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
papers.abstract: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.
papers.title_cn: 高维金融回归中基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的 $L_0$ 特征选择
papers.abs_cn: 特征选择是高维金融回归中的一个核心问题，大量工程化变量以及预测变量之间的强相关性会降低模型的稳定性和可解释性。$L_1$ 正则化（Lasso）被广泛用于稀疏回归，但当有信息量的信号分散在相关变量中时，其收缩可能过于严格。精确稀疏回归避免了这种收缩，但需要求解一个计算困难的组合优化问题，并且通常是最小化样本内误差而非样本外误差。本文提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索与广义嵌套滚动策略自适应（GNRPA）的特征选择框架。特征选择被建模为一个序贯决策过程，候选子集根据其样本外验证性能而非训练误差进行评分。该方法还支持一种考虑子集大小和多重共线性的字典序目标。我们在一个同期解释性回归任务上研究了该方法：用涵盖市场、宏观经济和因子数据的 1,072 个工程化特征来解释 NASDAQ-100 指数的周收益率。这将多重共线性下子集选择的价值与预测 forecasting 这一独立问题隔离开来。在该任务上，所提方法识别出的稀疏特征子集具有比优化后的 Lasso 基线更高的样本外解释力，样本外 $R^2$ 达到 0.6961，而 Lasso 为 0.6313。这些结果表明，蒙特卡洛树搜索是金融回归中稀疏解释性特征选择的一种实用替代方案，可替代凸正则化，并在因子归因和风险分解中具有潜在价值，因为在这些场景中透明度与样本外拟合同样重要。

papers.title: Simultaneous Competitive and Regret Guarantees for TCP Acknowledgment
papers.abstract: We study simultaneous competitive and regret guarantees for TCP acknowledgment. Each acknowledgment serves all pending packets, and the objective is to minimize the total acknowledgment and waiting costs. It is well known that no deterministic online algorithm achieves a competitive ratio better than $2$. Given $k$ randomized online experts and $0<\varepsilon<1$, we construct a randomized online algorithm whose realized total cost is always at most $(2+\varepsilon)$ times the offline optimal cost $\mathrm{OPT}$ and whose expected regret against the expert with the smallest realized cost is $O(\sqrt{\mathrm{OPT}\log(k+1)}+\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The algorithm requires no advance knowledge of the number of packets or $\mathrm{OPT}$. Our algorithm controls switching costs between experts and uses the gap between the permitted competitive bound and its current cost to determine when to learn. We also prove lower bounds showing that, for $k\ge 2$, this regret bound is asymptotically optimal in $\mathrm{OPT}$, $k$, and $\varepsilon$, and that $\varepsilon>0$ is necessary for sublinear regret.
papers.title_cn: TCP确认的同时竞争与遗憾保证
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了TCP确认的同时竞争与遗憾保证。每个确认服务于所有待处理的数据包，目标是最小化总确认成本和等待成本。众所周知，没有确定性在线算法能实现优于$2$的竞争比。给定$k$个随机在线专家和$0<\varepsilon<1$，我们构造了一个随机在线算法，其实际总成本始终至多为离线最优成本$\mathrm{OPT}$的$(2+\varepsilon)$倍，且相对于实际成本最小的专家的期望遗憾为$O(\sqrt{\mathrm{OPT}\log(k+1)}+\log(1/\varepsilon))$。该算法不需要预先知道数据包数量或$\mathrm{OPT}$。我们的算法控制专家之间的切换成本，并利用允许的竞争界限与其当前成本之间的差距来决定何时学习。我们还证明了下界，表明对于$k\ge 2$，该遗憾界在$\mathrm{OPT}$、$k$和$\varepsilon$方面是渐近最优的，并且$\varepsilon>0$是次线性遗憾的必要条件。

papers.title: Rationally Linearized MLPs
papers.abstract: We present Rationally Linearized Multilayer Perceptrons(RaLiMPs), a new approach to efficiently linearizing MLPs using low-degree rational approximations of standard activation functions. Inspired by polynomial-based MLP linearization, we show that rational approximations can provide accurate representations at substantially lower degree. RaLiMPs exploit these approximations to construct kernel representations with narrow bottlenecks, enabling efficient composition across MLP layers. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting approximation and evaluate RaLiMPs across applications ranging from implicit 3D models to large language models. Our experiments demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency tradeoffs, with RaLiMPs achieving competitive or improved accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost.
papers.title_cn: 有理线性化MLP
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了有理线性化多层感知机（RaLiMPs），这是一种利用标准激活函数的低次有理逼近来高效线性化MLP的新方法。受基于多项式的MLP线性化启发，我们表明有理逼近能够在显著更低的次数下提供精确表示。RaLiMPs利用这些逼近来构造具有窄瓶颈的核表示，从而实现跨MLP层的高效组合。我们为所得逼近提供了理论保证，并在从隐式3D模型到大型语言模型等应用中评估了RaLiMPs。我们的实验展示了良好的精度-效率权衡，RaLiMPs在实现有竞争力或更高精度的同时大幅降低了推理成本。

papers.title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
papers.abstract: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and on long documents it compresses faster than rereading them.
papers.title_cn: 排练一切，遗忘一切：Attic-KV 排练将要被读取的内容
papers.abs_cn: 许多键值（KV）缓存在任何人知道它们将被问及什么之前就被压缩了：为检索而缓存的文档、跨请求共享的提示前缀、长对话的记忆。主流方法通过排练来为 KV 条目打分：模型重读上下文并保留它关注的条目，假设缓存越完整地排练其上下文，它记忆得越好。我们表明，在紧张的预算下，这一假设适得其反：排练一切，遗忘一切。在 3% 的保留率下，重读整个上下文在 RULER 上仅保留 96.5 分中的 31.5 分，而在 LongBench 的自然文本任务上，它甚至低于完全不排练的方法。原因在于缓存会保留它所排练的内容：重读将预算分散到整个上下文，因此答案自身的条目仅以略高于随机的概率存活。就像考试前的学生一样，缓存通过自我测试比通过重读记住更多。由此得出两条原则：排练将要被读取的内容，并尽可能多地排练。我们将它们实例化为 Attic-KV（简称 Attic），一种无需训练的排练方法，其中模型用引用上下文的问答对进行自我测验，同时以内容自适应的数量加入锚点 token。仅改变排练方式就提升了三个以三种不同方式对其进行评分的宿主：在我们于 RULER 和 LongBench 自然文本任务上测试的全部八个设置中，Attic 单独就是最佳的无需训练方法，而将其接入基于梯度的 KVgrad 和训练过的 RestoreKV+ 后，分别将它们提升最多 17.1 和 28.1 分。其优势随着预算缩小而增大，在 3% 的保留率下比完整重读高出 41.9 分，并且在长文档上它比重读它们压缩得更快。

papers.title: Not All Correct Fixes Run Alike: An Empirical Study of Patch Performance in Repository-Level Issue Resolution
papers.abstract: Repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate submitted patches primarily based on whether they pass the correctness tests, leaving the runtime performance of different test-passing patches largely unexplored. Evaluating patch performance is essential but challenging since designing performance workloads for each benchmark instance is costly. However, these benchmarks already provide a natural candidate: the built-in \emph{FAIL\_TO\_PASS} (F2P) tests, which exercise the behavior affected by the issue fix. We therefore investigate whether the provided F2P tests can be repurposed to evaluate patch performance. Overall, we choose four frontier models, Claude Opus~5, GPT~5.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen~3.8 Max, paired with SWE-agent to resolve the pre-filtered measurable corpus from verified splits of SWE-bench and SWE-bench-Live, yielding 262 cases with at least two different correct solutions, including the developer ground-truth patch. We then measure each solution's runtime performance in instruction count and wall-clock time on the native F2P test, and use Welch ANOVA instead of the RSD proposed in prior work as a more robust statistical discrimination criterion. We find that this methodology exhibits notable discrimination capability in runtime performance and identifies performance differences among patches in almost half of the instances. Our empirical study shows that the runtime performance of generated patches is independent of the issue resolution rate of LLMs, with nearly reversed model rankings. The case study also shows that the performance analysis reveals architectural regression in some patches that the correctness evaluation overlooked. These findings suggest that resolution rate does not adequately characterize LLMs' capability for repository-level issue resolution, motivating future evaluations to consider patch performance alongside it.
papers.title_cn: 并非所有正确修复都表现相同：仓库级问题解决中补丁性能的实证研究
papers.abs_cn: 诸如 SWE-bench 之类的仓库级问题解决基准主要根据提交的补丁是否通过正确性测试来评估它们，而不同通过测试的补丁的运行时性能在很大程度上尚未被探索。评估补丁性能至关重要，但也颇具挑战，因为为每个基准实例设计性能工作负载成本高昂。然而，这些基准已经提供了一个天然的候选：内置的 FAIL_TO_PASS（F2P）测试，它们会执行受问题修复影响的行为。因此，我们研究所提供的 F2P 测试能否被重新用于评估补丁性能。总体而言，我们选择四个前沿模型 Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Qwen 3.8 Max，与 SWE-agent 配对，来解决来自 SWE-bench 和 SWE-bench-Live 已验证划分的预筛选可测量语料库，得到 262 个至少有两种不同正确解决方案的案例，其中包括开发者真实补丁。然后，我们在原生 F2P 测试上以指令计数和挂钟时间衡量每个解决方案的运行时性能，并使用 Welch ANOVA 而非先前工作中提出的 RSD 作为更稳健的统计判别标准。我们发现，该方法在运行时性能上表现出显著的判别能力，并在近一半的实例中识别出补丁之间的性能差异。我们的实证研究表明，生成补丁的运行时性能与 LLM 的问题解决率无关，模型排名几乎相反。案例研究还表明，性能分析揭示了某些补丁中被正确性评估忽视的架构回归。这些发现表明，解决率不足以刻画 LLM 在仓库级问题解决中的能力，促使未来的评估在考虑解决率的同时也考虑补丁性能。

papers.title: HF Single-Station Localization via Multimode Ray Tracing and Time-Frequency Information Fusion
papers.abstract: High-frequency (HF) single-station localization estimates an emitter location from measured directions of arrival (DOAs) and an ionospheric propagation model. When the propagation mode composition cannot be identified from conventional direction-finding (DF) measurements, the same DF observation may produce multiple physically valid ground landing points under different propagation modes, making the location inversion ambiguous. This paper proposes a multimode time-frequency information fusion localization method (MTFIF-L).Rather than assuming a propagation mode a priori, MTFIF-L retains valid landing points generated under different propagation modes and uses repeated observations across time windows and, when available, multiple operating frequencies to progressively constrain the resulting candidate locations. Experiments on four measured HF links examine the respective roles of multimode candidate retention, cross-window processing, and cross-frequency processing. All four links yield unique location decisions. Links A--C achieve relative errors of $1.40\%$, $0.78\%$, and $3.41\%$, respectively.Link D, the only single-frequency case, also yields a unique decision from repeated temporal observations, although its post- localization error is substantially larger.
